notes.title: 06/26 Patch Details (Updated on 06/20 05:09 AM UTC / 06/19 10:09 PM PDT)
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/6054a18528e7391406ca27ae2d8e9119902b0dcf.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,[/p][p][/p][p]It feels like we just stepped into this year, yet here we are, already halfway through it![/p][p]Have you been enjoying the changes to the game so far? We hope you are![/p][p][/p][p]This coming update, the mysterious Bianca, a brilliant mind capable of predicting everything, will make her grand entrance.[/p][p][/p][p]Coming with her is an update to Portrait of Thierry, alongside an attached mode to it called “Glorious Age”—offering fresh challenges and even greater rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re also improving your gameplay experience by removing intrusive UI elements, enhancing the filter system for relics and accessories, and refining the gem crafting feature for greater convenience.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, four of our Knights of Veda—including Xanthia and Ellen Farrell—are growing stronger with this update,[/p][p]and a new Knight’s Robe for Anais will bring a cool breeze to your summer![/p][p][/p][p]To help you enjoy the summer heat, there will be several seasonal events on the way where you can earn a wide variety of rewards—so we hope you’ll join in the fun![/p][p][/p][p]Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Knights of Veda[/b][/h3][p][b]* The new 5★ Knight of Veda, Bianca, welcomes you to her dark world[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/66d9265788a3b380c20f32fd26d1e153d741cd62.png"][/img][/p][h3][b][i]“I'm so ready to get crazy, who wants to play with me?”[/i][/b]
 
[b]Her laughter invites despair. To her, hope is just a toy. To her, a boring world is akin to death. She only feels truly alive when in danger, chaos, and instability. Her genuine amusement begins when everything falls apart[/b][/h3][p]

- Bianca is a Dark-type Melee DPS who uses a Large Club. Each hit of her massive hammer applies “Dopamine Index” to herself, gaining increased ATK and ATK SPD. You might even trigger a special skill called “Hey you, come here!,” which deals additional AoE DMG. 
- Her Normal Skill, “I’ll be right there!” lets her swift charge towards enemies in front to strike them down while her Signature Skill, “I’m just being my normal self,” unleashes a shockwave that damages nearby enemies all the while giving her access to some powerful buffs that increase DMG, give her a boost to CRIT DMG and reduce DMG taken.

- “Bianca” alongside her Signature Weapon “Once Sacred” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature Halo “Dark Natured Halo” and her Signature El Cid “El Cid of Game” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.
- Check out Bianca and her abilities all the while earning rewards in the “Journey in Memory” event.
- An enhanced Step Up Pack will also be available for Bianca, which contains a generous amount of Crystals of Destiny and a Bond of Sanctuary, allowing you to select a Legendary Weapon of Genesis of your choice.


[b]* Another new beginning arrives for the 5★ Knight of Veda, White Hell.[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/fdc9f8cc0bdd63748311837c03ada7bf2914645d.png"][/img]- “White Hell” is a Dual Attribute Electric and Light-type Ranged DPS wielding a Staff, she uses the power of “Dynamic Punishment” to periodically cause lightning to strike down around her. These lightning bolts become holy torrents, neutralizing some of the target's Electric and Light RES and delivering judgment.
- White Hell alongside her Signature Weapon “World Tree Broom” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature Halo “Advancing Halo” and her Signature El Cid “Awakened Angel” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.


[b]* 5★ Knight of Veda Lady Anais Liongray, companion of the eternal flame bird, once again answers the Call of the Stars[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/eb2d59cfc0eb3986f02569b15e3ff048830dc36d.png"][/img]- “Anais” is a Fire-type Ranged Healer wielding a Wand & Orb, she is a healer who sacrifices a portion of her HP to boost ATK while simultaneously reviving vulnerable allies during her attacks.
- Anais alongside her Signature Weapon “Special Relationship” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature Halo “Hopeful Halo” and her Signature El Cid “El Cid of Feather of Salvation” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.


[b]* Anais dresses up for the upcoming summer with a new “Knight’s Robe!”[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/8bc58249a93a94a03b5985f9b7834df62e3caeef.png"][/img]- A new refreshing Knight’s Robe, “Flowers on the Waves” for Anais will now be available.
- As with the previous Knight’s Robe, while “Flowers on the Waves” is equipped, Anais’ appearance will change, and her skill effects will be too to match the new look.
- A Name Card and Profile Icon will come with your purchase of the Knights Robe.


[/p][h3][b]■ A new “Glorious Age” dawns on Portrait of Thierry![/b][/h3][p][b]* “Glorious Age” will be added to "Portrait of Thierry” alongside other adjustments to the content.[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/8ffe08130d3ad16c2e21682dd407deebf296954d.png"][/img]- A new “Glorious Age” button will be added to the main Portrait of Thierry menu.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/169183b71cdf62a9c667cee38f08272508340566.png"][/img]- There’s three (3) difficulty levels you can choose before challenging Glorious Age. Select your preferred difficulty based on your party’s strength and take on the Glorious Age to gather progress points and earn plentiful rewards!
- Higher difficulty levels will enhance enemy abilities and increase the number of floors available to challenge. In return, you will earn more progress points upon clearing.
- If you’re encountering trouble with the difficulty level you chose, don’t worry! You can always change to a different one. (Updated on 06/20 05:09 AM UTC / 06/19 10:09 PM PDT)
- These progress points can then be used to claim rewards which will reset every Thursday. Rewards include Gold and Mythic Relic crafting materials.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/121be419faea6be7d088a4529027bbfb81912d06.png"][/img]- Thierry’s Pass will be available starting 07/01 and will reset every first day of the month.
- Additional rewards such as “Mystical Chromatics” can also be earned by going to the Thierry’s Pass menu. If you purchase the accompanying Goddess’s Reward Decree for Thierry’s Pass, you will be able to receive more rewards, including a Legendary El Cid Selector Ticket for the Pickup Knights of Veda (Rhynara included)!


[/p][h3][b]■ Nightmare of the Abyss rework? Nightmare of the Abyss rework![/b][/h3][p][b]* Adjustments to the Nightmare of theAbyss Levels will be made, reducing them from 25 to 10[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/35507a7bd72d2689e030238662222afb82c005aa.png"][/img]- To make the content more fun to do and allow our Masters of the Book to farm higher-level rewards, we’ve made the decision to reduce the number of Abyssal Levels from 25 to 10. Take note that we didn’t just reduce the number of levels, we’ve also made various balance adjustments to each to make sure that it’ll still be a challenge in line with its status as end-game content.
- Your current progress will be converted to the new system when the rework is live. We’ve also adjusted the penalties for failing a dungeon, such as that it will only be reduced one (1) level at a time.
- For more details on how the conversion works, please check the table below:
 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/08939cb368a1719c7467ecc328bc40ff1260e66a.png"][/img]* From the new Abyssal Level 8 onwards, you will now be able to obtain up to two (2) Mythic Relics.


[/p][h3][b]■ Balance[/b][/h3][p][b]* Another set of four (4) Knights of Veda will be up for adjustments.[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/1a6475f1435b0add7b351c706f5c7121764b1a48.png"][/img]- In this update, the Knights of Veda Xanthia, Ellen Farrell, Nec, and Violet will be adjusted.
- Going forward, we plan to make these Knight of Veda adjustments more regularly through our monthly updates.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/8215e83847108f0a1ae0a21a94a65cf5c651a92f.png"][/img][b]* Adjustments to PvP stat modifiers will be made.[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/8dc525dac7c30cadac1e323296d39e9bf93d152d.png"][/img]- As part of our quest to make the game’s balancing as it can be, we’re making adjustments to PVP stat modifiers. 
- To start, we’ll be making adjustments to the defensive capabilities of the Knights in PVP content.
- In Battlefield of the War Gods, Strong ATKs will no longer be used in order to make combat smoother and prevent DPS loss.
- Like we said in the beginning, this is only the beginning. Rest assured that we’ll continue to monitor the situation (and your feedback!) to make the necessary adjustments.


[/p][h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3][p][b]* A mythic change will now allow you to Mythic Accessories![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/84961171ce845c1034ee817d45d2e5bad68ead07.png"][/img]- You will now be able to craft accessories when you go to Gundir. It will also be accessible under the Craft & Shop menu on the Adventure Guide.
- You will need to have the specific Mythic Accessory Crafting Materials to proceed, with sub-stats being assigned randomly.
- Mythic Accessory Crafting Materials can be obtained as rewards on Portrait of Thierry: Glorious Age.


[b]* No more waiting for your crafted stuff! Crafting will now be instant![/b]
- As with the title, crafting will now be instant instead of taking a set amount of time. This will apply to all crafting features that previously had it.
- Items that were being crafted when the update is applied will be ended immediately and the crafted item delivered via in-game mail.


[b]* Reach new levels of accessorizing! The maximum level for accessories will now be set to 100![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9e2e44cb31b6480417249b791f5c696c1f221563.png"][/img]- When an accessory is upgraded to level 100, both its main and sub-stats will be strengthened.
- Ascending your Accessories from Level 90 to 100 will need you to have an item called “Accessory Frame of Intricacy,” which you can obtain from the Portrait of Thierry shop.


[b]* Speaking of shops…. We’ll be increasing the amount of Ascension Materials you can purchase from content shops![/b]
- You will now be able to purchase as many of the Accessory Ascension Materials as you can afford from the Portrait of Thierry Shop.
- We’ve also lowered the prices of Accessory Ascension Materials on all other Shops, alongside increasing their purchase limits.
- Accessory’s Oblivion, purchasable in the Support Store, can now be purchased with Gold.


[b]* Relics and Accessory Inventory Filters will be improved![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2e82ebdfac8637065ef459ab91da31dd725c06ee.png"][/img]- The filter system will be improved to allow more versatile filtering by letting you choose whether the selected options must \[All Match] or \[Exclude Selected].


[b]* Not just the filters! We’re also improving the Gem Crafting experience! [/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/03997b873174d76a05ed87ffec899a8eceb482f7.png"][/img]- An option to Batch Register will be added to the Gem Crafting menu to streamline the process.


[b]* Adjustments to the Game UX to make the experience smoother will be made![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/bbf6f0f8ffeb382c5b12a6d4060bab8b88aa4a1a.png"][/img]- Pop-ups that disrupted gameplay will be removed, with the menus that you used to encounter before entering content simplified to get you into the action as smoothly as possible.
  - Pressing the “Exit”/”X” button while on Celestial Trials will now return you directly to Todburg.
  - The “Knight’s Missions” icon will now remain visible at all times, and unnecessary pop-up windows when conducting Sweeps will be removed.
  - The Main Achievement screen will be removed, allowing you to better access and select the Achievement menu you wish to interact with.
- Unnecessary pop-ups will also be removed from some content entry and result screens, such as those on Apparition’s Rush.


[/p][h3][b]■ Events & Seasonal Content[/b][/h3][p][b]* “Our Great Summer Adventures Together” event celebrates our second Summer on this great adventure![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/5ad5ecf318af93e07419eb3d3640efa179c7bc50.png"][/img]- To prepare for the blazing summer, the “Our Great Summer Adventures Together” event will be held where you can earn rewards such as “Crystal of Fate,” “Crystal of Destiny,” and Starstones just by logging in.
- This event will run from after the maintenance on 06/26 and will end before the regular maintenance on 07/31.


[b]* Before Summer arrives, greet it warmly with the “Say Hello to Summer!” event![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0e93fb163f2240fc69843fef7889b9c140ce2f4f.png"][/img]- Welcome the coming of summer with adventuring! Explore Adventure Zones and earn “Ice Pop,” a summer-themed food item that can be used in battle and also provides rewards based on how many you collect.
- This event will run from after the maintenance on 06/26 and will end before the regular maintenance on 07/31.


[b]* Conduct various challenges even in this summer heat and earn rewards in the “Cool Summer, Hot Adventure!” Event![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/56354defacfb8aeacb72e044bb3a5d7bd8b38a48.png"][/img]- A summer-themed mission event where you can complete missions to earn various rewards.
- This event will run from after the maintenance on 06/26 and will end before the regular maintenance on 07/31.


[b]* Why have just one Rift when you can have two? Both Rift events will be active this update cycle![/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/591989c8d5db90a4dfdf23e7e0feda18c7dc334c.png"][/img]- Battle various bosses entering this world through the various rifts in the “Distorted Rift” and “Shattered Dimensional Rift” events!
- Distorted Rift will run from after the 06/26 Maintenance until 07/17 12:00 KST
- Meanwhile, the Shattered Dimensional Rift will run from 07/17 15:00 KST until before the 07/31 Maintenance.
- During their respective event periods, complete missions and earn rich rewards from the “Rift Pass” and “Dimensional Pass” which can be accessed via the buttons located at the bottom of the main event screen or through the Guidance of the Goddess screen. Purchase the Goddess’s Reward Decree and earn the “Unsullied Remnants of Accessories”, allowing you to select a Mythic Accessory with the highest possible stat for your desired Main stat.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/74bdc4850b20abb1995e877a8bf03559e4be9624.png"][/img][b]* The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will reward you for helping Harold with research materials.[/b]
- Collect the materials Harold requires to write his research log from the Adventure Zone stages and submit them to him in Todburg to receive rewards.
- The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will be unlocked progressively, with one log entry opening each day, and you can check your progress in the Research Log.
- The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will run from 07/17 06:00 AM UTC / 07/16 11:00 PM PDT until before the 07/31 Maintenance.

[b]* A new “The Fruits of Adventure” Daily Attendance event is upon us![/b]
- Receive various rewards depending on the number of days you logged in.
- “The Fruits of Adventure” event will run from 07/01 06:00 AM UTC / 06/30 11:00 PM PDT to 08/01 06:00 AM UTC / 07/31 11:00 PM PDT.

[b]* The "Blessing in Adventure" event is back to shower everyone with more rewards![/b]
- During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Dungeons up to the daily limit.
- The double rewards event for Adventure Dungeons will run from after the 06/26 maintenance until 07/17 03:00 AM UTC /  07/16 08:00 PM PDT.

[b]* The Calydon’s Blessing event will be there to sate your hunger for Gold![/b]
- During the event period, your Calydon’s Hideout rewards will be doubled!
- The Calydon Blessing event will be held from after the maintenance on 06/26 until 07/17 03:00 AM UTC / 07/16 08:00 PM PDT.

[b]* Veda’s Nightmare deepens as the rewards for braving its halls increase, the “Blessing in Nightmare” event returns![/b]
- During the "Blessing in the Nightmare" event, you can earn double rewards from “Veda's Nightmare” and on “Nightmare of the Abyss” up to the daily limit. 
- The "Blessing in the Nightmare" event starts on 07/17 06:00 AM UTC / 07/16 11:00 PM PDT and will end before the regular maintenance on 07/31.

[b]* A new Reward Decree season will start.[/b]
- The new Reward Decree season will begin on 07/01 06:00 AM UTC / 06/30 11:00 PM PDT, and will run until 08/01 06:00 AM UTC / 07/31 11:00 PM PDT
- Changes to the rewards you get from purchasing Neejarem’s Reward Decree:
  - The Steps of the Journey x20 given after the initial purchase will be changed to Crystals of Destiny x30.
  - The Level 50 Reward will be changed to “Weapon's Praise,” a Weapon Selector which includes the Exclusive Weapons of Knights such as Rhynara.

[b]* A new season of Arena will begin.[/b]
- During this Arena Season, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.
- This Arena Season will end before the regular maintenance on 07/31.

[b]* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.[/b]
- After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
- The new Portrait of Thierry season will end before the regular maintenance on 07/31.

[b]* A new season of Nightmare of the Abyss will be starting.[/b]
- With the new season, a new set of Abyss Trials will be applied to each stage.
 - The new Nightmare of the Abyss season will end before the regular maintenance on 07/31.

[b]* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.[/b]
- It has been answered! The “Desperate Prayer to the Goddess“ will be this season’s featured boss!
- "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
  - 1st Round: 06/26 to 07/08 / Settlement until 07/10 06:00 AM UTC / 07/09 11:00 PM PDT
  - 2nd Round: 07/17 to 07/29 / Settlement until 07/31 06:00 AM UTC / 07/30 11:00 PM PDT

[b]* The Celestial Trials get new floors![/b]
- Thought we forgot about it did we? We didn’t and we’re glad to let our Masters of the Book know that Celestial Trials will be expanded to up to Floor 65. Enjoy the climb everyone!


[/p][h3][b]■ Store[/b][/h3][p][b]* Some Reset Items can now be purchased with Gold on the Support Store.[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/b8c350a0555a6537805294cd3306269a38c4a4f3.png"][/img]- Knight’s Oblivion, Tunic’s Oblivion, Weapon’s Oblivion, and Accessory’s Oblivion can now be purchased on the Support Store with Gold.
- Accordingly, they will now be unavailable for exchange on the Exchange Abyss of the Stars.

[b]* Various Special Packages will be available starting this update![/b]
- To help you enjoy the early summer and the coming heat, special item bundles will be on sale:
  - Mythic Pack will assist you with the Mythic Promotion process for either your Knights of Veda or their Weapons.
  - Destiny Pack will offer Crystal of Destiny at a reasonable price.
  - The Halo Pack and El Cid Pack, contains items to obtain and upgrade your Halo and El Cid respectively.
  - The Starlit Destiny Pack then comes with a large amount of Crystal of Fate and Galactic Bliss.


[/p][h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p]- An issue where the Sealed Prison results from previous runs are being displayed when doing a Sweep will be fixed.
- An issue where the score displayed after a Survival Arena match is sometimes incorrect when a Double Rewards event is active will be fixed.
- An issue where an error message would appear when entering Portrait of Thierry through the Belle Menu then exiting it via the content links from item descriptions will be fixed.
- An issue where you could only purchase additional Sailing Wheels for Shadow Waters one at a time instead of in bulk will be fixed.
- An issue where you are unable to access Nightmare of the Abyss via the content links on item descriptions will be fixed.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: [Complete] 06/12 Update Server Maintenance and Sealed Prison Improvement Notice
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/234f37b457e2ca3c6297de60d563d5e4dd01e0de.jpg"][/img]

[b][Complete][/b]

Masters of the Book,

The 6/12 Unscheduled Maintenance has been completed, and now is your time to turn a new page on your adventures through Planis.

This update is available on both PC platforms. We hope you enjoy these latest updates to the game.

If you are having any issues while playing the game, please make sure to report them through our Customer Support Center.

Thank you.

[hr][/hr]
Masters of the Book,

During the 05/29 Update, we introduced the Sealed Prison Rework to all of our Masters of the book. While the intent of the rework was to introduce another way for everyone to strengthen their Knights of Veda, we acknowledge that more could be done to improve it.

With this in mind, we’ve made some improvements to the Sealed Prison with your feedback.

We would like to apologize for any inconvenience caused by the reworked Sealed Prison. Rest assured that aside from the changes we will be introducing during the maintenance, we will still be making some changes in the future to the content to increase your enjoyment of it.

To facilitate these improvements and to apply fixes to other issues currently in the game, we would like to inform you that a temporary maintenance will be conducted on June 12, 2025.

Please check the details below for more information on the changes that will occur

[h3][b]■ 06/12 Maintenance[/b][/h3]
[b]* Period:[/b] 
　- 06/12 05:30 AM - [strike]08:30[/strike]　07:09 AM (UTC)
　- 06/11 10:30 PM - 06/12 [strike]01:30[/strike]　12:09 AM (PDT)
[b]* Target:[/b]
　- All Servers
[b]* Notes:[/b]
　- The game will not be accessible during the maintenance.
[b]* Details:[/b]
　- Goddess’s Blessing will now be enhanced automatically after clearing a Sealed Prison and obtaining the specific Enhancement Stone for that Goddess’s Blessing. Any unused Enhancement Stones on your inventory will be automatically used to enhance the Goddess’s Blessing connected to it.
　- The current dungeon level will now be displayed again before entering or sweeping a Sealed Prison to make sure you’re challenging the right level.
　- Improvements to the Sealed Prison UI have been made to make viewing related information easier.
　- An issue where the ATK value a Mythic Bluebell would have received due to her Fate Level is decreased rather than increased will be fixed.
　- An issue where the achievement for obtaining Bluebell would not properly register for some users will be fixed.

[h3][b]■ Maintenance Rewards[/b][/h3]
[b] - Item: [/b]Starstone x300, Sealed Prison Key x5
[b] - Distribution Period:[/b] June 12, 2025 after the maintenance - June 13, 2025 02:59 PM (UTC) / 07:59 AM (PDT)

[h3][b]■ How to Obtain the Rewards[/b][/h3]
* Access Belle Menu → Mail → Receive Items
* The mail and items will expire within 7 days.
* Make sure to log in to the game during the distribution period in order to obtain the rewards.
* If you cannot find the rewards in your mail, please restart the game.

[h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3]
* During the maintenance, both PC and Mobile versions will be inaccessible, and the Coupon page will also be unavailable. 
* Maintenance time may be changed depending on the circumstances. Any changes will be announced in this notice. 
* To ensure that your game data remains safe, please make sure to close the game before maintenance begins. 

Once the maintenance has been completed, further information will be provided through this notice.

Thank you.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/897b7cf5f670eae4058355ede9dbe1392699f55f.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book,

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/6579ee6c1e35396f04064512e3e181d5e157e0b7.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

The 05/29 Update is nearly upon us and before it arrives, we wanted to give you a brief preview of the update’s content.

Bluebell, the fifth Enchanted Warrior of the Shadows of Dark Nights, who has lost all memories as a side effect of experiments gone wrong, comes to ASTRA: Knights of Veda. Though she lives in constant fear of what she has become, she becomes completely uncontrollable once she enters a frenzied state.

Coming with Bluebell is a rework of the long-forgotten Sealed Prison content! A specific prison will now open daily according to the day of the week, clearing which will grant you materials for “Goddess’s Blessing,” a buff that will enhance stats based on the Role.

We’ve also made careful adjustments to four Knights of Veda, making sure they’re all relevant to the game’s evolving meta, in addition to making all 5★ Weapons now eligible for Mythic Promotion. 

Finally, in response to player feedback, we’ve cooked up new events for everyone. Need more gold? A Double Rewards event for Calydon’s Hideout will be held, alongside one for Arena Survival! Blessing in Adventure/Nightmare, which already gives you double the rewards, will now have their daily use doubled also!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ Knights of Veda[/b][/h3]
[b]* Ring the bell and don’t forget, 5★ Knight of Veda Bluebell will be coming this update[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/bd3b58627d78346ca4981543e938d48f5a94e01d.png[/img]
[h3][i][b]“I'm sorry... Die, please die!!!”[/b][/i]

[b]In the dark of the night, follow the sound of weeping and you will find a slender girl muttering to herself. "S-Sorry... I-I'm so sorry..." She has forgotten everything in the constant experiments inflicted upon her and now remembers nothing but the word "Bluebell.” Once the most noble young lady in the kingdom, dreaming a dream full of hope, she now wants only one thing. Not to be punished, never to be dragged back into that terrible pain again.[/b]
[/h3]

- Bluebell is a Blood-type Melee Support who uses a Greatsword that inflicts [Increased Blood DMG] on enemies she hits, with a random chance to inflict the [Bleed] status effect. 
- Her Normal Skill slashes enemies in front of her three times, applying the [This Will Hurt a Little] debuff on the enemy. This debuff applies [Increased Blood DMG] to the enemy alongside increased Tenacity ATK and Melee-based DMG from Bluebell’s Allies.
- Her Signature Skill has her slash down with a giant sword made of blood, dealing AoE damage to enemies in front of her and applying the [Now Please Die] debuff on enemies hit. This debuff applies [Increased Blood DMG] to the enemy alongside an [ATK Bonus] and [Bonus DMG to Bleeding Enemy] from Bluebell’s Allies.

- “Bluebell” alongside her Signature Weapon “Blood Flower Sword” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature Halo “Dreadful Halo” and her Signature El Cid “El Cid of Lost Name” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.
- Check out Bluebell and her abilities all the while earning rewards in the “Journey in Memory” event.
- To celebrate her addition to the game, the “Fateful Encounter” login event will offer a set of valuable rewards, including Radiance and Mystical Chromatics.


[b]* 5★ Knight of Veda Asha splashes back into action.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/47c093b0a21baebdfdc70e9aa7d6ddc1e049d751.png[/img]
* The leader of the Shadows of Dark Nights and the last escort guard of the “Oirat,” Asha splashes back into action.
- Asha is a Water-attribute DPS who grants and stacks “Sea Shard” with every hit on an enemy. When “Sea Shard” reaches a certain number of stacks, they create a “Sea Maelstrom”, drawing enemies in the area to the center and dealing heavy DMG.
- Asha alongside her Signature Weapon “String of Blue Sky” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature Halo “Covenant Halo” and her Signature El Cid “El Cid of Silent Resolve” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.

[h3][b]■ Sealed Prison rework finally unsealed![/b][/h3]
[b]* The oft-forgotten Sealed Prison is now getting its deserved rework.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/1a498c5db68e93755ab7a1720571b7ee31077a42.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0d13b1c3832eed8b53caf6570715cf05e4b3222b.png[/img]
- The reworked Sealed Prisons can be accessed via the “Sealed Prison” button on the Belle Menu, through the Adventure Guide, or as before, by going through the respective Sealed Prison on the Adventure Zones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/3359db482bdf6cc9dba9f785f7551b811c1b7cbb.png[/img]
- The new Sealed Prison consists of seven dungeons, with each being available only during a specific day, which you can check on the main Sealed Prison screen where you can also check the current Blessing Level for each Sealed Prison.
 ※ What’s a Blessing then? Sit tight as we explain it in its own section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/b3dca0aa61b1824ff078cd4c2a888c37641acd30.png[/img]
- Each Sealed Prison has a recommended attribute and can be challenged either as a “Normal Battle” or “Squad Battle”
- The difficulty level changes depending on the Sealed Prison’s Blessing Level, with a higher difficulty however comes more rewards. Stuck on a certain level? You can adjust the level you wish to challenge by selecting your desired level at the preparation menu. The “Sweep” feature will also be unlocked once the level has been cleared at least once.
- You can challenge up to three (3) times a day, with additional attempts available by using your Starstones or Rubies.

- Clearing a Sealed Prison grants “Goddess’s Blessing Enhancement Stones” which can be used to strengthen a Goddess’s Blessing alongside a healthy amount of Gold.
- Accessories that were previously obtainable from Sealed Prisons can now be acquired through the Equipment Store starting from 06/01 06:00 AM (UTC) / 05/31 11:00 PM (PDT), with Accessory Ascension Materials being obtainable from the Portrait of Thierry Shop. (Updated 05/29 08:50 AM UTC / 01:50 AM PDT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d5a736caf55fb9fb305cc500d8cb7e67264d5120.png[/img]

- The “Sealed Prison Pass” which can be accessed via the button on the upper left of the selection screen, allows you to earn more “Goddess Blessing Enhancement Stones” in addition to other rewards by completing missions. The Sealed Prison Pass will be available starting on June 01.


[h3][b]■ Goddess’s Blessing[/b][/h3]
[b]* Enhance each Goddess’s Blessing by using the Goddess’s Blessing Enhancement Stones obtained from the Sealed Prisons.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/eac748e7d5db674332ce2fc7290e1748989aca34.png[/img]
- At the bottom of the Sealed Prison selection screen, you’ll find buttons to enhance each of the seven (7) types of Goddess’s Blessing. Each Goddess’s Blessing provides a permanent stat boost based on the Knight of Veda’s role.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/b9007bed825ce340da7059e9d8fd8fa803ddf04e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/5f020db440bef4fbe66f4df97fef8a168ead0156.png[/img]
- In the Goddess’s Blessing Enhancement screen, you can use the Goddess's Blessing Enhancement Stones to strengthen the Blessing of your choice. As you enhance a Blessing, it’ll grant more powerful effects but in turn raise the level of each Sealed Prison, allowing you to earn greater rewards.


[h3][b]■ New Features & Balance Adjustments[/b][/h3]
[b]*All Legendary (★5) weapons can now be upgraded to Mythic (★6).[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2807025511c0e94188cb0cd8cf97ca96f1981fa6.png[/img]
- Following the previous update, every (yes, all) Legendary (★5) weapon can now be upgraded to Mythic (★6). 
- Complete specific missions tied to each weapon to unlock Mythic Promotion to gain increased base stats and an additional Mythic skill.
 

[b]* Some Knights of Veda are getting upgrades![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/51f0c4380ae51ccdeeedfa5e67b373cf62721602.png[/img]
- In this update, the Knights of Veda Death Crown, Asha, Vesti, and Gabi will be adjusted.
- Going forward, we plan to make these Knight of Veda adjustments more regularly through our monthly updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/a8877e8454960c7d3a7b528f54b49d3f4dc29554.png[/img]

[b]* The DMG of Damage over Time (DoT) effects – Burn, Bleed, and Shock – will be increased.[/b]
- To improve the overall utility of DoT effects, the DMG dealt by Burn, Bleed, and Shock will be increased by 50%.
- As with the changes above, we will continue to monitor and adjust these values in future updates.


[h3][b]■ Events and Seasonal Content[/b][/h3]
[b]* Double the Calydon, double the Gold! The Calydon’s Blessing event will be there to sate your hunger for Gold![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/4ee33fb70c7a5270fe0c281eef2e20cf4b4ab13a.png[/img]
- We’ve heard you pleas for more gold, that’s why we’ve cooked up this event that’ll make you earn double than you usually would.
- During the event period, your Calydon’s Hideout rewards will be doubled!
- The Calydon Blessing event will be held from after the maintenance on 05/29 until 06/12 03:00 AM UTC / 06/11 08:00 PM PDT.

[b]* Double the times you can double the rewards! Adjustments to Blessing in Adventure![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/efb7e1333490f0951ff935e98383518802630880.png[/img]
- “Blessing in Adventure” will be adjusted to now be able to double the rewards you receive from Adventure Stages from eight (8) times a day to sixteen (16) times.
- The “Blessing in Adventure” event will be held from after the maintenance on 05/29 until 06/12 03:00 AM UTC / 06/11 08:00 PM PDT. 

[b]* Not to be beat, Blessing in Nightmare does the double thing also![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/a53bfcc28b7a059ef67e25ebaf3f0f0c27c3914f.png[/img]
- “Blessing in Nightmare” will be adjusted to now be able to double the rewards you receive from Veda’s Nightmare Stages and Nightmare of the Abyss from two (2) times a day to four (4) times!
- The “Blessing in Adventure” event will be held from 06/12 06:00 AM UTC / 06/11 11:00 PM PDT until before the maintenance on 06/26.

[b]* A new event comes your way! Introducing “Blessing in the Battlefield!”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/55604c20282b024365fed30b55c557695ba002fb.png[/img]
- During the event period, rewards from Arena Survival will be doubled!
- The “Blessing in the Battlefield” event will be held from after the maintenance on 05/29 until before the maintenance on 06/26.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2ef5df9622a0204889bcef499f5db94e4e9a7c01.png[/img]
- A “Survival Pass” will be introduced and be available in two phases during the event period. You can access it via the button on the bottom of the Arena Survival screen or on the “Guidance of the Goddess” screen. If you purchase the Survival Pass Goddess’s Reward Decree and complete the missions, you will earn the “Gem of All Things,” allowing you to select a Mythic Gem of your choice with the highest possible stat.

[b]* Join the ‘Simon’s Amazing Gifts’ event! Work together with your Guild members to defeat treasure chests and claim exciting rewards.[/b]
- The “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” event can be participated in every Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at 08:00 PM during the event period, at the Guild Territory.
- Various rewards can be obtained from this event, and for this current iteration: the new mascot “Rocker” can be earned.
- “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” will run from 06/05 to 06/22.

[b]* A new “The Fruits of Adventure” Daily Attendance event is upon us![/b]
- Receive various rewards depending on the number of days you logged in.
- “The Fruits of Adventure” event will run from 06/01 06:00 AM UTC / 05/31 11:00 PM PDT to 07/01 06:00 AM UTC / 06/30 11:00 PM PDT.

[b]* A new Reward Decree season will start.[/b]
- The new Reward Decree season will begin on 06/01 06:00 AM UTC / 05/31 11:00 PM PDT, and will run until 06/30 06:00 AM UTC / 06/29 10:00 PM PDT
- Starting from this new Reward Decree season, missions related to the Sealed Prison will now be Weekly Missions instead of Daily.

[b]* A new season of Arena will begin.[/b]
- During this Arena Season, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.
- This Arena Season will end before the regular maintenance on 06/26.

[b]* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.[/b]
- After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
- The new Portrait of Thierry season will end before the regular maintenance on 06/26.

[b]* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.[/b]
- The dynamic duo of “Nec” and “Roderick” is in the new Beast Battlefront season as the featured boss!
- "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
　﻿﻿• 1st Round: 
　﻿﻿　﻿﻿- From 05/29 06:00 AM UTC / 05/28 11:00 PM PDT to 06/10 06:00 AM UTC / 06/09 11:00 PM PDT
　﻿﻿　﻿﻿- Results will be tallied until 06/12 06:00 AM UTC / 06/11 11:00 PM PDT
　﻿﻿• 2nd Round:
　﻿﻿　﻿﻿- From 06/12 06:00 AM UTC / 06/11 11:00 PM PDT to 06/24 06:00 AM UTC / 06/23 11:00 PM PDT
　﻿﻿　﻿﻿- Results will be tallied until 06/26 06:00 AM UTC / 06/25 11:00 PM PDT

[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
- An issue where the Collection entry for “Lord of the Skies White Hell” was not displaying correctly will be fixed.
- An issue where the Veda’s Nightmare for Adventure Zone Chapter 9 would not unlock even after clearing all the stages in it will be fixed.
- An issue where the Daily Charging Cap bar still gets displayed when recharging Adventurer’s Shoes even though the user has no Rubies will be fixed.
- An issue where the search results in the Tutorial Collection would not display video-based content properly will be fixed.
- An issue where the Veda’s Nightmare stages on the Adventure Guide were incorrectly categorized will be fixed.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Team’s Responses to Your 04/24 Update Comments and Questions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

This is Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda. The development team is here to answer the feedback and questions you, our Masters of the Book, have shared.


[h3][b]1. Guild Contribution barely matters in the grand scheme of things. Is there something being done to address this? Maybe using them to level up the guild or apply guild-wide buffs? A Rework to the Guild Shop would also be great.[/b][/h3]

Due to the development prioritizing the development of other major features, the planned rework to the Guild System has been repeatedly delayed. We apologize for not being able to make improvements to the system despite it being released for a while now.

Updates to this system alongside a Guild Shop Rework and the introduction of “Guild Sieges” will be added on the game’s August Update. Rest assured once we have the details finalized we’ll be sharing the details either through a “Director’s Note” or the “Dev Sneak Peek”

[h3][b]2. I think a Global ranking/leaderboard for the game would be great, where users could also earn rewards depending on their rank. Thank you for your wonderful suggestion! We’ll keep it in mind while we do updates to the leaderboard system.[/b][/h3]

One of these ideas we are considering is the addition of a single page where you can view all the active leaderboards. As many of the game’s newer content feature leaderboards, we believe this is a good direction to go about it.

In addition, we are considering adding additional factors to calculating Global Ranking if we do go around adding one. 

[h3][b]3. Are there any plans to run events that allow us to earn extra Gold or maybe reduce Adventure Shoes consumption?[/b][/h3]

It seems that as we continue on our quest to update the game, we might have fallen into a routine with the event planning.

Rest assured that as with other aspects of the game, we plan to take a closer look at which resources our Masters of the Book need the most and incorporate them into our event planning discussions, with the request for more ways to earn Gold and reduced Adventurer’s Shoe consumption high on our list.

[h3][b]4. Are there any plans to adjust the rewards for the Daily Attendance Event? It seems like it’s based on very old standards, and the game’s changed a lot since then.[/b][/h3]

We would like to inform our Masters of the Book that an update to the reward structure for the Daily Attendance Event is currently being reviewed.

With the addition of new content to the game, we understand that the needs of players for various resources have increased and we plan to take this into account when conducting the review.

We’ll be sharing more information about this in the foreseeable future. 

[h3][b]5. Where can we find information on individual Knight skills and damage calculations? For example, I’m not sure whether the Additional DMG effect for Aslan’s skill is affected by Critical Chance or Crit DMG,
and I’d also like to know if DoT is unaffected by Elemental Damage. I’d like to understand the exact mechanics.[/b][/h3]

First, we would like to apologize for not being able to provide accurate information regarding damage calculations. There’s a couple of exceptions related to the damage calculation that makes it hard to display the calculation directly in-game. Rest assured that we will be updating and displaying the relevant information for this and other relevant calculation formulas on our official platforms.

As for the Additional DMG mechanic in use by Knights such as Ellen Farrell, Aslan, Amor and Dorothea among others, they are NOT affected by Crit DMG and Crit Chance. This was intentionally designed so as to not make the mechanic too overpowered.

Additionally, DoT effects are NOT influenced by Elemental Damage modifiers – they are only affected by their respective status effects (Bleed, Poison, Shock, Burn etc.)

Again, we would like to apologize for any confusion caused and hope that we are able to explain it properly to all of our Masters of the Book.

[h3][b]6. Can you guys stick to the roadmap or just release it in time? It’s a bit disappointing when you release a roadmap and then have it be changed. [/b][/h3]

Rest assured that with the recent roadmap released, we are planning to deliver all of the content therein punctually and that any changes to the release schedule or content will be announced more promptly.

We will do our best to meet the expectations of our Masters of the Book.

[b]※ The information stated was provided to help our Masters of the Book understand our upcoming content schedule. More precise details will be given regarding content names and specifics through the patch notes.[/b]

Thank You.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/f1031f68933c0b5d5bfdfa8ab570f5203689cd48.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on April 24, 2025!
 
Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ A new 5★ Knight of Veda, Dorothea, ascends the ranks.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/401cd9de25a80cc506cb859670869138ca22b3c9.png[/img]

[h3][i][b]“Fighting isn't just about strength. Always use your brain!!”[/b][/i][/h3]

[h3][b]Captain of the 1st Division of the 4th Legion of the Titans Army. She may have once been the weakest cadet in the army, but she killed the captain and took his place. There were rumors that she had returned from the brink of death like a ghost, but her perfect smile was enough to silence them all, hiding the truth deep within.[/b][/h3]


* [Dorothea] is a Fire-type Ranged DPS with a long gun (Large Bow) that inflicts [Mark] on enemies she hits. When she hits an enemy with [Mark], she removes the enemy's [Mark] and accumulates [Heat] for herself. When her accumulated [Heat] reaches max, she will enter the [Overheated] state and use a devastating explosive attack to destroy enemies. Her Normal Skill [Bombardment Support] calls for bombardment support to a specific location, dealing DMG to enemies in range and granting [Mark] while her Signature Skill [Scorching Blast] unleashes a scorching bomb on enemies, dealing massive DMG and creating a [Terrible Fire Zone] in the area where the bomb lands. Enemies in the fire zone take Fire DMG and gain [Enhanced Mark]. [Enhanced Mark] is not removed even when enemies are hit, allowing her to continuously build up [Heat].

- “Dorothea” alongside her Signature Weapon “Gemini” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature Halo “Burning Halo” and her Signature El Cid “Facade of Serenity” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.
- Check out Dorothea and her abilities all the while earning rewards in the “Journey in Memory” event.
- To celebrate her addition to the game, the “Fateful Encounter” login event will offer a set of valuable rewards, including Radiance and Mystical Chromatics.

[h3][b]■ 5★ Knight of Veda Amor returns, overflowing with love.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/5a37217b620aa6e816aa7c345c0bbccd961f1173.png[/img]

* The devoted secretary and former captain of the Duke of Koren’s family escort, Amor makes her return!
- "Amor" converts a portion of her Max HP into ATK and DEF and uses the "Thunderbolt's Protection" effect to distribute a portion of the Incoming DMG over a set period of time.
- “Amor” alongside her Signature Weapon “Record of Thunderbolts” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature Halo “Pure Love” and her Signature El Cid “Eternal Promise” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.

[h3][b]■ A better Battlefield of the War Gods comes to you during this season![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/256c9cd9b18977b1b85070865e623bd8df172896.png[/img]
- More abundant rewards await you on the upcoming Battlefield of the War Gods season, with the daily Radiance rewards you get from your rank being significantly increased!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/4c8060fb1f22fcae47b51a2e4cca6dfa729edffa.png[/img]
- To encourage party diversity and for other Knights of Veda to also have their time in the limelight, party formation rules for Battlefield of the War Gods have been adjusted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9a10211d1e3a4f869d5e310e4e17036f816b1caf.png[/img]

- A total of four (4) Knights, chosen at random, will be restricted each season. These Knights can be easily identified on the party formation screen and on icons displayed at the bottom.
- If any restricted Knights of Veda are in either your Attack or Defense Party, you’ll need to remove them in order to proceed.
- A new “War Gods Pass” will now also be available starting May 01. You can access it via the top-left button on the Battlefield of the War Gods menu. Please note that the missions and rewards from the pass will reset every 1st day of the month.

[h3][b]■ It’s not just War Gods, Nightmare of the Abyss also gets its own revamp![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/ed0bdc188b8f40b0530210675a620dfc511eaa05.png[/img]
- A button to easily switch between Veda’s Nightmare and Nightmare of the Abyss has been added.
- You will now also be able to freely select which Nightmare of the Abyss stage you want to challenge– no more waiting for the right one to appear!
- Abyssal Levels will adjust dynamically based on your performance and will be applied across all Nightmare of the Abyss stages.
- A new “Abyss Pass” will now also be available starting May 01. You can access it via the top-left button on the Nightmare of the Abyss menu. Please note that the missions and rewards from the pass will reset every 1st day of the month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/57d953c9cc0a1af606918c555d0881ff936189c5.png[/img]
- The “Repeat” feature will now also be available on Nightmare of the Abyss for your convenience. The Abyssal Level used will now also be adjusted based on the results of the previous battle.

[h3][b]■ Ascend to new heights! Halo and El Cid can now be Refined up to Level 7![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/c4dfa61b3c642cef7b6001ba9852b1ff8ea08805.png[/img]
- Halo and El Cid can now reach up to Refinement Level 7, making them more powerful. Nothing changes as to how you refine them, obtain another copy of the Halo or El Cid and you can now refine it to a higher level.

[h3][b]■ Balance[/b][/h3]
* The effects of the Relics [Forgotten Underground Monster] and [Lady of the Ancient Golden Age] will be adjusted.
- The 4-Set Effects for the aforementioned Relics at Legendary and Mythic Grade will be adjusted:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/1c6d1e8b62b6b24d7c37ab8f393047db98bb8eb3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/bb6976e65dfc3a7764a0e4bad621a3bc98964648.png[/img]

* Adjustments will be made to “Shadow Waters” and “Ancient Giant”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/28dae16677176301d9f53d46369b7ad239160400.png[/img]
- Both Shadow Waters and Ancient Giant are content designed to be challenged with the recommended Knights of Veda for each dungeon.
- Accordingly, we’ve made adjustments that will emphasize this design target.
- Bosses in Shadow Waters and Ancient Giant that are in a Groggy state will now take reduced damage from non-recommended Knights while taking increased damage from Recommended Knights.
- We’re still keeping an eye on your feedback for further adjustments so keep them coming Masters of the Book!

* The formula for ATK SPD Bonus calculation will be adjusted.
- Previously, only the highest value among all the active ATK SPD buffs will be applied. That means even when multiple sources of this buff are present– such as those from Halo, El Cid, Skills etc– only the highest value will be applied.
- To improve this, we’ve made a change where all ATK SPD buffs will now stack together, including those applied by equipment effects. However, a cap set to 90% of the base ATK SPD will be introduced, with diminishing returns on efficiency as you near the maximum.

[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]
* Enhance both your Knights of Veda and their Equipment in one go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2f38ebaa689824594eb6af52ef72000e80dcd65f.png[/img]
- A “Batch Enhance” button has been added when selecting the “Level Up” tab for your Knights of Veda.
- The same button has also been added for enhancing equipment (Weapons, Relics, Tunics, Halo, El Cid, Goddess Armor etc.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/7ff6abb5af1ea0253efd2332cc478428339fff2a.png[/img]
- Using this feature, you can now level up all at once to the highest possible level using all your available enhancement and ascension materials.
- Use the [+] and [-] to specify the level you wish to enhance to.

* Improvements to Halo, El Cid, and Weapon of Genesis summoning will be made.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/1386d272edf30f988f525bde9dbfd70c1935894a.png[/img]
- A new “Guaranteed Pull” button will be added to the “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty,” “Fragments of the Painting,” and the “ Furnace of Genesis” Summon screens.
- When you select the “Guaranteed Pull” button, you will continue to summon until you obtain the chosen Knight’s Signature equipment or until your available resources have been depleted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/587fccfb1571de485b62c3ccb5fd4aa016f75b1e.png[/img]
- For Weapon of Genesis, you will now also be able to summon until the selected Weapon of Genesis type is received.
- The “Skip Effects” option will now also skip the animations for when “Transcendent Revelations” is active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/df3bb007824e9566f0e829d035fc6ee9911fe5d3.png[/img]

* Improvements to the “Failed” screen will be made.
- Information on possible avenues for growth and enhancement to be able to successfully finish the Adventure Stage will now be visible on the Failed screen, with the buttons now guiding users to the respective feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/6a9e657bb81c5b7462647cb175fbd64782ccd3ca.png[/img]

* More granular Relic Synthesis will be added in this update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2c17e6f07fac63694326e2d9685f9f88e35c592e.png[/img]
- You will now be able to select a Main Stat in addition to up to two (2) sub-stats for your Relic.
- Main Stat selection will still need “Fixed Time Fragment” as before while for Sub-stats, you will be needing “Distorted Time Fragment” for the synthesizing process. The amount of “Distorted Time Fragment” consumed will vary based on how many sub-stats are selected.
- “Distorted Time Fragment” can be purchased in the Support Store and can also be earned as future event rewards or through other methods.

* It is now possible to have the same Main and Sub-stats on your relics when synthesizing them!
- Even without selecting it specifically, there is now a chance for both your main and sub-stats to be of the same stat.
- This works even for the Knight’s Memories and Core Beliefs Relic Types.

* The HP of the Guardian Stones you must protect in “Celestial Trials” will be increased.
- Starting from Floor 21 and above, the HP of the Guardian Stones have been increased by 60%.

* The number of Shoes consumed in Ancient Golden City has been adjusted.
 - We’ve heard your feedback regarding the amount of Shoes needed for some of the game’s content, we plan to address this issue step-by-step, starting with Ancient Golden City. We’ll continue to monitor your feedback so please let us know!
 - Shoe cost will now be at 20 Adventurer’s Shoes, previously it was 80 Shoes.

[h3][b]■ Events and Seasonal Content[/b][/h3]
* To celebrate this warm May, a couple of special events will be held.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0c594ff1374e3752a3cfcc675611b8660852ac4f.png[/img]
- “Warm May!” Attendance Rewards Event
  - Log-in daily to receive rewards such as Starstones, Crystal of Fates and Crystal of Destiny!
  - “Warm May! Attendance Rewards” event will run from after the 04/24 Maintenance to before the 05/29 Maintenance.

- “Adventure with Luck” Event
  - Complete missions during the event period to earn rewards such as a 4★ Knights of Veda, Radiance, Goddess’s Armor Enhancement Materials and more.
  - The “Adventure with Luck” Event will run from after the 04/24 Maintenance to before the 05/29 Maintenance.

* Transport Mania! The “Apparition Rush” and “Special Supply Delivery Operation” events will be returning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d6240e4e5cd5ddbfd674efea75f187dc52b40e06.png[/img]
- Each stage consists of one (1) round, and you will receive rewards upon completing the transport.
  - The “Apparition Rush” event will run from after the 04/24 Maintenance until 05/15 03:00 AM UTC / 05/14 08:00 PM PDT.
  - The “Special Supply Delivery Operation” event will run from 05/15 06:00 AM UTC / 05/14 11:00 PM PDT until before the 05/29 Maintenance.
- For your convenience, you will now be able to claim all available rewards with one button!
- A new “Apparition Pass” and “Special Delivery Pass” will now be available during their respective event’s run.
- Purchase the Goddess’s Reward Decree for either pass and you will be able to obtain “Scroll of All Things,” which allows you to obtain a Legendary-grade Enchant Scroll of your choosing.

* The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will reward you for helping Harold with research materials.
- Collect materials Harold requires to write his research log from the Adventure Zone stages and submit them to him in Todburg to receive rewards.
- The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will be unlocked progressively, with one log entry opening each day, and you can check your progress in the Research Log.
- The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will run from 03/13 06:00 AM UTC / 03/12 11:00 PM PDT until before the 05/29 Maintenance.

* A new “The Fruits of Adventure” Daily Attendance event is upon us!
- Receive various rewards depending on the number of days you logged in.
- “The Fruits of Adventure” event will run from 05/01 06:00 AM UTC / 04/30 11:00 PM PDT to 06/01 06:00 AM UTC / 05/31 11:00 PM PDT.

* The "Blessing in Adventure" event is back to shower everyone with more rewards!
- During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Dungeons up to the daily limit.
- The double rewards event for Adventure Dungeons will run from 04/24 after maintenance until 05/15 03:00 AM UTC / 05/14 08:00 PM PDT.

* Veda’s Nightmare deepens as the rewards for braving its halls increase, the “Blessing in Nightmare” event returns!
- During the "Blessing in the Nightmare" event, you can earn double rewards from “Veda's Nightmare” and on “Nightmare of the Abyss” up to the daily limit. 
- The "Blessing in the Nightmare" event starts on 05/15 6:00 AM UTC / 05/14 11:00 PM PDT and will end before the regular maintenance on 05/29.

* A new Reward Decree season will start.
- The new Reward Decree season will begin on 05/01 06:00 AM UTC / 04/30 11:00 PM PDT, and will run until 06/01 06:00 AM UTC / 05/31 10:00 PM PDT

* A new season of Arena will begin.
- During this Arena Season, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.
- This Arena Season will end before the regular maintenance on 05/29.

* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.
 - After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
 - The new Portrait of Thierry season will end before the regular maintenance on 05/29.

* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.
- The “Swamp King Monster“ wades its way into this new Beast Battlefront season as the featured boss!
- "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
  - 1st Round: 04/24 to 05/06 / Settlement: 05/06 to 05/08 
  - 2nd Round: 05/15 to 05/27 / Settlement: 05/27 to 05/29

[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
* An issue where after leaving a Guild and joining a new one, the previous Guild’s information was displayed on the Ancient Giant leaderboard will be fixed.
* An issue where when leveling up a Knight or Equipment in the Book screen, the excess EXP from the process is displayed in the UI as 0 will be fixed.
* An issue where after changing your display language while in Todburg, guild names from other accounts will be incorrectly displayed will be fixed.
* An issue where Knights with no Wounds still appear on the Battle Return list will be fixed.
* An issue where if all previously used Enchant Scrolls were consumed, a different scroll would be automatically selected will be fixed.
* An issue where Liam’s Fate 7 effect, which should allow “Curse of the Black Wolf” to stack up to two (2) times only, shows it to be stacking up to four (4) on enemy debuff icons will be fixed.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Team’s Responses to Your 03/27 Update Comments and Questions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

This is Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda. The development team is here to answer the feedback and questions you, our Masters of the Book, have shared.

[h3][b]1. White Hell’s final in-game design and illustration seem quite different from other Knights of Veda, is there a reason for this? [/b][/h3]

The game character illustrations for the Knights of Veda are all handled internally by the development team, however, summoning illustrations are handled by a different entity due to scheduling reasons and thus there may be slight stylistic differences. 

Since ASTRA: Knights of Veda has a distinct identity art-style and mood wise, we strive to ensure stylistic consistency with our art through a review process.

We acknowledge however that we should have paid more attention to our First Anniversary Knight, White Hell. We sincerely apologize for this and will improve our quality control going forward.

[h3][b]2. Clearing Mythic Promotion missions is inconvenient due to Sweeping not counting for event progress in addition to some content having entry restrictions. Are there any plans to make improvements to ease this?[/b][/h3]

We have received feedback related to this, a very specific pain point is on missions related to Portrait of Thierry. 

To address this, we plan to introduce an option to play from Floor 36 in addition to a full sweep feature.

We sincerely apologize for implementing updates without thorough review, and we will continue improving these aspects of the game.

[h3][b]3. Will all Legendary (5★) weapons, aside from the Exclusive Weapons, be upgraded to Mythic (6★)?[/b][/h3]

Due to an increase in the gap between each weapon’s performance, we are planning to introduce Mythic Promotion for all weapons, not just the exclusive ones. We are planning to introduce this update in May, with more details to be announced through the Update Roadmap.

[h3][b]4. Radiance as a currency is too scarce, are there any plans to introduce more ways to obtain them?[/b][/h3]

We plan to increase Radiance rewards during the Battlefield of the War Gods refresh planned for April.

More details will be provided, specifically related to the ways Radiance is obtained,  through the Update Roadmap.

[h3][b]5. The Knight’s Robes introduced in this update has been underwhelming so far. Can you give us hints on what will be the next ones?[/b][/h3]

We plan to introduce a specific theme of Knight’s Robes around June~July, specifically focused on swimwear. We hope this will be of interest to all our Masters of the Book.

More details will be provided, maybe even a sneak peek of the actual design, through the Update Roadmap.

[h3][b]6. We expected a new Adventure Zone and Story for the 1st Anniversary, if not on this update, when will they be released?[/b][/h3]

We are currently modifying our internal processes to make sure we have constant and high quality story updates for everyone. We sincerely apologize if our content release schedule did not meet the Masters of the Book’s expectations.

We can announce however that the next story update alongside new Adventure Zones will be introduced on the July Summer Update.

Similarly with the other announced content, we will be releasing more information about this on the Update Roadmap for April to August 2025, which we plan to release soon.


We will do our best to meet the expectations of our Masters of the Book.

[b]※ The information stated was provided to help our Masters of the Book understand our upcoming content schedule. More precise details will be given regarding content names and specifics through the patch notes.[/b]

Thank You.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/20893a9cff925122e63a8244eca7af189d08edc6.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on March 27, 2025!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ Death is her new beginning, the new 5★ Knight of Veda “White Hell” rises[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/fdc9f8cc0bdd63748311837c03ada7bf2914645d.png[/img]
[h3][i][b]"Death is the perfect beginning"
 
From a tiny being that was dependent on the Goddess, she has been reborn to begin a new phase of her life. Overcoming her fear of ceasing to exist and gaining the power of transcendent beings, Belle Snow was reborn as “White Hell.” Now that she understands the principles of the world, she is about to begin her own story[/b][/i][/h3]


- White Hell uses the power of “Dynamic Punishment” to periodically cause lightning to strike down around her. These lightning bolts become holy torrents, neutralizing some of the target's Electric and Light RES and delivering judgment. Her Normal Skill, “Storm Stigma,” allows her to brandish her staff and shoot a bolt of holy energy, branding the target with “Divine Retribution.” A judgement of lightning and thunder will descend upon the target with “Divine Retribution,” bombarding them with lightning strikes that will eventually incapacitate them. Her Signature Skill, 
Celestial Judgment,” opens the sky and calls forth an atmosphere charged with electricity, raining down countless lightning bolts, each one too much for the target to withstand, finally bringing them to their knees


[b]* Beloved ★5 Knight of Veda, Anais returns to answer your call.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/eb2d59cfc0eb3986f02569b15e3ff048830dc36d.png[/img]
- The beloved “Anais” makes her return to Call of the Stars.
- “Anais” is a Fire-type Ranged Healer wielding a Wand & Orb. Anais is a healer who sacrifices a portion of her HP to boost ATK while simultaneously reviving vulnerable allies during her attacks.
 
[b]* Rise to new heights by promoting your Legendary (5★) Knights of Veda and Weapons to Mythic (6★)![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/19c5daaf933a2a2610f22c4f5abb85c5b594e0a5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2ffa2e183dfca0cadd9ccb7e57f774d07289d675.png[/img]
- “Mythic Promotion” allows Legendary (5★) Knights of Veda or Weapons to be upgraded to Mythic tier by clearing missions specific to each Knight and Weapon.
- Promoting your Knights and Weapons to Mythic will have their basic stats increase in addition to obtaining Mythic Skills.
- Mythic Promotion increases the potency of each character by giving them “Mythic Skills” that lean more into their individual strengths.
- Among the Knights eligible, the Mythic Promotion for the Knight of Veda “Eliyar” will be added in a future update. (Updated on 03/27 03:00 AM UTC / 03/26 08:00 PM PDT)
 
[b]* Deck your Knights of Veda out with a new look. Introducing “Knight’s Robe.”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/7edc38844b51bf58af3fa659a019b763d9936ffe.png[/img]
- Give your Knights of Veda a new look with the new “Knight’s Robe” feature!
- The first Knight to get an additional look will be the newly introduced “White Hell,” with more Knight’s Robe to be introduced in future updates.

[b]* Challenge the new “Snow White’s Frosty Dream” content and obtain the new Knight “White Hell!”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0cf915cbb98ba7fe3c88f1ea344e2748e3966c9f.png[/img]
- Her heartfelt wish has finally come true: White Hell awakens from the "White Hell" to find her new self. Join White Hell on her journey of inner exploration amidst the fluttering white snow on “Snow White’s Frosty Dream.”
- Clear “Snow White's Frosty Dream” with various trial Knights of Veda to obtain “White Hell.” You can then replay it and earn various materials and strengthen “White Hell.”
- Clearing the Story Mode will allow you to conduct “Challenge Missions” which have a higher difficulty level. On these missions, White Hell appears as a companion who can help you.
- The initial clear of Story Mode will reward you with “White Hell,” along with enough enhancement materials to level her up to Level 90.

[b]* Challenge the wrath of the awakened giant with your Guild Members on the new “Ancient Giant” content.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/468d3147dcf9190d36d14edc3a055071317b0c8f.png[/img]
- After the Great Battle in ancient times, the Ancient Giant went into a deep slumber. Now they’re awake and wreaking havoc.
- "Ancient Giant” is a content available on Saturdays and Sundays, where your goal is to work with your guild members to inflict as much damage as possible on “Ira the Giant,” whose attribute changes weekly.
- Earn points based on damage dealt to Ira, and compete with other guilds for the “Daily Score” and “Weekly Score” rankings. Bonus points will be granted by using Knights with certain roles or attributes.
- Rankings include “Guild Rankings,” “Guild Member Rankings,” and “Individual Rankings.” Rewards will be determined, which include Starstones and Guild Medals, based on the final “Guild Ranking” every Sunday.
- Since this content is Guild-based, we encourage everyone who hasn’t joined one yet to do so!

[b]* Shiny, lustrous, Mythic Gems with two different stats are coming to the game![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/82d1dfa683252e39785e6a6049918a568c10d65e.png[/img]
- To craft Mythic Gems, you'll need Legendary (★5) Gems of the same type and “Crests of Stars" as materials. The new “Crests of Stars” can be obtained as rewards for clearing the Nightmare of the Abyss on Abyssal Levels 10 and up.
- When crafting Mythic Gems, you can select four possible stats, two of which will then be chosen to be assigned to the crafted gem. This is unlike Legendary Gems who only have one stat.

[b]* Signature Halos and El Cid will now be available for all the Standard 5★ Knights of Veda![/b]
- Just like the Pickup 5★ Knights, the Standard 5★ Knights of Veda will now also have their own Signature Halo and El Cid. You can obtain them from the usual place, at the Guidance of the Book under “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” for Halos and “Fragments of the Painting” for El Cid.

[b]* You can now select between “Old” and “New” options for all 5★ Shared Weapons[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d20b56bb23815c8810750a6b670f8c501805ebed.png[/img]
- 5★ Shared Weapons will now have new options! These new options will have different stats and skills from the old weapon. This is to allow these weapons to shine and still be viable in light of increasing competition from other weapons, especially the Exclusive and Promoted Weapons.
- Since some Masters of the Book may prefer the old version of these weapons, we have added the option to select from either of the New or Old options per copy of the weapon. This change is permanent and cannot be changed.

[b]* Enjoy a free summon every day! A free summon will now be available everyday for the Fallen Wings of Veda Call of the Stars.[/b]
- From now on, you will be able to perform the Call of the Stars once a day for free in the “Fallen Wing of Veda”
- Free Calls of the Stars will also allow you to accumulate Grace of the Holy Grail points


[h3][b]■ Event and Season content[/b][/h3]
[b]* A total of 365 summons can be obtained during Veda's 1st Anniversary Starlit Carnival event.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/082a919ada7dfb1ac8099d63495455e3f4058736.png[/img]

[b]*  It’s Veda's 1st Anniversary Starlit Carnival! Join us as we celebrate the game’s first anniversary with a variety of fun events teeming with rewards![/b]
- “A year of wonderful moments! Let’s continue our journey every day!” event is where you can receive rewards just by logging in daily.
 - Receive Crystal of Destiny every day to summon more Knights of Veda or Weapons.
 - Log-in for fourteen (14) days during the event period and receive the “The Great Belle” Mascot as your final reward. It’s been rumored that she was created by White Hell herself, so please don’t make her wait too long!
 - The “A year of wonderful moments! Let’s continue our journey every day!” event will run from after the 03/27 Maintenance until before the 04/24 Maintenance.
- “Beyond a year's journey, let the new challenges begin!” event is where various challenges can be completed to receive rewards!
 - Complete missions during the event period to receive various rewards, including the Pristine Wing cosmetic “Wings of Blessing Mark.”
 - The “Beyond a year's journey, let the new challenges begin!” will run from after the 03/27 Maintenance until before the 04/24 Maintenance.
- What’s a festival without a delicious cake? The “Honk! Happy 1st Anniversary Party” event allows you to obtain cakes for our celebration!
 - Obtain the “1st Anniversary Cake" dish on Adventure Stages during the “Honk! Happy 1st Anniversary Party” event and earn rewards based on how many you have.
 - You will be able to obtain twenty (20) “1st Anniversary Cake" per day.
 - The “1st Anniversary Cake" can also be used to enhance the abilities of your Knights of Veda.
 - Additional rewards based on the number of “1st Anniversary Cake" can be redeemed on the event’s Guidance of the Book entry, with the final reward being a new “Mark of Sanctity” cosmetic, “Starlight Festival Mark.”
 - The “Honk! Happy 1st Anniversary Party” event will run from after the 03/27 Maintenance until before the 04/24 Maintenance.

[b]* Join the ‘Simon’s Amazing Gifts’ event! Work together with your Guild members to defeat treasure chests and claim exciting rewards.[/b]
- The “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” event can be participated in every Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at 08:00 PM during the event period, at the Guild Territory.
- Various rewards can be obtained from this event, and for this current iteration: the new mascot “Baby Yor” can be earned.
- “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” will run from April 03, 2025 until April 20, 2025.

[b]* The “Distorted Rift” appears once again on Todburg and will run from after the 03/27 Maintenance until before the 04/10 Maintenance.[/b]

[b]* The "Special Supply Delivery Operation" event will be held once again.[/b]
- Each stage will consist of one (1) round, successfully completing the supply transport will net you various rewards.
- The "Special Supply Delivery Operation" event will begin on April 10, 2025 and will run until before the 04/24 Maintenance.

[b]* A Double Rewards event for Adventure Zone rewards will be held.[/b]
- During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Zone up to the daily limit.
- The double rewards event for Adventure Zones will run from after the 03/27 Maintenance until before the 04/10 Maintenance.

[b]* Veda’s Nightmare deepens as the rewards for braving its halls increase, the “Blessing in Nightmare” event returns![/b]
- During the "Blessing in the Nightmare" event, you can earn double rewards from Veda's Nightmare and Nightmare of the Abyss up to the daily limit. 
- The "Blessing in the Nightmare" event will begin on April 10, 2025 and will run until before the 04/24 Maintenance.

[b]* A new Reward Decree season will start.[/b]
- The new Reward Decree season will begin on April 01, 2025 and will end on April 30, 2025.
- For this season, some missions will be changed and rewards increased following your feedback.

[b]* A new season of Arena will begin.[/b]
- During the new Arena season, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.
- The “Tunic of White” will now be available for purchase in the Arena Shop.
- The Arena Season will end before the regular maintenance on 04/24.

[b]* A new season of Nightmare of the Abyss will be starting.[/b]
- With the new season, a new set of Abyss Trials will be applied to each stage.
 - The new Nightmare of the Abyss season will end before the regular maintenance on 04/24.

[b]* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.[/b]
 - After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
 - The new Portrait of Thierry season will end before the regular maintenance on 04/24.

[b]* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.[/b]
- “White Hell, Lord of the Sky” is this season’s Beast Battlefront boss!
- "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
  - 1st Round: 03/27 to 04/08 / Settlement: 04/08 to 04/10 
  - 2nd Round: 04/10 to 04/22 / Settlement: 02/22 to 04/24

[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]
[b]* Changes to Gem Fuse Probabilities[/b]
　- When fusing Rare (3★) Gems, the probability of obtaining a Heroic (4★) Gem will be increased from 5% → 30%.
　- When fusing Heroic (4★) Gems, the probability of obtaining a Legendary (5★) Gem will be increased from 1% → 30%.

[b]* Changes to the Accessory Information view.[/b]
　- A new visual indicator will now distinguish effect value rarities on Accessories, which will use the ✦icon differentiated just by color instead of a numerical value.
　- The effect value rarity colors will range from [i][b]High (★5) - Legendary[/b][/i] / [i][b]Medium (★3) - Rare[/b][/i] /  [i][b]Low (★1) - Normal[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/dd23efd82dec25794db1ab27507e4b3942dbc7d5.png[/img]


[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
* An issue where the total number of unlockable entries in the Collection was incorrectly increasing will be fixed.
* An issue where the Tunic Enhancement effects were being displayed when doing ascension on a Tunic will be fixed.
* An issue where some character animations are displayed incorrectly when selecting the Fate Tab while in the Book menu will be fixed.
* An issue where the notification icon is appearing on some content despite all related rewards already being claimed will be fixed. 
* An issue where the UI is being displayed abnormally when moving to and from Chapter 7 of the Adventure Zone and the Ancient Golden City will be fixed.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.

notes.title: 2/28 Patch Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/897b7cf5f670eae4058355ede9dbe1392699f55f.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book,

A patch was released on 02/28 that will address some issues. In order for the patch to be downloaded and applied to your game, please make sure to restart the game.

[h3][b]■ Unscheduled Patch Announcement[/b][/h3]
* Date: 02/28 06:43 AM UTC, 02/27 10:43 PM PST
* Patch Details
 - An issue where the game became unplayable after checking detailed item information on the Dungeon Auto-Progress Results screen was fixed.
 - An issue where text overlapped in the Call of the Stars menu at certain resolutions was fixed..
 - An issue where trophies were not obtained on certain stages when using the Dungeon Auto-Progress feature was fixed.
 - An issue where the Double Reward count for Blessing in Adventure was sometimes not deducted when using the Repeat feature on an Adventure Stage was fixed.
 - An issue where the game froze when interacting with the Veda’s Return statue multiple times after a battle when either Repeat or Dungeon Auto-Progress was active was fixed.
 - An issue where the damage displayed for arrows was incorrect when she is under the “Reindeer Strong Bow” effect applied under her Fate Level 7 effect will be fixed.
 - An issue where some of the mission text under the “Unforgettable Moments” event did not match the actual mission was fixed.
 - An issue where missions related to Shadow Waters under the “Unforgettable Moments” event did not display correctly on certain languages was fixed.

[h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3]
* If your game is not updated, content that requires other players (Co-Op, Arena) may be problematic. Please make sure to restart the game to download the patch before engaging in these contents.

Thank You.
