notes.title: 02/27 Patch Details
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/20893a9cff925122e63a8244eca7af189d08edc6.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on February 27, 2025!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ A Silent Shadow, the new 5★ Knight of Veda “Asha”, answers the Call of the Stars [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/47c093b0a21baebdfdc70e9aa7d6ddc1e049d751.png[/img]

[h3][b][i]"I’ll make an oath that not even fate can break."[/i]

The leader of the Shadows of Dark Nights, a group of five Enchanted Warriors who vanished into thin air. This leader’s true identity is the last escort guard of the “Oirat,” the kingdom defeated by the Empire in the “War of Five Kingdoms.” Asha,  a guard who resembles an eerie, silent abyss, fights to return the amnesiac princess to her homeland.[/b][/h3]

* Asha grants and stacks “Sea Shard” with every hit on an enemy. When “Sea Shard” reaches a certain number of stacks, they create a “Sea Maelstrom”, drawing enemies in the area to the center and dealing heavy DMG. Asha's Normal Skill, “Striking Waves,” allows Asha to strike with two swords in quick succession, followed by a “Shadow Wave” effect, dealing more DMG to enemies while reducing DMG taken. Asha's Signature Skill, “Blue Dragon Swim,” uses two swords to strike in quick succession before unleashing a rain of arrows downward. While doing so, Asha gains the “Darkness Tide” effect. While it lasts, “Sea Shard” stacks double to devastate enemies with more “Sea Maelstrom.”


[b]* The 5★ Knight of Veda “Aslan” returns to exact retribution[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/238ce1cbf4029950474583e425c1a0ff377bb91c.png[/img]
- The highly requested “Aslan” is making his triumphant return!
- “Aslan” is an Earth-type Melee DPS who uses a Sword & Shield. He converts his Stamina into Skill DMG to deal powerful DMG and uses his skills to take the initiative in battle.
- Through this ★5 Pickup Hero Event, you are guaranteed to obtain the Knight of Veda Aslan! 

[b]* The Standard ★5 Knights get more love, more power![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/724418d003590677a4a1b8e242bea2b1ee55a3bb.png[/img]
- The Standard 5★ Knights will be adjusted to make them perform better on the battlefield!
- Here’s a summary of the incoming improvements to each Knight:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/c817f3c45bad062e5f1983478f33dc59fd68013c.png[/img]

[b]* Guarding you through the Abyss, are these Magical Glyphs! Introducing the “Magical Glyph” system.[/b]
- The “Armor” you found in the depths of the Abyss has an undiscovered power. You can unlock this hidden power with the “Magic Glyph”
- "Magic Glyphs" can be inscribed on the Goddess's Armor with powerful effects. Unique effects are available for each position's armor, and the effect is granted randomly
- “Armor Crest,” the material for the Magic Glyphs, can be obtained as a clear reward from Nightmare of the Abyss Level 10 and higher.

[b]* The Nightmare grows ever deeper into the depths of the Abyss, with the highest Abyssal Level now being 25![/b]
- As the Nightmare seeps into the very depths of the Abyss, more levels become available for the intrepid Master of the Book.
- More powerful enemies await you on the expanded levels, alongside even greater rewards!

[b]* Numbers? More Numbers! “DMG Totals” fresh off the press for people who like numbers![/b]
- With the new DMG Totals screen, you will now be able to accurately check the battle contribution of each Knight to help form strategies when making parties.
- You will now be able to check “DMG Dealt”, “DMG Taken” and “Healed” for each Knight of Veda.
- The DMG Totals screen will be available in the following content:
  - Adventure Zone Stages / Veda’s Nightmare / Nightmare of the Abyss / Ancient Golden City / Arena (Showdown or Survival) / Battlefield of the War Gods / Beast Battlefront / Shadow Waters / Celestial Trials / Calydon Hideout / Forgotten Mine / Special Supply Delivery / Portrait of Thierry
- In PvP content, you will also be able to view the statistics of your opponent.

[b]* “Dungeon Auto-Play” will be automatically going into your game with this update![/b]
- To make your journey more convenient, “Dungeon Auto-Play” will now be available.
- Dungeon Auto-Battle
  - Adventure Zones will now have an “Auto Battle” feature that will automatically play to advance to the final stage of the zone
  - Dungeon Auto-Battle will be available only in Chapters where the final Stage has been cleared.
- Repeat
  - The “Repeat” feature allows you to repeat any dungeon play in the Adventure Zone, Sealed Prison, or Veda's Nightmare. Set the number of repeats you want, then relax and start earning rewards!
  - You are able to specify up to 50 repetitions.

[b]* A new “Upgrade All for skills” feature will now be available for your convenience.[/b]
- Use as many enhancement materials as you have to upgrade all of a Knights’ skills at once!
- You can also now select a target level you wish to upgrade your Skills to.
- If your Enhancement Materials are insufficient, it will be displayed in red, making it easier to keep track of what you're running low on!

[b]* Passive Skill Display will now be actively displayed after this update![/b]
- Knights of Veda with Passive Skills will now have an additional “Passive” tab on their Skill information window, allowing our Masters of the Book to view the information clearly.

[b]* Inconvenient Relic Enhancement will now be a relic of the past! Improvements to the feature coming in this update~[/b]
- Relic Levels can now conveniently be upgraded in steps of 3/4/8/12/16/20:
· Level 3 Unlock two (2) new sub-stats.
· On Levels 4/8/12/16/20, a random sub-stat will be selected to be enhanced.
· This feature aims to help players optimize the use of their materials.
- Additionally, you can select either to use only Enhancement Materials or include Relics themselves as Enhancement Resources.

[b]* Improvements to the “Bloom” system will be blooming with this update.[/b]
- When attempting to Bloom, the list of possible sub-stats will be displayed in advance.
- You can now also exclude up to two (2) sub-stats before the process begins.

[b]* Improvements to the “Auto-Equip Relic” will be introduced.[/b]
- The feature will now also take advantage of the “Recommended Relics” feature, with them being prioritized to ensure better results.
- If multiple Recommended Relics exist, the top-listed one will be prioritized.

[b]* The “Treasure Keeper” Mascot, now available in the Guild Shop![/b]
- Previously only obtainable on “Simon’s Amazing Gifts,” this adorable little monstrosity will now be available for purchase at the Guild Shop from 02/27 06:00 AM UTC / 02/26 10:00 PM PST until the April 24 maintenance.

[b]* Enhanced Notifications for content that reset.[/b]
- Some content is reset periodically but lacks clear notifications, making it difficult for players to notice. These changes are meant to make them easily noticeable by the Masters of the Book:
- For Beast Battlefront and Shadow Waters, notifications will now be displayed daily upon reset.
- For Portrait of Thierry and Ancient Golden City, notifications will now be displayed weekly upon the reset every Thursday.

[h3][b]■ Event & Seasonal Content Updates[/b][/h3]
[b]* An improved “Shattered Dimensional Rift” is set to arrive in this update.[/b]
- Bosses from “Ancient Gold City” will now appear instead of the former enemies, allowing for a more focused boss battle.
- Earn points by clearing boss stages – The faster you clear them, the more bonus points you receive.
- Earn Guild Kill rewards and Individual Kill rewards based on the number of bosses defeated with your guild members.
- The “Sweep” function will now also be available for use after your initial clear.
- The "Shattered Dimensional Rift" event will end on 03/20 06:00 AM UTC / 03/19 10:00 PM PDT.

[b]* “Unforgettable Moments” Event[/b]
- Complete various content missions to earn valuable enhancement materials and equipment.
- The "Unforgettable Moments" event will start after the 02/27 Maintenance and will end before the 03/27 Maintenance.

[b]* The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will reward you for helping Harold with research materials.[/b]
- Collect materials Harold requires to write his research log from the Adventure Zone stages and submit them to him in Todburg to receive rewards.
- The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will be unlocked progressively, with one log entry opening each day, and you can check your progress in the Research Log.
- The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will run from 03/13 06:00 AM UTC / 03/12 10:00 PM PDT until before the 03/27 Maintenance.

[b]* Another "Apparition’s Rush" will be held, will you be able to escort a carriage through several nightmares?[/b]
- The "Apparition’s Rush" event is a Squad Battle event tasking you to escort a carriage through a nightmare with four other Knights of Veda in a “Special Supply Delivery Operation”.
- The “Apparition’s Rush” event can be unlocked by completing the “Escort the Carriage” quest that you will receive upon clearing Chapter 5, Stage 4 of the Adventure Zone. You can then access it via the new “Apparition’s Rush” icon at the bottom of the Cloister of the Holy Grail.
- The “Apparition’s Rush” event will run from 03/13 06:00 AM UTC / 03/12 10:00 PM PDT until before the 03/27 Maintenance.
 
[b]* The "Blessing in Adventure" event is back to shower everyone with more rewards![/b]
- During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Dungeons up to the daily limit.
- The double rewards event for Adventure Dungeons will run from 02/27 after maintenance until 03/13 06:00 AM UTC / 03/12 10:00 PM PDT.

[b]* Veda’s Nightmare deepens as the rewards for braving its halls increase, the “Blessing in Nightmare” event returns![/b]
- During the "Blessing in the Nightmare" event, you can earn double rewards from “Veda's Nightmare” and on “Nightmare of the Abyss” up to the daily limit. 
- The "Blessing in the Nightmare" event starts on 03/13 6:00 AM UTC / 03/12 10:00 PM PDT and will end after the regular maintenance on 02/27.

[b]* A new Reward Decree season will start.[/b]
- The new Reward Decree season will begin on 03/01 6:00 AM UTC / 02/28 10:00 PM PDT, and will run until 03/31 06:00 AM UTC / 03/30 10:00 PM PDT

[b]* A new season of Arena will begin.[/b]
- During this Arena Season, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.
- The “Sea King’s Tunic” will continue to be available for purchase until the end of this Arena Season.
- This Arena Season will end before the regular maintenance on 03/27.

[b]* A new season of Nightmare of the Abyss will be starting.[/b]
- With the new season, a new set of Abyss Trials will be applied to each stage.
- The new Nightmare of the Abyss season will end before the regular maintenance on 03/27.

[b]* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.[/b]
 - After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
 - The new Portrait of Thierry season will end before the regular maintenance on 03/27.

[b]* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.[/b]
- “Blazing Rage Bjorn“ from the Ancient Golden City rampages his way into this new Beast Battlefront season as the featured boss!
- "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
  - 1st Round: 02/27 to 03/11 / Settlement: 03/11 to 03/13 
  - 2nd Round: 03/13 to 03/25 / Settlement: 03/25 to 03/27

[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]
[b]* The amount of “Goddess’s Armor Ascension Materials” obtained when clearing Abyssal Level 12 or higher of the Nightmare of the Abyss will be increased.[/b]
- We’ve received multiple feedback regarding the difficulty with enhancing your Goddess’s Armor due to a lack of Ascension Materials.
- With this change, at Level 12, your chance to obtain Goddess’s Armor Ascension Materials will be increased by 2%. As the Abyssal Level increases, the increase will gradually increase, reaching to an increase of 60% at Abyssal Level 20.

[b]* Compensation for Masters of the Book with uncompleted missions on their expired Goddess’s Reward Decree for the Nightmare of the Abyss Content Pass.[/b]
- The information on the handling of the Content Pass upon its expiration was deemed insufficient, and so we have decided to take the following measures.
- For Masters of the Book who purchased the Goddess's Reward Decree for the Nightmare of the Abyss Content Pass and whose pass expires before the 03/27 maintenance, rewards for uncompleted missions will be distributed via in-game mail during the maintenance.
- The distribution of rewards will take place in two phases depending on the pass expiration date:
　- Users whose pass expired before the 02/27 maintenance will receive their rewards during the said maintenance.
　- Users whose pass expires after the 02/27 maintenance but before the 03/27 maintenance will receive their rewards during the 03/27 maintenance.

[b]* An issue where the shortcut keys for cooking set to Q or E conflicted with the retry or next button in the dungeon result screen will be fixed.[/b]
- The settings have been adjusted so that the shortcut keys for Cooking (X) and Chat (Enter) can no longer be changed in the settings.
- If you have set any custom keybinds for the respective keys, they will be reset to the default after this update.

[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
* An issue where the Skill CDR value for a promoted Yanko was displayed lower than expected in the Skill info window will be fixed.
* An issue where you will be able to retry in Beast Battlefront after challenging it with a 4★ and then promoting it to 5★ will be fixed.
* An issue where the “Grand Rebel Justice Front, March!” Achievement cannot be completed with a Rani, Yanko, or Leon promoted to 5★ will be fixed.
* An issue where Achievements with Stage Clears as the unlock method are not being unlocked when playing via Squad Battles will be fixed.
* An issue where when you summon a Knight of Veda on your wishlist that is on max Fate, the notification warning you of this was not displayed when using Rubies or Starstones as the summon resource will be fixed.
* An issue where the Challenge Record Times for Shadow Waters were displayed in UTC +0 will be fixed. They will now be displayed in each region’s local time.
* An issue where certain Lightning Lump Undead on Adventure Stage 4-3 were not attacking will be fixed.
* An issue where pressing the "Stop" button repeatedly during the Enhancement auto-progress caused the result screen to freeze and not move to the next step will be fixed.
* An issue where the number of shoes restored when refilling with Rubies or Starstones was incorrectly displayed as 1 instead of 60 in the result screen will be fixed. The actual recharge amount was correctly applied at 60, and only the display was incorrect.
* An issue where the “Guidance of the Book” and the “Guidance of the Goddess” screens did not immediately update when a new event started will be fixed..
* An issue where when inside the “Cloister of the Holy Grail,” the “Apparition Rush” button did not update immediately upon event start will be fixed.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Team’s Responses to Your 01/23 Update Comments and Questions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

This is Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda. The development team is here to answer the feedback and questions you, our Masters of the Book, have shared.

[h3][b]1. One of the announced upcoming features is the Mythic Promotion from 5★ to 6★, will the requirements to do so be the same as with those from 4★ to 5★? [/b][/h3]

As we have mentioned, instead of relying on the Call of the Stars feature for Mythic Promotion, our plans have it involve a dedicated quest where you would need to conduct missions on certain content and the collection of quest items from the Abyss.

[h3][b]2. One of the other things mentioned during the broadcast was a “Hero Balance Patch,” would the adjustments be made through Mythic Promotion? Could you share more details about it?[/b][/h3]

Our goal with the adjustments to each Knight’s Mythic Promotion is to not just enhance their base stats but to also strengthen their “uniqueness” within the roster of Knights. 

For example, with a 6★ Xanthia, Boss Monsters will now also be affected by the gravitational pull of her Signature Skill, making her more desirable to use on PvE content like Nightmare of the Abyss.

A couple of Knights underperforming on their respective roles will also be adjusted, alongside the Knights on our Standard 5★ roster, on the 02/27 Update.

[h3][b]3. I missed a couple of Mascots! Will it ever be possible to obtain any of them through reruns or sales?[/b][/h3]

Starting on the 12/27 Update, the Mascot “Treasure Keeper” will be available for purchase in the Guild Shop.

The rest of the Mascots, will be brought back through any of the stores or through in-game events. If you have missed out on any of the Mascots, rest assured that they will be made available again eventually.

[h3][b]4. Although matchmaking has been added to Nightmare of the Abyss, making Co-Op play easier, the content’s actual difficulty remains very high. While this is as expected, the difficulty gap between modes of play shouldn't be significant.[/b][/h3]
 

Nightmare of the Abyss is a content designed for end-game item farming.

From my own experience, I initially struggled at Abyssal Levels 4 and 5 when attempting to play Solo with Aslan, Bikki, Violet, and Anais. However, after a few runs and gradually equipping and upgrading the Goddess Armor I was able to obtain, I was eventually able to clear up to Stage 20. 

However, we understand that Goddess’ Armor, and by extension Nightmare of the Abyss, plays a crucial role in the item progression system of the game. Rest assured that we will seriously discuss any potential adjustments to the contents’ difficulty.

[h3][b]5. Amor has been dominant in PvP since her release – even winning 1v4 battles. As a Tank, she is very durable, but her strength creates an imbalance with other Knights in similar roles. Are there any plans for adjustments?[/b][/h3]

The effects of Amor’s Signature Skill allows her to counter burst damage from her opponents, especially in PvP. However, this advantage wears off when battling with opponents who rely on doing fast, constant, but low damage attacks. Her Signature Skill’s effects also do not apply on DoT Damage.

Since Amor is a newly released Knight, we’re still monitoring her performance on both PvE and PvP and will do adjustments if necessary.

[h3][b]6. Relic Farming is becoming a bit tedious, what with the amount of Relics that needs to be check then manually enhancing them to check their sub-stats. Are there any plans to improve the convenience of Relic Farming?[/b][/h3]

We have been discussing ways to allow users to filter and farm Relic Options/Stats. However, due to the vast variety of sub-stats, slots, and values to consider, finding a solution without any unintended side effects is taking more time than usual.

However, on the 02/27 Update we will introduce a new QoL feature that allows relics to be upgraded through one-click enhancement at each growth stage. 

[h3][b]7. Aslan is no longer available, but his strength means that he is still essential in newly introduced content. Are there any plans to bring back the Season 2 Knights of Veda?[/b][/h3]

Season 2 Reruns will be done sequentially. Case in point, on the 02/27 Update, Aslan will be the first Season 2 Knight of Veda to return.

[h3][b]8. When Promoting Yanko from 4★ to 5★, his Skill Cooldown effect and stats seem to have disappeared. Why was this changed without prior notice?[/b][/h3]

Yanko’s Skill Cooldown Reduction effect is actually obtained from achieving Fate Level 7. However, due to a UI issue, this effect was not shown in the description.

On the 02/27 Update, we will fix this issue so that the correct values are displayed properly.

[h3][b]9. After promoting a Knight from 4★ to 5★, the number of Abyss of the Stars fragments obtained from Call of the Stars (or duplicates) seems to have decreased. It feels like a loss despite the promotion. Why is this happening?[/b][/h3]

This is a reasonable concern following the implementation of the 4★ to 5★ Promotion system.

The amount of Abyss of the Stars fragments given summoning duplicates of a Knight of Veda follow these rules:
- If the Knight in questions’ Fate level is not yet maxed out, the Knight of Veda is obtained alongside Abyss of the Stars x2.
- If the Knight in questions’ Fate level has already been maxed out, you will obtain Abyss of the Stars x5.

Before the 01/23 Update, any 4★ Knight of Veda with maxed out Fate levels have reached the end of progression, and so give out Abyss of the Stars x5 per duplicate summon. However, since further Fate levels are available to a 4★ Knight after being promoted to 5★, each duplicate summon now only gives Abyss of the Stars x2.

Once a Knight reaches Fate Level 7 as 5★, their Fates are already maxed out and so for every subsequent duplicate summon, you will now receive Abyss of the Stars x5.

While it may feel like you are receiving fewer Abyss of the Stars per duplicate summon, please consider that a promoted Knight with higher Fate levels has more potential and usability.

[h3][b]10. Aslan is no longer available, but his strength means that he is still essential in newly introduced content. Are there any plans to bring back the Season 2 Knights of Veda?[/b][/h3]

Overflowing Power of the Stars is a mechanic that affects performance but is unrelated to Hero upgrades outside of the Overload Charge stat.

To prevent excessive reliance on this mechanic for competitive content, we have restricted its usage there. However, rest assured that we will continue allowing its use on PvE Content.

[hr][/hr]
In addition to answering these questions, we also have an announcement regarding Mythic Promotion:

During our previous Director’s Live Broadcast, we mentioned that Mythic Promotion would be added to the game on the 02/27 Update. However, we have decided to postpone it to the 03/27 Update to align it with the 1st Anniversary update.

Releasing Mythic Promotion just a month after 4★ Promotion might feel overwhelming rather than enjoyable. We wanted to give players enough time to experiment with different hero combinations before introducing another major upgrade.

For the [b]1st Anniversary Update[/b], in addition to [b]Mythic Promotion[/b], we are preparing [b]White Hell[/b], a [b]1st Anniversary Special Dungeon[/b], and [b]new Guild content[/b], among other exciting features and events.

We will do our best to meet the expectations of our Masters of the Book.
 
[b]※ The information stated was provided to help our Masters of the Book understand our upcoming content schedule. More precise details will be given regarding content names and specifics through the patch notes.[/b]

Thank you.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/20893a9cff925122e63a8244eca7af189d08edc6.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on January 23, 2025!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ The new 5★ Knight of Veda “Amor”, who is both Love and Thunder, arrives[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/5a37217b620aa6e816aa7c345c0bbccd961f1173.png[/img]
[b][i]"Ahh~ I will love only you!"[/i]

A former captain of the Duke of Koren's family escort, she is now the Duke's personal assistant. Free from the obsessions of her past, this talkative young woman sees everything through a romantic filter and dreams of a happily ever after. However, due to the "Principality of Koren Incident" that occurred during her absence, she is about to reawaken her "destructive powers" that she had put aside for a while.[/b]
 

[b] * "Amor" converts a portion of her Max HP into ATK and DEF and uses the "Thunderbolt's Protection" effect to distribute a portion of the Incoming DMG over a set period of time.[/b]
- Her Normal Skill, "Electric Romance," hurls her lightning-imbued axe forward, dealing DMG to enemies in its path while inflicting the "Stigma of Lightning" effect to restrict their movement.
- Her Signature Skill, "Love Stings," grants her the "Thunderbolt's Resonance" effect, which allows her to split some of the DMG her allies take for a limited time while the effect is active.

[b]* The Ruler of the Deep Sea rises on these shadowy waters. New Content, “Shadow Waters” will be released![/b]
- In the new content “Shadow Waters,” the goal is to deal as much damage as possible to the Ruler of the Deep Sea, Krak. Krak will have different attributes depending on the day of the week.
- “Shadow Waters” will become available after completing the World Mission that can be obtained after clearing Adventure Stage 8-12. Once the World Mission is completed, it can now be accessed from the World Map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/bdc8f5c8f0fa13fbd71fe4f2c10e1fb78fa4d8aa.jpg[/img]
- You can participate in “Shadow Waters” for up to three (3) times a day, from Monday to Thursday each week. Each day, Krak will change attributes over the course of those four days. Up to two (2) additional entries can be gained by using Rubies or Starstones.
- The first season will be available starting on January 27.
- You are able to select up to a maximum of five (5) Knights of Veda which will then enter battle in FULL AUTO mode, with no option to change to manual control. Overflowing Power of the Stars and Active Resistance Shields are also not available in this content.
- Krak cannot be defeated in “Shadow Waters.” Once his HP reaches 0, its ATK power and HP will increase exponentially.
- Attacking Krak with an attribute that he is weak to can put them in a “Groggy” state, where they will take more damage.
- Scores are based on the amount of damage you deal to Krak. Your Weekly Score is the total of the Daily Scores earned from Monday to Thursday. This score will rank you against other players on your server, and rewards will be given based on your ranking.
- Rewards will be sent via in-game mail every Saturday, with the amounts varying according to the scores earned during the week.
- You can earn Starstone and Gold as rewards for clearing the new content, ‘Shadow Waters’

[b]* Your 4★ Knights of Veda or Weapon can now reach new heights of power by upgrading them to 5★![/b]
- Once a 4★ Knight of Veda or Weapon reaches Fate Level 7, you are now able to upgrade them to 5★ regardless of their level.
- Knights of Veda or Weapons upgraded from 4★ to 5★ will still need to have their Fate or Refinement levels upgraded with their 4★ duplicates, though more duplicates of the said Knight of Veda or weapon may be required for each Fate level. The abilities gained by upgrading them to 5★ and from their additional Fate levels will make them of similar power levels to currently existing 5★ Knights of Veda or Weapons.
- Some Knights of Veda will also receive new abilities when they are upgraded to ★5.
  ※ The abilities granted vary depending on the Fate Level of the Knight of Veda.

[list]- Lucian: When using his Signature Skill “Magnificence of Light,” in addition to healing Allies, there will now also be a chance of having their applied debuffs removed.
- Yanko: His Normal Skill “Automatic Interceptor” will now be enhanced to be a “Gatling” with rapid-fire capabilities.
- Leon: One of his buffs “Armor of Passion” will be improved, further reducing the DMG taken by allied Knights of Veda with the Blood attribute.
- Liam: His Signature Skill “Black Wolf” is greatly enhanced, increasing all DMG dealt and with additional Dark DMG dealt to enemies with the Light attribute.
- Capecchi : His Signature Skill “Spore Facilitator” will now also buff Poison DMG dealt to enemies.
- Andrei: When using his Signature Skill “Blazing Pillar,” it will now summon three (3) Fire Pillars instead of just one.
- Bjorn: When using his Signature Skill “Wild Frenzy,” a certain amount of incoming Melee DMG will now be reflected back to the attacker.
- Ardor: When the target of his Normal Skill “Explosive Arrow” is a boss, it will now deal more DMG and Explosive DMG.
- Orlik: When using his Normal Skill “Rock Armor”, all Allies will now also have immunity to debuffs during its duration.
- Elias: The damage for his Signature Skill “Lightning Leap” will be increased, in addition to now also having a chance to stun enemies.
- Shikh: Attacking enemies with his Normal ATK will now apply a DMG Reduction debuff to the enemy for a certain period of time.
- Nayan: The effect applied by her Signature Skill “Water Vigor” will be enhanced to now also have a chance of removing debuffs and increase Water DMG for Water-attribute Knights of Veda.
- Marthel: The damage of his Normal Skill “Will of Thunderblade” is increased alongside dealing additional DMG to Water-attribute enemies.
- Rani: The Light DMG from her Signature Skill “Influx of Light” is increased, with enemies near the Light Beam now also being drawn to it.
- Emile von Kloos: Fire-attribute enemies with the “Chill of Blessing” effect will now also get an ATK power reduction.
- Iris: Her summon “Dekania” will now deal additional DMG to Bosses.[/list]
- For Masters of the Book who have maxed out their Knight’s Fate levels and have at some point received at least one or more duplicate copies from Call of the Stars, these will be counted retroactively. Additional copies of the Knight of Veda will be distributed after the regular maintenance on 01/23.
- Weapons upgraded to 5★ will retain the same Weapon Skills they currently have, but their main stats and the skill effects will be enhanced.

[b]* A cozier descent into the Nightmare of the Abyss awaits with these improvements![/b]
- A Matchmaking system will be added to Nightmare of the Abyss.
- Players who wish to take advantage of this Matchmaking system can select the Abyssal Levels they wish to conquer based on their highest level reached and players will be matched accordingly.
- Hero’s Shoes can now also be used in Nightmare of the Abyss, in addition to the perks from the Blessing in Nightmare event now being applied to it also.

[b]* The Celestial Trials reach new heights.. literally. The Celestial Trials will now reach up to Floor 60![/b]
- Reaching Floor 50 of the Celestial Trials will reward you with the new “Pristine Wing” cosmetic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/ce00c929fe16760e11d99216b4bcfd8b778ae2fa.png[/img]

[b]* New Cosmetic Type: “Pristine Wings” will be added.[/b]
- “Pristine Wings” is a new cosmetic type that will add wings to your Knights of Veda. It can be obtained as a reward for clearing Floor 60 of the Celestial Trials.
- “Pristine Wings” are purely cosmetic and do not provide any additional gameplay effects.

[b]* Portrait of Thierry will be expanded to now have 39 floors.[/b]
- With the expansion of Portrait of Thierry to the 39th floor, the damage dealt by enemies will decrease on all floors, while the enemies' health will increase.

[b]* The stars have answered the Master of the Book's wish! New “Wishlist” feature added.[/b]
- A new “Wishlist” feature has been added to the “Fallen Wing of Veda” Call of the Stars. This feature increases the probability a wishlisted Knight of Veda can be summoned.
- You can select one (1) 5★ and one (1) 4★ Knight of Veda as your Wishlist. When either a 5★ or a 4★ Knight of Veda is summoned, the wishlisted Knights have a 50% chance of being summoned. 
- When a wishlisted Knight of Veda is not summoned, they have a 100% chance of being summoned on the next instance a Knight of Veda of their grade is summoned.
- The “Wishlist” feature can be accessed through a dedicated button located at the bottom-right of the “Fallen Wing of Veda” Call of the Star screen.

[b]* Your weapons can now get a glow-up! Weapon Transmogrification will be added in this update.[/b]
- You can now change the appearance of your weapons with “Weapon Transmogrification.” If you've ever liked the look of a weapon but couldn't equip it because of its stats, try this Transmogrification feature!
- The "Transmogrification" feature can be used by clicking the dedicated icon that appears when selecting the weapon you wish to change the appearance of.

[b]* When Enchanting, you now have the choice of applying a new effect or keeping the existing one.[/b]

[b]* "Shoes Packs" have been added, allowing you to obtain additional Shoes even while your storage is full.[/b]
- Once you reach the Adventurer’s Shoes cap, these new "Shoes Packs" will be created every 18 minutes, up to a maximum of 2,400. One "Shoes Pack" can be used to recharge one pair of Adventurers Shoes.

[b]* Additional rewards based on your Knights of Veda’s Synchronization Level will be added.[/b]
- Crystals of Fate will now be given as reward for reaching Synchronization Levels 2, 7, 8, and 9 with every Knight of Veda.
- Progress will be retroactively counted and any missing rewards will be distributed after the regular maintenance on 01/23.

[b]* Delegate! Deputy Guild Leaders can now also have some Guild management permissions granted.[/b]
- Through the newly added “Guild Privilege Settings” tab in the Guild menu, Guild Leaders will now be able to grant certain management permissions to Deputy Guild Leaders.

[b]* In celebration of the coming Lunar New Year, we’ve prepared an event with the hope that all our Master of the Book will herald its arrival with abundance and joy.[/b]
- The “Full of Blessings~ New Year’s Grand Feast!” event will bring abundance this New Year. During this event, you can obtain up to twenty (20) “Rice Cake Soup” in Adventure Stages.
- You can consume this dish to enhance your Knights of Veda and based on how many you have obtained, you will also be able to receive rewards.
- The “Full of Blessings~ New Year’s Grand Feast!” event will start after the regular maintenance on 01/23 and will end on February 13, 2025 6:00 AM UTC / February 12, 2025 10:00 PM PST.
- Complete certain missions and earn rewards while doing so during the “A Rich New Year’s Festival” event.
- The "A Rich New Year’s Festival” event will start after the regular maintenance on 01/23.

[b]* Join the ‘Simon’s Amazing Gifts’ event! Work together with your Guild members to defeat treasure chests and claim exciting rewards.[/b]
 - The “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” event can be participated in every Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at 08:00 PM during the event period, at the Guild Territory.
 - Various rewards can be obtained from this event, and for this current iteration: the new mascot “Ludwig” can be earned.
[strike] - “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” will run from February 06, 2025 until February 23, 2025.[/strike]
- “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” will run from january 23, 2025 until February 23, 2025. (Updated 01/23 11:45 AM UTC / 03:45 AM PST)

[b]* The “Distorted Rift” appears once again on Todburg and will run until February 06, 2025 [strike]05:59[/strike] 03:00 AM UTC / February 05, 2025 [strike]09:59[/strike] 07:00 PM PST.[/b] (Updated 02/06 04:50 AM UTC / 02/05 08:50 PM PST)

[b]* The "Special Supply Delivery Operation" event will be held once again.[/b]
- With this update, each stage will now only consist of one (1) round, similar to Apparition’s Rush.
- If you successfully complete the supply transport, you will receive rewards.
- The "Special Supply Delivery Operation" event will begin on February 06, 2025 6:00 AM UTC / February 05, 2025 10:00 PM PST and end after the maintenance on 02/27.

[b]* A Double Rewards event for Adventure Zone rewards will be held.[/b]
- During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Zone up to the daily limit.
- The double rewards event for Adventure Zone will end on February 06, 2025 [strike]05:59[/strike] 03:00 AM UTC / February 05, 2025 [strike]09:59[/strike] 07:00 PM PST.[/b] (Updated 02/06 04:50 AM UTC / 02/05 08:50 PM PST)

[b]* Veda’s Nightmare deepens as the rewards for braving its halls increase, the “Blessing in Nightmare” event returns![/b]
- During the "Blessing in the Nightmare" event, you can earn double rewards from Veda's Nightmare up to the daily limit. 
- You can also now get double the reward in “Nightmare of the Abyss.”
- The "Blessing in the Nightmare" event starts on February 06, 2025 6:00 AM UTC / February 05, 2025 10:00 PM PST and will end after the regular maintenance on 02/27.

[b]* A new Reward Decree season will start.[/b]
- The new Reward Decree season will begin on February 01, 2025 6:00 AM UTC / January 31, 2025 10:00 PM PST, and will run until February 28, 2025 6:00 AM UTC / February 27, 2025 10:00 PM PST.

[b]* A new season of Nightmare of the Abyss will be starting.[/b]
- With the new season, a new set of Abyss Trials will be applied to each stage.
 - The new Nightmare of the Abyss season will end after the regular maintenance on 02/27.

[b]* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.[/b]
 - After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
 - The new Portrait of Thierry season will end after the regular maintenance on 02/27.

notes.title: Development Team’s Responses to Your 12/26 Update Comments and Questions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

This is Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda. The development team is here to answer the feedback and questions you, our Masters of the Book, have shared.

[h3][b]1. The drop rates for Goddess’s Armor seem to be very low. Since there are no features like Sweep on Nightmares of the Abyss, it feels harder to farm them, are there any plans to adjust the drop rates?[/b][/h3]

We understand the frustration with the drop rates. There are currently plans to make adjustments to the higher Abyssal Levels of the Nightmare of the Abyss with the February 2025 update. After the update, we’ll carefully review the data and adjust the difficulty and drop rates accordingly.

Additionally, the Nightmare of the Abyss is a content that requires consistent challenges to complete the Goddess’s Armor you wish for your Knights of Veda. Since Goddess’s Armor has fixed sub-stats, once you fully refine and upgrade it, you would only need more of it to build your other Knights if you so wish.

[h3][b]2. I mostly play solo and want to do so still. However, I’m forced to use Co-Op when playing Nightmare of the Abyss, which is inconvenient since parties can only be made by directly inviting other players. Is it possible for a lobby system to be added to the game where you can openly recruit players to create a party?[/b][/h3]

Due to the Nightmare of Abyss’ difficulty level, many Masters of the Book feel the need to create parties to tackle the content together, lowering the difficulty as a result.

Adding a lobby system to the game corresponds to a big investment of development time and resources and would potentially make the game more bloated in terms of systems. Additionally, there could be issues when there are no players available, so we plan to introduce a similar Quick Matchmaking system. This will allow players to set the Abyssal Level they want to tackle and quickly match with users who wish to party up. 

Rest assured that we will prioritize the addition of this feature and then consider updates to it afterwards.

[h3][b]3. Currently, Anais is performing well for a newly-released Knight of Veda. However, the Wound Recovery part of her kit is lacking. Are there any plans for buffs of any kind?[/b][/h3]

Anais’ Kit was made with having her the best Healer knight in terms of damage and buffs applied in mind, in addition to having the Wound Recovery mechanic. Due to this, she has quickly become a necessary part of any team when tackling Celestial Trials and Nightmare of the Abyss.

However it would seem that this part of her kit is found to be lacking contrary to expectations, of which we would like to apologize for. Buffing the Wound Recovery part of her kit could be risky, however we’ll continue to keep an eye on the situation and make adjustments after careful consideration and review.

[h3][b]4. Many recently introduced content include a time-limit rule, which I feel limits the players in terms of build diversity by making them be simple DPS checks.[/b][/h3]

Are there any discussions regarding this, specifically if more new content will include this rule? Will the upcoming World Boss also have it?

Time-limits are used in content where it matches the gameplay goal, which in the case of Nightmare of the Abyss, is a key element. Teaming up with other users allows them to clear the content faster, allowing for better efficiency in farming Goddess’s Armor and the upgrade materials for it.

As for the World Boss content, it does include a time-limit, but it is used differently from current implementations. In this content, the boss becomes more ferocious and deals more damage as its health decreases. Ranking is then based on how much damage has been dealt by each user within a limited time. This means that you would also need to focus on your Knights’ survivability alongside their attack power if you wish to rank high in this content.

However, as the time-limit rule is dependent on the gameplay goals for the content, we’re considering content without this rule in place and hopefully introduce them to you as soon as possible, so please look forward to it.

[h3][b]5. Since the introduction of Goddess’s Armor, PvP Matches have suddenly become longer. Are there any plans to adjust the effects of the Goddess’s Armor based on if the content is PvP or PvE?[/b][/h3]

We’ve received numerous feedback regarding this and are looking to make adjustments to the equipment for PvP-related content to realize our aim of PvP matches not being too long or too short. 

[h3][b]6. Are there any plans to allow “Hero’s Shoes” to be usable on Nightmare of the Abyss? It would make the more tedious parts of content, specifically the farming, much more manageable.[/b][/h3]

We completely understand your feedback and are making adjustments to ease the frustration. Alongside the upcoming Quick Matchmaking feature, we’re actively considering allowing the use of Hero’s Shoes on Nightmare of the Abyss. 

We will inform you as soon as possible once we have finalized the details and would like to ask for your understanding and patience as we do so.

[h3][b]7. We’ve already cleared Floor 50 of Celestial Trials, when will the additional floors be released?[/b][/h3]

Floors 51~60 of Celestial Trials will be added to the game on the 1/23 Update alongside an update to the lower floors to reduce their difficulty.. 

[b]※ The information stated was provided to help our Masters of the Book understand our upcoming content schedule. More precise details will be given regarding content names and specifics through the patch notes.[/b]

Thank you.

Masters of the Book,

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on December 26, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ From the flames, rise the newest 5★ Knight of Veda, Anais[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/eb2d59cfc0eb3986f02569b15e3ff048830dc36d.png[/img]
[b][b]"Now, I… want to help, together with Yor"[/b]

Lady Liongray, the companion of the eternal flame bird, has always remained true to her duty as a member of the Knights of Boden. As a knight, not as the youngest daughter of House Liongray, she endeavors to rescue those in need. With a compassionate heart yearning for peace, Anais will relentlessly work towards realizing her dreams[/b]


- “Anais” is a Fire-type Ranged Healer wielding a Wand & Orb. Anais is a healer who sacrifices a portion of her HP to boost ATK while simultaneously reviving vulnerable allies during her attacks. Her Normal Skill, "Radiant Flames of Life," allows the summoned Yor to unleash fireballs that pierce enemies and deal additional DMG when they explode. Her Signature Skill, "Wings of Eternal Flames," allows the summoned Yor to fly, dealing DMG to enemies in its path while granting a healing feather that heals allies.
- During the Pickup Hero Event, when a 5★ Knight of Veda or an Exclusive Weapon is summoned, the selected Hero or Weapon will appear with a 100% chance.

* In an endlessly deep abyss lies nightmares untold. The new “Nightmare of the Abyss” will be added to the game in this update
- ”Nightmare of the Abyss” is similar to “Veda’s Nightmare,” but features stronger enemies and the “Abyssal Trials” that will present a formidable obstacle to all Masters of the Book.
- ”Nightmare of the Abyss” can be unlocked after completing the World Quest, available after clearing Adventure Zone Chapter 9, Stage 12, and accessed through Veda’s Nightmare.
- You will be able to participate Solo or through Co-Op using either Normal, and Squad Battles.
- As shown on the image below, you will be able to see the unlocked “Nightmare of the Abyss” through the button shown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/f0985a56c20782a4c20f966697b0f4f020506728.png[/img]
- In the “Nightmare of the Abyss,” monsters are more ferocious than those from the existing Veda’s Nightmare, and additional obstacles are introduced. The higher the Abyssal Level, the more powerful the enemies you will face and the more Abyssal Trials you will accumulate. But you’ll receive more rewards for that.
- The ”Nightmare of the Abyss,” has up to twenty (20) stages, with the available stages increasing or decreasing based on the results of the dungeon clears.
- When a “Nightmare of the Abyss” stage is cleared, a random Veda’s Nightmare stage will then be chosen to become an Abyss Nightmare.
- As a reward for clearing Nightmare of the Abyss, you can obtain the new equipment, ‘Goddess’s Armor.’ The higher the level you clear, the higher the grade of ‘Goddess’s Armor’ you can acquire.

* A new equipment type “Goddess’s Armor” will be added.
- “Goddess’s Armor” is a new equipment obtainable on the new “Nightmare Dungeon of the Deep Abyss.” By equipping this item, you will be able to enhance your Knights of Veda’s survivability. The “Goddess’s Armor” is classified according to different roles: Tank, DPS, Support, and Healer.
- The new equipment, ‘Goddess’s Armor,’ is available up to the legendary grade. Higher-grade ‘Goddess’s Armor’ can be obtained depending on the abyss level cleared in ‘Nightmare of the Deep.’
- You can equip “Goddess’s Armor” on the Equipment Tab.
- Achievements related to “Goddess’s Armor” have also been added to the game.

* “Pickup All-Out” returns, this time for good. Check out the new “Guided by the Stars” and “Weapons Awakened Under the Stars” Call of the Stars.
- On the new “Guided by the Stars” Call of the Stars, you will be able to summon Season 1 5★ Pickup Knights of Veda while on the “Weapons Awakened Under the Stars” Call of the Stars, you will be able to summon their respective Exclusive Weapons.
- The new Call of the Stars also include the Knight of Veda “Rhynara” and her Exclusive Weapon.
- The “Grace of the Holy Grail” count for these new Call of the Stars is separate from those of the Pickup Hero Event and the Fallen Wing of Veda Call of the Stars.
- Each new Call of the Stars also offer bonus rewards based on the number of summons made on them, allowing you to choose and guarantee the Season 1 5★ Pickup Knight of Veda or Exclusive Weapon of your choice.
- The Pickup All-Out Event also applies to the ‘Mark of the Sworn Loyalty’ and ‘Fragments of the Painting’ events, with all Season 1 Pickup Knights of Veda and Rynara’s Halo/El Cid included.
- The number of attempts made in the previous "Aslan's Pickup Hero Event" and "Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event" has been retroactively applied to the 'Call of the Stars Count' progress of 'Guided by the Stars' and 'Weapons Awakened Under the Stars'. (Updated 12/26 9:40 AM UTC / 1:40 AM PST)​​​​​​​
 
* Improvements arrive to Portrait of Thierry this update!
- The “Sweep” feature will now also be available to Portrait of Thierry.
- At the start of a new season of Portrait of Thierry, you can select a floor range where the sweep will be applied up to the last cleared floor.
- During the sweep, all clear rewards, including Accessories, will be given.
- The “Portrait of Boden Caryen” has been improved to not only revive the selected Knights of Veda but also fully heal their wounds.
- On Floors 28 to 36 of Portrait of Thierry, the drop rate for Mythic Accessories has been increased from 10% to 15%.
- The reward for clearing Floor 36, the Legendary Set Accessory Ticket previously given as clear reward will be replaced by a Mythical Set Accessory Ticket.

* The Sweep feature will also be added to the Ancient Golden City.
- You can now perform a Sweep on Ancient Golden City stages that you have previously cleared.
- Stages cleared using Support Knights of Veda will not be Sweepable.

* We've added a new map to Arena Survival: “Faded Last Land.” 
- Players will be randomly assigned to play on the existing map, “Estate of the Fallen Loser,” or the new map, “Faded Last Land.”

* A ‘Show Recommended Relics’ function will be added to guide players in selecting the most suitable Relics for each Knights of Veda.
- This new feature can be accessed by clicking the newly added icon on a currently equipped Relic.
- When you click the “Show Recommended Relics” button, a Relic that will suit the selected Knight of Veda will be displayed. By using Filters, you can sort and easily view the desired Relic with your preferred stats for easy equipping.

* We're adding the “Craft & Shop” feature to the Adventure Guide!
- You can access your desired features, such as Crafting or Enchanting, easily through the Adventure Guide without checking the map!

* Charging up your Adventurer’s Shoes will be improved.
- When charging your Adventurer’s Shoes with Rubies or Starstones, you will now be able to do so up to ten (10) times at once.
- The number of “Steps of the Journey” you can use at once has been increased from five (5) to ninety-nine (99).
- The maximum number of Adventurer’s Shoes you can obtain has been increased from 999 to 9,999.

* Missed a day? Use the “Make-up Attendance” feature to catch up on any rewards you might have missed.
- The "Make-up Attendance" function calculates the maximum number of days available from the start of the event to the current day, enabling you to claim missed rewards.
- The cost will be Starstone x160 per day of attendance.

* The purchase limit for Common-grade ingredients in the Cooking Store has been changed from unlimited to 200 items.

* The information window for the Arena Store has been improved so that it will now display the stats of Tunic.

* To celebrate the arrival of the new year, the “The Sun Rises Again" will be held.
- During “The Sun Rises Again" event you will be able to earn the new mascot “Bacon” by logging in for seven (7) days during the event period.
- “The Sun Rises Again" event will end after the regular maintenance on 1/9.

* In addition, the “New Year Mission” event will also be held.
- The “New Year Mission” event will end after the regular maintenance on 1/23

* Shattered Dimensional Rift event
- Earn Guild Kill rewards and Individual Kill rewards based on the number of Rogue One defeated with your guild members. Guild Defeat rewards include Insignias in addition to other rewards.
- The "Shattered Dimensional Rift" event will end on 1/16.

* A Double Rewards event for Adventure Zone rewards will be held.
- During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Zone up to the daily limit.
- The double rewards event for Adventure Zone will end after the regular maintenance on 1/9.

* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.
 - After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
 - The new Portrait of Thierry season will end after the regular maintenance on 1/23.

* A new season of Arena will begin.
- During Arena Season 7, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.
- The Season 4 Tunic rewards will also be available for purchase in the shop during Arena Season 7.
- Arena Season 7 will end after the regular maintenance on 1/23.

* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.
- For this season, the Poison-attribute “Swamp King Maneater” will be gracing us with their presence as the featured boss.
- "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
  - 1st Round: 12/26 to 1/7 / Settlement: 1/7 to 1/9 
  - 2nd Round: 1/9 to 1/21 / Settlement: 1/21 to 1/23

* A new Reward Decree season will start.
- The new Reward Decree season will begin right after January 1, 2025, and will run until January 31, 2025 6:00 AM UTC / January 30, 2025 10:00 PM PST.

* The "Journey in Memory (Anais Trial)" event will be held.
- During this Trial event, you can try out Knights of Veda: 5★ Anais, 4★ Iris, and 4★ Bjorn.
- The "Journey in Memory (Anais Trial)" event will end after the regular  maintenance on 1/23.

* The “Fateful Encounter” encounter event will be held.
- Log-in for seven (7) days to earn various bountiful rewards.
- The "Fateful Encounter" event will start on ½ and will end after the regular maintenance on 1/23.

[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]
 * The difficulty level for the “Path of Trials” and “Path of Succession” difficulties of the Ancient Golden City will be reduced.
 * The difficulty levels for “Portrait of Thierry” Floors below 25 will be lowered.
 * The AI of unfocused Veda Knights will be improved for more efficient movement during Squad Battle.
 * The health bonus given to Masters of the Book on PVP battles will be adjusted to reduce the chances of battles ending abruptly.

[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
* An issue where the Stamina-based additional damage from Aslan’s Signature Skill ”Deadly Leap and Blow” was not applied when switching to another character after the shockwave was triggered will be resolved.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9120f46e53b03b71dc0440b3f0c05cee4e8fd20f.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book!

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on November 28, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ A new 5★ Knight of Veda “Aslan” will now be available![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/238ce1cbf4029950474583e425c1a0ff377bb91c.png[/img]

[h3][b]“The King demands victory”[/b][/h3]

[i][b]"Aslan Liongray, who chose to pledge his allegiance to the king instead.
He gave everything for his family, but House Liongray gave him nothing in return. The stigma of being "unchosen" ate away at his heart, and on the day he faced the blade of betrayal, Aslan chose the king instead"[/b][/i]


- “Aslan” is an Earth-type Melee DPS who uses a Sword & Shield. He converts his Stamina into Skill DMG to deal powerful DMG and uses his skills to take the initiative in battle. Aslan's Normal Skill, “Iron Rock Wall,” is his primary CC ability, causing rocks to pile up high in front of him, dealing DMG to enemies within range and incapacitating them for a period of time, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks. His Signature Skill, “Deadly Leap and Blow,” is an offensive skill that allows him to leap to an enemy's location and deliver a powerful blow that knocks them into the air, leaving them defenseless and vulnerable to further attacks
- Starting this update, summoning in a Pickup Hero or Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event guarantees a 100% appearance rate for the featured 5★ Knight of Veda or Exclusive Weapon.

*  Endless conquest to reach the top floor, with the new content “Celestial Trials”.
 - The new content, ‘Celestial Trials,’ challenges players to conquer a tower one floor at a time, advancing to greater heights. Each floor features powers that either strengthen or weaken the Knights of Veda, requiring strategic planning and careful team building to overcome.
 - To access “Celestial Trials”, you must clear Chapter 7 Stage 12 of the Adventure Zone, after which the World Quest “Celestial Trials” will be available. (Players who already have access to the Tower of Trials will not need to do this quest and can enter immediately.)
 - The mechanics and combat systems for “Celestial Trials” are the same as the previous “Tower of Trials”, only with the addition of each floor having special rules, buffs, and debuffs. Battles will also be fought in various dungeon types.
 - There will be an initial clear reward for every floor, and with every initial clear of ten floors, a “First Conqueror” reward will be given to all users, given under the name of the Master of the Book who cleared it first.
 - When someone becomes the “First Conqueror”, a notification with that player’s name will be sent to all Masters of the Book.
 - First clearing the 30th and 50th floors of ‘Celestial Trials’ grants the ‘Mark of Glorious Response’, a reward that can be used to customize with the new ‘Mark of Sanctity’ feature.
 - You can view the rankings to check the status of users who participated in ‘Celestial Trials’.

* A new way to decorate your equipped Halo, “Mark of Sanctity”, will be added to the game.
 - The “Mark of Sanctity” is an item that will allow you to change the appearance of your equipped Halo.
 - No additional game effects are given when equipping the “Mark of Sanctity” and are purely cosmetic.
 - You can obtain this item as a first clear reward from the “Celestial Trials” content.

* Randomly change one of your Relic’s sub-stats with the new “Blooming Relics” feature.
 - “Blooming Relics” feature can be accessed via the newly added “Blooming” button.
 - Select the Relic you want to modify and the sub-stat you want to change, then press the "Bloom" button. The selected sub-stat will be changed into a random stat selected from a pool of sub-stats of the same tier as your Relic.
 - You will be able to do “Blooming Relics” with the new “Solvent of Prayer”, which can be obtained as First Clear Reward for the new “Celestial Trials” content and by purchasing it with Gold or Rubies in the Shop.

* A new difficulty level will be added to the “Ancient Golden City”
 - “Path of the Dynast II”, a new difficulty level, will be added to the Ancient Golden City with this update.
 - Under this new difficulty level, you will be able to obtain more rewards.

* Starting this update, summoning in a Pickup Hero or Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event guarantees a 100% appearance rate for the featured 5★ Knight of Veda or Exclusive Weapon.

* To celebrate the end of one year and the coming of another, we will conduct a special login event called “December's Special Rewards”.
 - As a token of our appreciation, the “December's Special Rewards” login event will allow our Masters of the Book to obtain a “Knight of Veda & Weapon Selection Box” on the 7th and 28th day of logging in.
 - Upon using the “Knight of Veda & Weapon Selection Box” you will be given either a Standard 5★ Knight of Veda and Weapon or a Pickup 5★ Knight of Veda and Exclusive Weapon (excluding the new Knight of Veda, Aslan)
 - The “December's Special Rewards” event will be held from after the 11/28 Maintenance until December 31, 2024.

* To celebrate the upcoming Holidays, the “Winter Morning Bells” event will be held where you can clear missions and earn rewards.
 - The “Winter Morning Bells” event will end after the regular maintenance on 12/26.

* Join the ‘Simon’s Amazing Gifts’ event! Work together with your Guild members to defeat treasure chests and claim exciting rewards.
 - The “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” event can be participated in every Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at 8:00 PM during the event period, at the Guild Territory.
 - With this update, a new feature will be added that allows you to check and choose whether to receive the contents of the first Treasure Chest you select after defeating the Fearsome Treasure Chest.
 - Various rewards can be obtained from this event, and for this current iteration: the new mascot “Ted Fatale” can be earned.
 - “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” will run from December 5, 2024 until December 22, 2024.

* The "Special Supply Delivery Operation" event will be held once again.
 - Each stage consists of 3 rounds, and you can acquire buffs upon entry and after completing the 1st and 2nd rounds of combat.
 - If you successfully complete the supply transport, you will receive rewards.
 - The "Special Supply Delivery Operation" event will end after the maintenance on 12/26.

*  The “Distorted Rift” appears once again on Todburg and will run until December 12, 2024.

* The "Blessing in Adventure" event is back to shower everyone with more rewards!
 - During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Dungeons up to the daily limit.
 - The double rewards event for Adventure Dungeons will run from November 28 after maintenance until December 12, 2024 05:59 AM UTC / December 11, 2024 09:59 PM PST.

* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.
 - For this season, the Electric-element “Striking Thunderblade of the Canyon” will be gracing us with their presence as the feature boss.
 - "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
   · 1st Round: 11/28 to 12/10 / Settlement: 12/10 to 12/11 
   · 2nd Round: 12/12 to 12/24 / Settlement: 12/24 to 12/25

* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.
 - After regular maintenance, monsters differing in attributes from those in the previous seasons will appear in the stages of “Portrait of Thierry.”
 - The new season of "Portrait of Thierry" will end after the regular maintenance on 12/26.

* A new season of Arena will begin.
 - During Arena Season 6, you can earn rewards such as [strike]Tunics[/strike], Emotes and Insignia based on your progress. (Updated 12/2 3:09 AM UTC / 12/1 7:09 PM PDT)
 - The Season 3 rewards will also be available for purchase in the shop during Arena Season 6.
 - Arena Season 6 will end after the regular maintenance on 12/26.

* A new Reward Decree season will start.
 - The new Reward Decree season will begin right after December 1, 2024, and will run until December 31, 2024 6:00 AM UTC / December 30, 2024 10:00 PM PST.

* The "Journey in Memory (Aslan Trial)" event will be held.
 - During this Trial event, you can try out Knights of Veda: 5★ Aslan, 4★ Lucian, and 4★ Orlik.
 - The "Journey in Memory (Aslan Trial)" event will end after the regular  maintenance on 12/26.


[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]

* A new feature has been added to inform players how many times a Relic sub-stat has been enhanced.
 - An icon will be displayed beside a sub-stat to show how many times it has been engraved and the grade.
 - For Legendary-grade Relics, the number of enhancement attempts made on sub-stats will be displayed as they appear on levels 4, 8, 12, 16, and 20 respectively.
 - Each time a Relic is Engraved, the affected sub-stats Enhancement count will increase by one.
 - Additionally, the grade of the enhanced sub-stats will be differentiated via the color of the icon. They will be displayed, in the following order: Gray / Green / Blue / Purple / Orange.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/80d5c5658009afa9a140fe4b17f83382952ccbf6.png[/img]

* “FULL AUTO” function Added for Squad Battles.
 - The new “FULL AUTO” function has been added for Squad Battles, allowing you to unleash Overflowing Power of the Stars automatically during battles.

* A new "Organize" Button for Easy Item Disassembly will be added.
 - A new "Organize" button has been added in the item info window. By selecting this button, you can easily choose items to dismantle all at once using the "Batch Register" button in your inventory.
 - You can easily manage the items acquired in the dungeon by reviewing them on the Result Screen, conveniently displayed on the left and right sections.

* Belle Menu Improvements.
 - For content that is still locked to the Master of the Book, a lock icon will appear and the button will be deactivated.
 - For current non-seasonal content (Beast Battlefront, Battlefield of the War Gods, etc.): The text “Preparation” will be displayed.

* You will now be able to change the registered Knight of Veda Deck on the Stage entry screen.

* The maximum number of Relics that can be kept in your inventory will be increased to 2,000.

* The Knight of Veda “Edward” will be adjusted as follows:
 - The “ATK Bonus” applied when using his Signature Skill “Time for Punishment “ will be raised from 50% to 80%.
 - The “Reduce Incoming DMG” effect applied when using his Signature Skill “Time for Punishment” will be increased from 10% to 15%.
 - The DMG increase granted by his Fate Level 6 effect will be raised from 40% to 50%.
 - The ATK SPD increase granted by his Fate Level 6 effect will be raised from 15% to 30%.


[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]

* An issue that caused the Knight of Veda “Rhynara” to be recognized as a Melee-type Knight and allowed completion of achievements that need Melee-types to complete will be fixed.
 - Any achievements completed due to this issue will not be removed from users accounts.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.
