notes.title: Development Team’s Responses to Your 10/31 Update Comments and Questions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,
I am Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

The highly anticipated Season 2 update, Tears of the Goddess. was finally released on October 31, 2024. We would like to sincerely thank everyone who participated in the launch festivities. The development team is here to answer the feedback and questions you, our Masters of the Book, have shared.

Through your feedback, we feel a greater sense of responsibility in addressing areas of the game that need further improvement. We will make sure to properly review your suggestions and reflect them in a way that would improve the game for Season 2 and beyond.


[h3][b]1. The Experience points required to level up the Master of the Book in Season 2 seem to have increased significantly, which caught many off guard. It’s great that the experience points are higher, but the gap between Master of the Book levels and the Adventure Level Ascension Quests seems to have increased the progression difficulty.[/b][/h3]

We have received numerous feedback about this, and it is one that we can empathize with as we plan to continually review and make changes to it on the difficulty side.

The development team increased the experience points for the Master of the Book level in Season to allow new and returning users to level up quickly and unlock most of the content tied to these levels much faster.

In the process, we anticipated a much slower increase in Knights’ power relative to their Master of the Book level, and thus an increase in the difficulty of levels. While this was the case, we believed that several buffs made to most Knights, and the steady flow of resources given to users compared to those given from the Open Beta, made it so that clearing Adventure Zones shouldn’t be too difficult. 

However, rest assured that we will continue to monitor the situation and make adjustments to Ascension Quests or Adventure Zones that are proving to be too difficult.


[h3][b]2. We’re enjoying the addition of Squad Battles, but it seems like the monsters in it feel stronger. Are there any differences with monster HP values?[/b][/h3]

For Season 2, the development team has made Squad Battle the foundational battle mode. In Squad Battle, all four Knights are actively on the field, which increases enemy health accordingly. 

After taking advantage of synergies with Knight combinations and stats, it became possible to break through the Adventure Zone using Squad Battle. However, if progress became difficult, we designed a play experience that allows you to challenge harder areas through Normal Battle or Co-Op, offering a more strategic approach to overcoming tough obstacles.


[h3][b]3. Most of the Knights added in Season 1 haven't had story quests attached to them. Are there any plans to add Story Quests to them?[/b][/h3]

The Knights released in Season 1 continue to advance their quests and agendas within the world of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

The characters in the main story will continue to evolve, with additional storylines added over time. For the external characters with significant episodes, we will prioritize important updates and release them gradually.


[h3][b]4. I was really looking forward to the release of Season 2, but then I noticed that most of the new content added has been for the end-game. Are there any plans to add content for those still starting or at an intermediate level?[/b][/h3]

In an earlier Director’s Letter, we briefly introduced some content that will be added to the game’s subsequent updates.

We are currently monitoring the difficulty of content like Portrait of Thierry, Beast Battlefront, and the Ancient Golden City, as they seem to present a significant barrier for beginners. 

As a development team, our first priority has always been to design the difficulty of all content, future or existing, with high quality, ensuring that players of all skills levels can still have a satisfying gameplay experience. With that in mind, we will continue to adjust the balance of existing content and add more challenging high-level content to match the progression of users.

The most important part in building powerful Knights in ASTRA: Knights of Veda has always been Item Setup, the most critical of which is the Relic setup. We believe that properly setting artifacts is a key skill for anyone wishing to master the game.

The Development Team is currently exploring various ways to make Relic setup and the checking of item stats easier for beginners. Once we finalize the direction for this update, we will share it with you all.


[h3][b]5. The stress brought about by the pity system is quite high, especially when consecutive pity pulls occur, bringing extreme disappointment. Could you ease the pity system or allow us to choose between a 100% guaranteed pity pull after 100 summons or a 50% pull after 70 summons.[/b][/h3]

"Call of the Stars" is an area that requires careful consideration for various reasons. We fully understand the stress users may experience in this area and are working on measures that will satisfy a wide range of players. 

We will share these updates as soon as possible. While there is ongoing discussion, please note that since it is a system that has already been commercialized, we must approach any changes with caution. We appreciate your understanding and patience.


That concludes the answers to the topics that we thought you might be curious about regarding the Season 2 update.

As announced on a previous Developer Note, after the Season 2 “Tears of the Goddess” update, we plan to introduce “Trials of the Celestial”, “Nightmare Dungeon of the Deep Abyss”, “World Bosses”, and the Mythic-grade for Weapons and Knights. This, alongside some other planned content and improvements that we are still to introduce in future updates.

We would like to thank all our Masters of the Book, who are still with us and who joined us for Season 2, “Tears of the Goddess”.

A full roadmap for Season 2 will be provided soon, combining both the planned developments and improvements to existing content.

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Team’s Responses on Season 2 Update Direction
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book. I am Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you for your incredible support as we kick off Season 2! We're thrilled to see your enthusiasm and excited to let you know that the updates you've seen so far are just a taste of even bigger changes ahead.

As Season 2 progresses, ASTRA: Knights of Veda will strive for greater innovation and growth. Your journey is just beginning, and we look forward to bringing you even more exciting developments! We would like to briefly explain the development direction we are working towards and the content we are preparing.

First, we want to reduce the burden of in-game purchases that users feel are mandatory and provide more diverse opportunities for strengthening. To do this, we are preparing a system allowing all 4★ and 5★ Knights of Veda to ascend to the “Mythic” grade. Equipment can also ascend into Mythic-grade, with their appearance able to be set by the player. This ascension into the Mythic grade will be facilitated through various in-game content and missions. 

We believe that some of the content released was too challenging and may now feel like too repetitive and routine work. In the future, we will strive to avoid creating content that is too “homework-like” in feel and gameplay, and will focus on developing content that provides a true expression of skill that can only be experienced in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

In addition, we will carefully review the rewards to match them to the difficulty level of the challenge.

The specific schedule for these changes will be revealed alongside the roadmap, but we will be taking this opportunity to provide some of the information on the changes and additions we have prepared.


[h3][b]In November, a new game mode called “Trials of the Celestial” will be released.[/b][/h3]

As the power of the Dark Royal Tomb beneath Gigantfall is released and the Crown of Death finds its master, the clouds obscuring the top of the Tower of Trials are lifted. Now, would- be challengers can ascend to the top of Tower of Trials, as its ancient, original form is revealed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9ad38a692bd1944e0a8c958a060be6ac0782b365.png[/img]

The existing Tower of Trials has been significantly changed, and the Master of the Book can now challenge its infinite floors.

With most of the Masters of the Book's recent spec upgrades and the addition of the Portrait of Thierry, we've noticed some overlap with the Tower of Trials content. The experience and challenge level may feel less engaging, with the content repeating every three weeks. We understand it might feel more like a task than a thrill.

To avoid this feeling of repetitiveness, we have removed the resets for Tower of Trials, alongside other changes coming to this content with the “Trials of the Celestial” update. As previously mentioned, the “Trials of the Celestial” will not reset and rewards will be provided each floor. 

Initially, about a hundred floors will be opened, and as you attempt the higher floors, you will need to be more creative in your Knight lineups to beat it as each floor will also feature special buffs and debuffs. 

You can check the rankings for records on reaching the highest floor. The nickname and portrait of the Masters of the Book who clear each floor in a specific section are engraved on that floor first, and all Masters of the Book who climb the tower may receive special rewards in honor of the first climber.

There will be no support for Squad Battles; you can only challenge the Tower with your wits and your Knight setups.


[h3][b]In December, we will be introducing the Nightmare Dungeon of the Deep Abyss[/b][/h3]

Following the events of the Dark Royal Tomb and the Crown of Death, the nightmare has descended further into the abyss, intensifying the darkness surrounding it.

Nightmare Dungeon of the Deep Abyss will present you with a more difficult challenge as the abyss deepens and continues to take hold of the Nightmare, with higher level monsters and a regional debuff) called “Abyss Trials”).

Challenge the Nightmare Dungeon of the Deep Abyss to obtain new Mythic-grade items and relics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/68eaba6d9fb9b7fb01743c47c00320834d2cd511.jpg[/img]

Looking for more challenges and a way to show off the power of your Knights of Veda? Look no further as we designed the Nightmare Dungeon of the Deep Abyss with a higher level of challenge specifically in mind. We look forward to our Masters of the Book braving the challenges of this new content, and don’t worry if this is still not enough, the journey only starts here.

Nightmare Dungeon of the Deep Abyss is an end-game content where the deeper you delve into the abyss, the enemies become stronger and stronger, special debuffs are applied. You will be able to strategically tackle these debuffs and face the threats posed by stronger enemies to earn powerful rewards.

You can obtain entrance tickets to the Abyss Nightmare dungeon through regular Nightmare dungeons, and by clearing the first stage of the Abyss, you will receive another ticket for a specific second-stage dungeon. The Abyss Nightmare has a time limit, and if you clear it faster than the limit, you can challenge a higher stage of the Abyss based on the remaining time. Additionally, you can use the "Co-Op" feature to challenge it with friends or guild members, allowing for a more exciting experience through cooperation.

As you challenge the Abyss Stages that match your growth, you can acquire a new item, the "Goddess's Armor," and the probability of obtaining Mythic-grade Relics will increase with each stage. At higher Abyss stages, you can even acquire Mythic-grade armor.

This new "Goddess's Armor" can only be obtained by playing the Abyss Nightmare dungeon, and there are no paid products involved.


As the new year starts in January, new content in the form of a “World Boss”, a feature we have longed to introduce, will be coming to the game.

Defeat the ruler of the deep sea, “Krak”, and help Vesti protect her massive warship “Dawn’s Avenger” located on a new area for Season 2, “Narvir Coast”. 

Krak’s many tentacles each possess unique elements, delivering a range of powerful and menacing attacks against you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9a9fd06fddc03d896736a4b2eab2d011e0fd3d03.png[/img]
World Boss: Krak is PvE endgame content where you must target different elements of the boss each day throughout the week. Krak can be challenged daily, with each day focused on a unique element to strategize against.

Rewards will be given based on daily rankings, so prepare your Knights to match the changing elements and join the competition with other Masters of the Book!


[h3][b]4★ Knights will now have the opportunity to be promoted to 5★.[/b][/h3]

When a 4★ Knight of Veda reaches Fate Level 7, they will be upgraded to 5★ with enhanced stats. Like with Fate Level 7, they can continue to develop their Fate one by one.

With this update, all 4★ Knights that Masters of the Book have obtained will be distributed as a gift.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/ea110af23ec043594898029847d63ca392bd28fc.png[/img]

All 5★ Knights (including those promoted from 4★ Knights of Veda) will have the opportunity to ascend to Mythic-grade. This promotion can be achieved by completing in-game missions, regardless of the Knight’s Fate Level. 

Now, all Masters of the Book can elevate their beloved Knights, whether 4★ or 5★, to the Mythic-grade.

Mythic-grade Knights of Veda will gain unique special effects, adding more depth to strategies and enhancing the joy of studying and analyzing your Knights.

In ASTRA: Knights of Veda, there are various attractive weapon designs, yet some are overlooked due to their performance. Now, you can use the appearance of the weapon you like.

5★ weapons can also be promoted to Mythic rank through missions, and any weapon you've acquired can have its appearance changed to your preferred style as long as it’s recorded in your inventory.


In addition, a new Re-release system, various events, and missions are in the works. Once the schedule and details are finalized, we’ll be sharing them with you and gathering your feedback. We’re also planning an event, possibly a meeting or online session, where we can hear your opinions directly.

We at the development team are committed to delivering more engaging and enjoyable updates and services.

We look forward to your continued support and interest in ASTRA: Knights of Veda Season 2, Tears of the Goddess. After the first update of Season 2, we’ll be addressing more of your feedback so stay tuned.

※ The information stated was provided to help our Masters of the Book understand our upcoming content schedule. More precise details will be given regarding content names and specifics through the patch notes.

Thank you.

notes.title: 10/31 Patch Details (Updated 11/1 05:30 AM UTC / 10/31 10:30 PM PDT)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9120f46e53b03b71dc0440b3f0c05cee4e8fd20f.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book!

A new season dawns as we deliver an update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda that will be released on October 31, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ A new Dual-Attribute 5★ Knight of Veda “Rhynara” will now be available![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/382a0b2fb238a9e72ce03e1bb677a2b78ebb9d64.png[/img]

[i][b]“Surrender to the Queen”

Everlasting winters of solitude have hardened her into perfect coldness. She has only one desire: death. The cold that has taken everything from her will swallow her whole one day... She waits without knowing when.[/b][/i]

“Rhynara” is a Water & Light dual-type Ranged Support with a Wand & Orb. She inflicts “Frostbite” on enemies, restricting their movement and leaving them vulnerable so her allies can attack efficiently. Rhynara's Normal Skill “Reign of the Blizzard” unleashes a powerful whirlwind at an enemy's location, attacking them and increasing the level of the Frostbite effect to incapacitate them. Her Signature Skill “Eternal Winter” drops chunks of ice over a wide area, dealing DMG to targets it hits and continuously increasing the Frostbite level of enemies, turning the tide of battle in her allies’ favor

* ASTRA: Knights of Veda Season 2 introduces a new story, “Tears of the Goddess”!
 - The journey to find Veda’s Heart continues with “Tears of the Goddess”!  Travel to the Principality of Koren to search for the whereabouts of Edward who escaped with the white dragon Vasily at the end of Season 1’s story quest. However, numerous enemies block the Master of the Book’s path, including elements of the “Titans Army” and members of the “Enchanted Warriors”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0f233fe4921ae55146853aa138e1e62fa7be89d4.jpg[/img]
* The new story “Tears of the Goddess” can be experienced by going to the new Adventure Zones “Chapter 8, A City Shrouded in Silence” and “Chapter 9, A Land of Truth and Wisdom.”
 - You will be able to enter the new “Chapter 8, A City Shrouded in Silence” Adventure Zones by completing the Ascension Mission which is available after clearing Chapter 7, Stage 12, and reaching Master of the Book Level 55.
 - With the addition of the new Adventure Zones, the new areas “Shivering Nightmare Warship” and “Lightning Nightmare Palace” will be added to Veda’s Nightmare.
 - You will be able to obtain various Enhance and Ascension materials as well as new exclusive Relics in the new Adventure area and Veda's Nightmare.

* The adventure level cap is increased from Level 8 to level 9.
 - As your Adventure Level increases, you will battle more powerful monsters in the Adventure Zones, Veda’s Nightmare, and Sealed Prison. In return, you will be able to get better rewards in the form of Relics and various enhancement materials.

* The Master of the Book Level, the levels of the Knights of Veda, and the Weapon Levels will be increased!
 - The Master of the Book Level will be increased from 55 to 60.
 - Achievement rewards are earned with each level increase of Masters of the Book, setting a standard for accessing future content.
 - The maximum level for Knights of Veda and for Weapons will be increased from 90 to 100, allowing you to enhance your Knights of Veda further.
 - Ascension Materials for the new level cap can be obtained from the new Adventure Zones, with the specific amount obtained increasing with your Adventure Level.

* The Fate Level of Knights of Veda and Weapon Refinement Level is expanded from a maximum of Level 6 to Level 7.
 - At Knights of Veda Fate Level 7, the primary stats of each Knight of Veda are enhanced, and a new Fate effect is granted, empowering them further in battle.
 - When Weapon Refinement reaches Level 7, the weapon's main stats are increased, along with improved values for existing weapon skills.

* New Mythical (6★) Relics and Accessories will be introduced!
 - The Mythical-grade equipment being introduced is an advanced tier of existing gear, retaining the same set effects but with increased stats. Additionally, equipping multiple Mythical sets grants enhanced set effects based on the number of Mythical-grade items equipped.
 - Relic and Accessory set effects apply uniformly, even when equipped with lower-grade Relics or Accessories of the same type.
 - As with lower-grade Relics, the set effect remains active when equipped, though at reduced effect values depending on the number of items worn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0b0f826f56bed230718df78b154a2a5aef0cfb3a.jpg[/img]

 - For example, if you equipped 3 Mythic-grade and 2 Legendary-grade Relics from the Silent Slave Knight set, the 2-set effect will have Mythic-grade values while the 4-set effect will have Legendary-grade values.

* Mythic-grade Relics can be obtained as rewards for clearing Veda’s Nightmare areas at Adventure Level 9.
 - You will also have a chance to obtain Mythic-grade Relics when crafting Legendary-grade Relics.
 - Mythic Grade Accessories can be obtained from Portrait of Thierry Floors 28 to 36.

* Four new Relic sets will be added.
 - Four new Relic sets will be added to the game in order to increase the options our Master of the Book has in making their builds.
 - The newly added four types of Relic sets are also obtainable at the Mythical grade by clearing Veda's Nightmare.
 - These new Relic sets can be obtained by bosses in the new Adventure Zone and from Veda's Nightmare.

* After the 10/31 Maintenance, the Trophy Reward Information for the Adventure Zones will be reset.

* You will now be able to enter battle either in Normal Battle or in Squad Battle Mode. 
 - Before entering a stage on the Adventure Zone, on Veda’s Nightmare and on Sealed Prisons, you will now be able to select whether you want to start the Normal Battle or as a Squad Battle.
 - Squad Battles refer to battles in which the selected Knights of Veda fight simultaneously with only one of them being directly controlled by you.

* A new World Map can now be accessed, allowing you to see the places beyond the Kingdom of Neejarem, like the Principality of Koren.
 - Please look forward to the adventures that will unfold with the new World Map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d9c4a5e1db9fa36827927aa19c447638bcfa481b.jpg[/img]

* To celebrate the release of the second season of ASTRA: Knights of Veda “Tears of the Goddess”, we have prepared the following:
 - The “Salvation in the Blizzard” event will be held where, during the event period, you can log-in for seven days and obtain Crystal of Destiny x100 and the new Mascot “Mr. Pumpkin”.
   · The “Salvation in the Blizzard” event will end after the regular maintenance on 12/26.
 - The “Off to the Principality of Koren!” event will also be held where you can complete various missions on the new Adventure Zones and obtain various enhancement materials.
   · The “Off to the Principality of Koren!” event will end after the regular maintenance on 12/26.
 - Complete missions and you will be able to obtain various rewards, specifically the “The Joy of Weapons (Weapon Selection Ticket)” and Starstone in the  “The Rewards for Pushing the Limits” event.
   · The “The Rewards for Pushing the Limits” event will end after the regular maintenance on 12/26.
 - Masters of the Book who have been with us since Season 1 and has completed all of its Story Quests will be given the 5★ Knight of Veda “Death Crown” as part of the “The Sword Against Fate” event.
   · Masters of the Book who have cleared Chapter 7, Stage 12 of the Adventure Zone will be able to claim the 5★ Knight of Veda “Death Crown” on the “Sword Against Fate” event page.
   · This event will be held permanently and rewards for this event will be given only once.

* The event Call of the Stars “Destiny Guided by the Stars” and “Weapons Awakened Under the Stars” will feature the event limited Knights of Veda released during Season 1 alongside their exclusive weapons. 
 - During the Pickup Event Period, you will be able to access two Call of the Stars pages: “Destiny Guided by Stars”, which allows you to summon Knights of Veda from Season 1 and “Weapons Awakened Under the Stars”, which allows you to summon their respective exclusive weapons.
 - On each of their respective Call of the Stars pages, you can choose the specific Knight of Veda or Exclusive Weapon you wish to summon, and they will be summoned with the same probabilities as their previous Call of the Stars appearances.

-  In both "Destiny Guided by the Stars" and "Weapons Awakened Under the Stars," all 4★ Knights of Veda and Weapons released up to Season 1 will appear with equal probability.

 - This event will also include similar Pickup events for “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting”, allowing you to summon Halo’s and El Cid’s for all Season 1 Knights of Veda, including new Signature Halos and El Cids for Knights that previously did not have one.
 - “Destiny Guided by the Stars” and “Weapons Awakened Under the Stars” events will end after the regular maintenance on 11/28.

* The participation approach for the "Beast Battlefront" content will be revised to improve convenience.
 - Starting this season, "Beast Battlefront" content will be held two times per season, with updates occurring every month.
   · The duration of the first round of "Beast Front" will be extended from 7 days to 12 days, followed by a 2-day settlement period.
   · The duration of the event will stay the same, but the settlement period might be modified according to the schedule.
   · After the settlement, the second round will open and will proceed for 12 days, followed by a 2-day settlement, just like the previous round.
   · The bosses appearing in a single season of 'Beast Battlefront' will remain the same, but the buffs/debuffs will change for each round.
   · With the introduction of the second round, the reward amount per round will be reduced compared to the previous season, but the total amount of rewards will increase.
 - A practice mode will be introduced, allowing players to experiment with different combinations before joining the "Beast Battlefront"
   · The practice mode will only be available during the "Beast Battlefront" event period.
 - The results screen for "Beast Battlefront" will be enhanced to show the top scores earned by the Masters of the Book.
 - The Overflowing Power of the Stars mechanic will not be activated in "Beast Battlefront."

* Convenience features will be added to the "Training Grounds."
 - A new feature that allows users to modify the selected Knights of Veda directly within the Training Grounds.
 - A new feature to track the battle time starting from the moment the battle commences.
 - Images of the Knights of Veda have been included to facilitate easier identification of the chosen Knight of Veda.

* The "Beast BattleFront" season will be renewed.
 - This new season introduces the Fire-type boss, "Black Prince of Death."
 - The "Beast Battlefront" boss's HP and defense stats have been increased compared to the previous season.
 - Starting this season, the "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
   · 1st Round: 10/31 to 11/11 / Settlement: 11/12 to 11/13 
   · 2nd Round: 11/14 to 11/25 / Settlement: 11/26 to 11/27

* A 5★ Enchant Scroll will be added.
 - The 5★ Enchantment Scroll can be obtained as rewards from various events and can also be purchased with Gold and Rubies from the shop.

* Shattered Dimensional Rift event
 - Earn Guild Kill rewards and Individual Kill rewards based on the number of Rogue One defeated with your guild members. Guild Defeat rewards include Insignias in addition to other rewards.
 - The "Shattered Dimensional Rift" event will end on 11/21 06:00 AM UTC / 11/20 10:00 PM PST.

* A Double Rewards event for Adventure Zone rewards will be held.
 - During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Zone up to the daily limit.
 - The double rewards event for Adventure Zone will run from 10/31, after maintenance until 11/14 6:00 AM UTC / 11/13 10:00 PM PST.

* The "Blessing in Nightmare" event will be held, allowing you to earn double rewards from Veda's Nightmare.
 - During the "Blessing in Nightmare" event, you can receive double rewards from Veda's Nightmare up to the daily limit.
 - The "Blessing in Nightmare" event will run from 11/14 until before the 11/28 regular maintenance.

* The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will reward you for helping Harold with research materials.
 - Collect materials Harold requires to write his research log from the Adventure Zone stages and submit them to him in Todburg to receive rewards.
 - The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will be unlocked progressively, with one log entry opening each day, and you can check your progress in the Research Log.
 - The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will run from 11/14 until before the 11/28 regular maintenance.

* Another "Apparition’s Rush" will be held, will you be able to escort a carriage through several nightmares?
 - The "Apparition’s Rush" event is a Squad Battle event tasking you to escort a carriage through a nightmare with four other Knights of Veda in a “Special Supply Delivery Operation”.
 - The “Apparition’s Rush” event can be unlocked by completing the “Escort the Carriage” quest that you will receive upon clearing Chapter 5, Stage 4 of the Adventure Zone. You can then access it via the new “Apparition’s Rush” icon at the bottom of the Cloister of the Holy Grail.
 - A Nightmare Boss not present in the “Special Supply Delivery Operation” event will be added to “Apparition’s Rush” alongside a couple of more powerful buffs.
 - The “Apparition’s Rush” event will run from 11/14 until before the 11/28 regular maintenance.

* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.
 - After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
 - The new Portrait of Thierry season will end after the regular maintenance on 11/28.

* A new Tower of Trials season begins.
 - The completion rates for the "Tower of Trials," which consists of floors 9 through 12, will be reset, and new "Quest Blessings" and "Goddess's Arrangement" will be applied.
 - The new Tower of Trials season will end after the regular maintenance on 11/28.

* A new season of Arena will begin. (Updated: 10/30 10:25 PM PDT / 10/31 5:25 AM UTC)
 - During Arena Season 5, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.
 - The Season 2 rewards will also be available for purchase in the shop during Arena Season 5.
 - Arena Season 5 will end after the regular maintenance on 11/28.

* A new Reward Decree season will start.
 - The new Reward Decree season will begin right after the update on 10/31, and will continue until 11/30 6:00 AM UTC / 11/29 10:00 PM PST.

* The "Journey in Memory (Rhynara Trial)" event will be held.
 - During this Trial event, you can try out Knights of Veda: 5★ Rhynara, 4★ Lucian, and 4★ Leon.
 - The "Journey in Memory (Rhynara Trial)" event will end after the regular  maintenance on 11/28.

* Changes to the way Lost Items are generated and the rewards given. (Updated 11/1 05:30 AM UTC / 10/31 10:30 PM PDT)
- Three (3) Lost Items will now be generated once a day.
- The rewards obtained from Lost Items have been increased by more than double, with higher quality rewards possible due to lower probabilities.

[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]
* The Wander Store, Grocery Store, Sundries Store, Weapon Store, and Arena Store will undergo reorganization.
 - The shop refresh cycle will be changed from Daily to Monthly.
 - The purchase limit for the Wandering Merchant will be reset after each regular maintenance.

notes.title: Development Team’s Responses on Season 2 Update Direction
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book. I am Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Season 2 of ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on 10/31, and as we’re gearing up for that, we would like to sincerely thank everyone for the feedback you gave during Season 1. Thanks to this feedback, we made ASTRA: Knights of Veda a better game for everyone.

Through this letter, we would like to let our Masters of the Book know about the direction we would like to take on your feedback for the announced Season 2 changes.

We have carefully reviewed every feedback given regarding the changes coming to Season 2. In particular, the expansion of Fate levels to Level 7. We have received various concerns that the change may feel more like a burden than a source of joy.

We sincerely apologize for any disappointment this has caused as I, in particular, feel a significant sense of responsibility towards this specific change. While our goal with this change was to enhance the fun and challenge of the game, we understand the frustration that this might cause and thus we would like to present the following measures to alleviate the burden of leveling up to Fate Level 7.


[h3][b]1. Based on the number of the times you use Pickups All Out summons, you will now be able to choose and acquire a bonus “Season 1 5★ Pickup Hero/Exclusive Weapon.”[/b][/h3]

First, we would like to explain how Pickups All Out works. This Call of the Star summon will feature two types, one for [Knight of Veda from Season 1] and another for [Exclusive Weapon from Season 1].

On the Pickup menu, there will now be tabs where you can select which Knight or Weapon you wish to summon.

[Image example] 
* The example image is from a development environment, and the content of some images may change upon live service.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/48e5f5d34699125be8939c5a6c05b3256cd6a7a8.png[/img]

You will be able to select and acquire a Season 1 Pickup as a bonus once 300 “Pickups All Out” summons are reached.

For example, if you summon for Nec 220 times and for Ellen Farrell 80 times in the Pickups All Out menu for [Knight of Veda from Season 1], reaching a total of 300, you will be able to choose one “Season 1 5★ Pickup Knight of Veda” as a bonus. This bonus can be repeatedly obtained every time you reach the required number of summons.

The same applies to the Exclusive Weapons, although the summon counts for the bonus will be counted separately for [Knight of Veda from Season 1] and [Exclusive Weapon from Season 1]. However, please be informed that summon counts Knights of Veda/Exclusive Weapon Call of the Stars for the first Season 2 Pickups will be shared.
- Summon counts for the bonus will be shared between “Pickups All Out: Season 1 Knights of Veda” and “Season 2 First Pickup Knights of Veda”.
- Summon counts for the bonus will be shared between “Pickups All Out: Season 1 Exclusive Weapons” and “Season 2 First Pickup Exclusive Weapons”.

By providing bonus rewards, we aim to reduce the tediousness of trying to repeatedly summon all the while making it easier for our Masters of the Book to obtain their desired Knights.


[h3][b]2. We will now be providing three (3) additional  “Season 1 5★ Pickup Hero Selection Ticket” to help our Masters of the Book achieve Fate Level 7 for their characters.[/b][/h3]

As mentioned previously, we would like to sincerely apologize for the frustration caused by the announcement of the expansion to Fate Level 7. To address this, in addition to the changes outlined above, we will now also be providing three (3) additional “Season 1 5★ Pickup Hero Selection Tickets.”

Originally, we planned to give one “Season 1 5★ Pickup Hero Selection Tickets” as a Season 2 Pre-Registration Reward. With this change, users who Pre-Registered will now receive a total of four (4) “Season 1 5★ Pickup Hero Selection Tickets” at the start of Season 2.

With the addition of bonus rewards from the “Pickups All Out” and the additional selection tickets, we aim to allow you to be more flexible in choosing your Knights of Veda and reduce the difficulty of leveling up to Fate Level 7. In the future, we will strive to reflect your feedback more carefully and deliver a more enjoyable and satisfying experience.

Once again, we would like to apologize for any inconvenience caused. We will strive to be more thoughtful in incorporating your feedback in our decisions so that we can provide a more enjoyable and satisfying experience.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude once again to all the Masters of the Book who continue to show their love and support. 


In Season 2, various rewards will be available through numerous events, and the ASTRA: Knights of Veda development team will always do its best to repay your support with heartfelt appreciation.

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Team’s Responses to Your 10/2 Update Comments and Questions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book. I am Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

On 10/2 we released an update introducing the new gamemode, Beast Battlefront, alongside the Knight of Veda Bikki.

We have gathered your feedback regarding this update and would like to assure our Masters of the Book of our commitment to improve.

Following this update, we will respond to comments received through various channels in sequence.


[h3][b]1. “I’m satisfied with the addition of new PvE content that provides weekly rewards based on rank, as it provides additional motivation. However, it would be good if more products would be available at the Beast Battlefront Shop. In addition, a function to view the Knights setup of those in the leaderboards like in Battlefield of the War Gods should be added.[/b][/h3]

The Development Team has identified several areas that need improvement for Beast Battlefront. Rest assured that we are hard at work working on this and the other issues mentioned.

In particular, Beast Battlefront Season 2 will introduce various strategic elements to help players achieve higher records. We are carefully considering not only balance, but also ways to make the gameplay more engaging, such as adjusting battle time, difficulty levels, and the utilization of buffs and debuffs in determining what adjustments are to be made.

We are also preparing a practice mode that allows you to access Beast Battlefront related content without using up “Guiding Lantern”. We will also be improving the user experience, by updating the results screen to now show both your current and best record in addition to, as suggested, a function to view the Knights setup of those in the leaderboards. 

With all this in mind, Beast Battlefront is just the beginning as we plan to add more ranking-type PvE end-game content in the future such as Celestial Trials, World Boss and Guild Boss during Season 2 alongside PvP content such as Tournament Battle.


[h3][b]2. While 5★ Knights of Veda have been released every update, we have noticed that ever since Death Crown all released have been female. Are there any male Knights of Veda in the works?[/b][/h3]

Male Knights of Veda currently slated for release include Aslan Liongray and Asha, the leader of the Liongrays and one of the Shadows of the Dark Night.

We are also still continuing to think about adding more male Knights of Veda, pulling from the game’s vast lore for characters to base the new Knights on.



[h3][b]3. With the limited daily supply of Adventurer's Shoes, it's difficult to obtain the desired relics and the necessary skill materials simultaneously. It would be helpful if a replacement function for skill upgrade materials could be introduced, similar to the replace feature for knight ascension materials and weapon ascension materials.[/b][/h3]

We completely understand your concern and will work to address this as quickly as possible.

In the next update, we will introduce a skill upgrade material replacement function and improve accessibility by making skill upgrade materials obtainable through shops and events, in addition to Veda's Nightmare.


[h3][b]4. The appearance of the mascots that can be obtained from the  “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” event looks unique. Are there any plans to add new ones besides “Treasure Keeper” and “Coco”?[/b][/h3]


We will continue to add more mascots and are planning for fun designs that reflect the seasons and various holidays. We will do our best to present them to you in a satisfactory manner. 


This is an overview of what Masters of the Book users might be curious about regarding the upcoming update. 

On 10/31, Season 2 of ASTRA: Knights of Veda, titled ‘Tears of the Goddess,’ will be released, featuring a new story, a new area, and a level cap expansion.

Fate and weapon refining levels will also be expanded, and with this increase, the opportunity to increase the power of your Knights are provided.

For Masters of the Book who have maxed out their Knight’s Fate levels and have at some point received at least one more duplicate copy from Call of the Stars, it will be counted retroactively and an additional copy of the Knight of Veda will be provided so that you can upgrade the Knight to Fate Level 7 immediately.

In addition, we plan to provide an additional “Weapon’s Oblivion”, which can reset the enhancements made to weapons, to all Masters of the Book. We hope this will be an opportunity to quickly secure the materials needed to upgrade a weapon to Refinement Level 7, in addition to rewarding all your efforts as you take on the new challenges brought about by Season 2.

Additionally, Oblivion items, which allow for the reset of Accessory and Tunic enhancements will be added, along with various exciting events. Other content previously mentioned will be rolled out sequentially.

We appreciate your continued anticipation and support.

We're working hard to bring you an even more thrilling adventure in Season 2 and will quickly share the post-update roadmap. 

Thank you!

notes.title: 10/2 Patch Details (Updated 10/2 09:07 AM PDT / 10/2 02:07 AM UTC)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9120f46e53b03b71dc0440b3f0c05cee4e8fd20f.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book!

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on October 2, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ A new 5★ Knight of Veda “Bikki” will now be available![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/aa13ef6ecc0550c75bf23a38ac016ab562f8a7c1.png[/img]

[b][i]“Don't order me around! How dare you?”[/i]

Misfortune always followed her like a shadow. Fighting back tears in a pile of garbage, the girl vowed to herself that she would bring all those who laughed at her to their knees. Now Bikki has the power to prove it, but she hasn't found a way to redeem herself.[/b]

* “Bikki” is a Poison-type Melee DPS with a Large Club, capable of powerful combat through demonization. Her Normal Skill “Poisoned Blow” allows her to move forward and swing the massive club at enemies in front of her, striking them with a quick blow that nearly kills them. Her Signature Skill “Superior Awakening” sucks enemies into a powerful vortex of poison with her massive club, dealing heavy DMG as "Bikki" takes them down in a demonized form that maximizes her fighting abilities.


* New Content: Beast Battlefront
 - “Beast Battlefront” is a new end-game “Squad Battle” content where you need to defeat powerful bosses as quickly as possible and obtain rewards based on your ranking.
 - You can access “Beast Battlefront” by talking to the NPC Licorice after clearing Chapter 4, Stage 12 of the Adventure Zone.
 - Each challenge of the “Beast Battlefront” requires 1 “Guiding Lantern”, of which three is given per day. You can then choose from one of the five difficulty levels with the 5 members of the Knights of Veda party you wish to accompany you.
 - You are given 30 minutes to defeat the boss and each party can participate in the battle for up to 2 minutes.
 - If the party participating in the battle fails to defeat the boss within 2 minutes, they can continue the battle by forming a new team of the Knights of Veda, while the boss's health and wounds remain as they were at the time of failure.
   · Knights of Veda who belonged to a party that were unable to defeat the boss during the 2 minute window cannot be selected to be part of the next party, though they can be selected once again for a retry.
 - After defeating the boss, you will receive a reward and a ranking awarded to you based on your clear score and time bonus. This ranking will be recorded in a season ranking leaderboard.
   · Additional ranking rewards will be awarded based on your ranking at the end of the season.
 - The first Beast Battlefront season will end on 10/9 06:00 AM UTC / 10/8 11:00 PM PDT.

* New Content: Training Grounds
 - You can enter the new Training Grounds through the World Map and from the Belle menu after reaching Level 35 and completing the corresponding Ascension Mission for that level. 
 - You can then choose to enter into Regular or Squad Battles.
 - Buttons to adjust stats and resistances, reset skill cooldowns, and others are provided so that you can check the combat power according to various situations.
 - You can check the accumulated damage and also the average DPS (Damage per second).

* New Feature: Equipment Presets
 - The ‘Equipment Presets’ function allows you to save the Accessories and Relics currently equipped by Knights of Veda into a desired slot and share the saved Relics with other Knights of Veda.
 - This is expected to make farming for accessories and relics easier than before.
 - This function can be accessed via a newly added icon above the currently equipped Relics.
 - Before finalizing your Equipment Preset, you can click the “Compare” button to compare it with the set currently equipped and then choose whether to apply it.
 - You can register up to 30 Equipment Presets, which you can assign names to.

* New Event: Distorted Rift
 - The “Distorted Rift” event features the same content style as the guild-exclusive “Shattered Dimensional Rift”, allowing all users, including Guild Members, to participate.
 - You will be able to access Distorted Rift via the portal at the entrance to Todburg that will appear after you clear Chapter 7, Stage 12 of the Adventure Zone.
 - Similar to “Shattered Dimensional Rift”, players will have to defeat waves of powerful enemies, earning rewards based on their performance.
 - The “Distorted Rift” event will end after the regular maintenance on 10/31.

* New Event: Apparition’s Rush
 - A new event called “Apparition’s Rush” is introduced, tasking you to escort a carriage through a nightmare with the other 4 Knights of Veda in a “Special Supply Delivery Operation”.
 - The “Apparition’s Rush” event can be unlocked by completing the “Escort the Carriage” quest that you will receive upon clearing Chapter 5, Stage 4 of the Adventure Zone. You can then access it via the new “Apparition’s Rush” icon at the bottom of the Cloister of the Holy Grail.
 - New nightmare boss monsters that are not present in the Special Supply Delivery Operation will be added, and a new set of stronger buffs will also be added.
 - The “Apparition’s Rush” event will end after the regular maintenance on 10/31.

* The Support Knight function will now be available in “Ancient Golden City”.
 - To help with the perceived difficulty of Ancient Golden City, the Support Knight function will now also be available to use.
 - This feature can be accessed via the newly added Support icon before starting Ancient Golden City dungeons.
 - You can take advantage of this feature three times a week.

* Better, more colorful Guild Flag customization will be introduced.
 - To showcase your Guild’s personality better, you are now able to select different, more vibrant colors for the background and emblem of the Guild Flag.
 - Changes to the Guild Flag can be made through the “Change Guild Flag” menu in Guild Management, and new Guilds can confirm this upon setting their Guild Flag.
 - The cost for changing the Guild Flag has been adjusted from Rubies x100 to Gold x10,000.
   · Rubies used from 9/1 until the regular maintenance on 10/2 will be refunded via in-game mail due to this change.

* A new emoticon will be added to express the gratitude of the "ASTRA: Knights of Veda" director to all the Masters of the Book.

* Simon is giving away more gifts! “Simon's Amazing Gifts!” event is back.
 - You can participate in the event at your Guild Territory at 8:00 PM based on server time on Thursdays. Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays during the event period.
 - At the designated time, a “Fearsome Treasure Chest” will appear in the Guild Territory
   · When the “Fearsome Treasure Chest” is defeated, 30 Treasure Chests will be dropped and one of these can be opened per Guild Member.
 - In this “Simon's Amazing Gifts!” event, you can obtain the new mascot "Coco" along with various other rewards.
 - The “Simon's Amazing Gifts!” event will conclude after the regular maintenance on 10/31.

* The "Blessing in Adventure" event is back to shower everyone with more rewards!
 - During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Dungeons up to the daily limit.
 - The double rewards event for Adventure Dungeons will run from October 2, 2024 after maintenance until October 16, 2024 11:00 PM PDT / October 17, 2024 6:00 AM UTC.

* Nightmares have never been so bountiful! The "Blessing in Nightmare" event returns.
 - During the "Blessing in Nightmare" event, you can receive double rewards from Veda's Nightmare up to the daily limit.
 - The "Blessing in Nightmare" event will run from after the maintenance on 10/17 until before the 10/31 maintenance.

* The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will reward you for helping Harold with research materials.
 - Collect materials Harold requires to write his research log from the Adventure Dungeons and submit them to him in Todburg to receive rewards.
 - The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will be unlocked progressively, with one log entry opening each day, and you can check your progress in the Research Log.
 - The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will end after the regular maintenance on 10/31.

* The "Black Mutation" will appear in the Nightmare regions.
 - The “Black Mutation” event in the Nightmare Dungeon will feature anomalies occurring in specific Nightmare areas every [strike]3 days[/strike]4 days during the event period.  (Updated 10/2 09:07 AM PDT / 10/2 02:07 AM UTC)
 - “Black Mutation” will end before the 10/31 maintenance.

* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.
 - After regular maintenance, monsters differing in attributes from those in the previous seasons will appear in the stages of “Portrait of Thierry.”
 - The new season of "Portrait of Thierry" will end after the regular maintenance on 10/31.

* A new Tower of Trials season begins
 - The completion rates for the "Tower of Trials," which consists of floors 9 through 12, will be reset, and new "Quest Blessings" and "Goddess's Arrangement" will be applied.
 - The new Tower of Trials season will end after the maintenance on 10/31.

* The "Journey in Memory (Bikki Trial)" event will be held.
 - During this Trial event, you can try out Knights of Veda: 5★ Bikki, 5★ Xanthia, 4★ Emile, and 4★ Rani.
 - The "Journey in Memory (Bikki Trial)" event will end after the maintenance on 10/31.

* The Knight of Veda “Bjorn” and the weapon "Battleaxe of Severance" will now be available for summoning in the "Call of the Stars: Fallen Wing of Veda" event following an upcoming improvement.
 - However, it will not be included in the “Start the Call of the Stars” and “Knight's First Leap” events.

[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]
* The method in which the difficulty level displays has been improved to help differentiate between different difficulty settings in Ancient Golden City.

* The notifications will now be provided when new posts are added to the Guild Forum.

* The critical damage will now be reduced depending on the value of the 'Tenacity' stat.
- When the 'Tenacity' value reaches 5,000, critical damage should be reduced by 50%. As the 'Tenacity' values climb over 5,000, the efficiency of critical damage reduction gradually decreases.

* Adjustment to 5★ Standard Weapons:.
 - The weapon skill ‘Bloody Determination’ of ‘A Noble Will’ is adjusted to increase both Attack Power and DEF based on maximum HP.

 - The weapon skill ‘Slaughter’ of ‘Unlimited Will to Fight’ has been modified to inflict AoE damage according to the equipped Knights’ attribute when an enemy is killed.

 - The weapon skill ‘Winning Streaks’ of  ‘The Conqueror's Wings’ has been adjusted to deal AoE damage according to the equipped Knights’ attribute when hitting enemies.

 - An additional effect for the ‘Symbol of Curse’ skill ‘Overreaction’ will be added.
　· When hitting a resistant enemy, damage will be increased by 20% / 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% / 45% / 50%.
 - An additional effect for the ‘Sword of the Red Moon’ skill ‘Fighter’s Child’ will be added.
　· When the maximum of 10 stacks is reached, 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50 / 55 Veda Energy will be restored instantly, with the ATK increase now lasting for 15s. (When there are 10 stacks, the buff does not disappear even when you are hit.) 
 - An additional effect for the ‘A Freezing Prospect’ skill ‘Wound Infliction’ will be added.
　· Attacking an enemy with the Bleeding status effect will now increase your Lifesteal Rate by 40% / 50% / 60% / 70% / 80% / 90% / 100%.
 - An additional effect for the ‘Holy Sword of Unir’ skill ‘Blessing for Protection’ will be added.
　· When the ‘‘Blessing for Protection’ skill is activated, Reduces Incoming DMG by 5% / 6.7% / 8.4% / 10.1% / 11.8% / 13.5% / 15.2% for 5 seconds.
 - The amount of HP restored upon defeating an enemy by ‘The Guillotine of Bachram’ skill ‘Life Absorption’ will be increased by 6.2% / 7.4% / 8.6% / 9.8% / 11% / 12.2% / 13.4%.
 - The ‘Unshakeable Faith’ weapon skill for ‘Bud of Grudge’ will be adjusted to now deal AoE damage when equipped.
 - The stat increase for ‘The Beginning of Tragedy’s skill ‘Child of Violence’ based on Refinement Lv.
 - The stat increase for ‘Salvation of Apecatina’s skill ‘Enchantment’ based on Refinement Lv.

* The following previously mentioned improvements will be made on future updates. We sincerely apologize for any confusion this may have caused. (Updated: 10/2 6:00 AM UTC / 10/1 11:00 PM PDT)
 - An additional effect for the ‘A Freezing Prospect’ skill ‘Wound Infliction’ will be added.
   · Attacking an enemy with the Bleeding status effect will now increase your Lifesteal Rate by 40% / 50% / 60% / 70% / 80% / 90% / 100%.
 - An additional effect for the ‘Holy Sword of Unir’ skill ‘Blessing for Protection’ will be added.
   · When the ‘‘Blessing for Protection’ skill is activated, Reduce Incoming DMG by 5% / 6.7% / 8.4% / 10.1% / 11.8% / 13.5% / 15.2% for 5 seconds.
 - An additional effect for the ‘Celestial Globe of Magic’ skill ‘Endless Fury’ will be added.
   · Damage received from resistant enemies will be reduced by 8% / 10% / 12% / 14% / 16% / 18% / 20%. 
 - The weapon skill “Bloody Cheers“ of “Origin of the Storm” is adjusted to reduce enemies ATK Speed and Stamina upon hitting the enemy while increasing the Knight’s ATK Speed and Stamina.

* The throw range of Knight of Veda 'Rebecca's Normal Skill 'A Pleasant Golden Shield' has been increased. (Updated: 10/2 6:00 AM UTC / 10/1 11:00 PM PDT)
* The Shield Bounce range of Knight of Veda 'Rebecca's Normal Skill 'A Pleasant Golden Shield' has been increased when used. (Updated: 10/2 6:00 AM UTC / 10/1 11:00 PM PDT)
* The angle at which the shield recognizes enemies when using Knight of Veda 'Rebecca's Normal Skill 'A Pleasant Golden Shield' has been widened. (Updated: 10/2 6:00 AM UTC / 10/1 11:00 PM PDT)


[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
* An issue where Active Resistance would activate earlier than usual after receiving DoT will be fixed.
* An issue where the effect of sharing the damage received from summoned creature 'Roderick,' belonging to Knights of Veda's 'Nec,' does not disappear if Roderick dies while floating in the air will be fixed.
* An issue where Elemental Advantage was applied to only one Elemental DMG type for certain dual-elemental boss monsters (Butcher of the Abyss / Black Prince of Death) will be fixed.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.

* Compensation for issue with Veleno’s Signature Skill:
 - Item: Starstones x300
 - Distribution Period: 
 　· September 12, 2024 after the maintenance - September 18, 2024 02:59 PM (UTC) 
 　· September 12, 2024 after the maintenance - September 18, 2024 07:59 AM (PDT)
 - Details:
 　· When using Veleno's Signature Skill, the backward movement during the attack motion often caused a loss in damage output. On the 8/22 Update, Veleno’s combat balance was increased and the issue of the backward movement affecting damage output was improved.
　· However, it has been confirmed that this information was not included in the update announcement and so we are making this additional information available.

　※ Additional Information: Veleno will no longer move backward when using her Signature Skill.
　　[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2484250/view/6849498317546579256?l=english][Click here for the 8/22 Update Patch Notes][/url]

We apologize for any confusion caused during gameplay. We will make every effort to ensure that such omissions do not occur in the future and to provide accurate information.

[h3][b]■ How to Obtain the Rewards[/b][/h3]
* Access Belle Menu → Mail → Receive Items
* The mail and items will expire within 7 days.
* Make sure to log in to the game during the distribution period in order to obtain the rewards.
* If you cannot find the rewards in your mail, please restart the game. 

[h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3]
* During the maintenance, both PC and Mobile versions will be inaccessible, and the Coupon page will also be unavailable. 
* Maintenance time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
 Any changes will be announced in this notice. 
* To ensure that your game data remains safe, please make sure to close the game before maintenance begins. 

Once the maintenance has been completed, further information will be provided through this notice.

Thank you.
