[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9120f46e53b03b71dc0440b3f0c05cee4e8fd20f.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book! 

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on September 12, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game. 

[h3][b]■ A new 5★ Knight of Veda “Rebecca” will now be available![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2660faddd57e9dea64d7930b4b336e4c1ccf37ae.png[/img]
[b][i]“Where’s the enemy? Leave it to me!”[/i]

As Orlik's adopted daughter and Marthel's biological daughter, she takes after Orlik's exuberance and Marthel's determination. However, the source of her boundless passion remains a mystery. Some argue that her fervent enthusiasm can be overwhelming at times, but her inner fire never allows her to give up. While her intense zeal may occasionally lead her down the wrong path, she will never surrender and will continue her adventures[/b]

“Rebecca” is a Fire-type Melee Tank wielding a Club & Shield. She shields her allies from projectile attacks while incapacitating enemies by reflecting fire damage back at them with their own projectiles. Her Normal Skill, “A Pleasant Golden Shield,” thrusts a series of shields at nearby enemies, inflicting burn damage and stunning them by chance, restricting their actions. Her Signature Skill, "Breath of Flames," reduces projectile damage taken by allies while reflecting fire damage back at enemies, turning their own attacks against them and leading to their defeat

[h3][b]■ A new 4★ Knight of Veda “Shikh” will now be available![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/8858a67d8de48b0828bb531e5acfe29d671c94a6.png[/img]
[b][i]“Batar of Vulcan has come! May the great plains bless you!”[/i]

He is known throughout Planis as the leader of the Batar, having dedicated his life to protecting Vulcan. Even those who are not knights hold him in high esteem, recognizing his noble nature. Born to protect the Royal Household of the Crown, his unwavering loyalty remains steadfast. He will forever serve as the sword of the Crown Royal Family, defending Vulcan [/b]

“Shikh” is a Light-type Ranged Support wielding a Small Bow, engaging in various customized battles through rapid projectile firing and dagger ATKs. Normal Skill “Moonlight Stomp” enables evasion while attacking enemies. Signature Skill “Dawn under the Moonlight” deals DMG to enemies by descending a shower of wide-area arrows, simultaneously amplifying incoming damage and aiding allies in battle

* The available floors for "Portrait of Thierry" will be expanded from 27 floors to 36th floors.
 - With the expansion to the 36th floor, you can challenge higher difficulty levels and have the opportunity to earn greater rewards upon clearing them.
 - If you have previously cleared up to the 27th floor on your past "Portrait of Thierry" runs, you are now able to choose between starting at the 1st Floor and progressing up to the 27th Floor or from the 10th Floor to the 36th floor each week when "Portrait of Thierry" resets on Thursday.
 - Additionally, based on the highest floor you have reached in your past "Portrait of Thierry" runs, you will now “breakthrough” some floors, immediately obtaining the rewards on the affected floors and starting your run on the first available floor.
　· To start from a higher floor, you must clear floors 18, 27, and 36 in "Portrait of Thierry." After the reset, you can now begin from the 10th, 19th, or 28th floor respectively.
　　: If you clear the 36th floor and then choose the "1st to 27th floors" option in the difficulty selection, you will start from the 19th floor instead of the 28th floor.
　　: This will be applied based on the highest floor you have cleared in Portrait of Thierry as of the 9/12 Update. 
　· When starting from a higher floor, you can choose and obtain any Grace, Accessory Set, or rewards that you missed on the lower floors.
　　: However, if you start from the "10th to 36th floors," rewards below the 9th floor will not be provided.

* The “Sweep” feature will be added to repeat daily content.
 - The “Sweep” feature allows you to obtain rewards without directly repeating daily content. This new function can be used where the daily reset content such as “Calydon Hideout”, “Forgotten Mine”, and “Knights Mission.”
 - The amount of rewards given when using the “Sweep” feature is based on the following criteria.
　· Calydon Hideout: Based on the highest kill record for each attribute in Calydon Hideout.
　· Forgotten Mine: Based on the highest number of acquired Enhancement Materials.
　· Knights Mission: Based on the completion reward for the accepted mission.
 - The sweeps for ‘Calydon Hideout’ and ‘Forgotten Mine’ can now be accessed through the newly added ‘Sweep’ button on the dungeon entry screen and the adventure guide. You can click the button to perform sweeps as many times as you have set.
 - You can use the “Sweep” feature on Knights Missions by selecting the “Sweep” button that appears after accepting the mission on the Knights Mission screen.

* “Auto Item Dismantling” feature will be added.
 - “Auto Item Dismantling” is a feature that automatically dismantles equipment obtained at a grade lower than the preset level for each equipment type for enhancement materials.
 - It can be checked by going to the Settings and then going to the “Automatic disassembly of items” tab.  You can then select the criteria under which the feature will function.
 - You can check the results of the dismantling process through the automatic dismantling results screen that will appear after the item acquisition screen.

* Enhancement materials will now be provided when dismantling all equipment types.
 - Initially, enhancement materials from dismantling can only be obtained when doing so on Relics. We have changed this so that when dismantling all equipment types will now yield the respective enhancement materials.
 - The amount of enhancement materials obtained when dismantling equipment is equivalent to the amount of EXP gained when using the equipment to be dismantled as refinement material.

* A feature allowing you to set whether or not each Knight of Veda uses their Strong ATK during auto-battle will be added.
 - You can find the toggle for each Knight of Veda's Strong ATK usage in the "Settings" menu, where you can adjust this setting for each Knight individually.
 - Only the Knights of Veda with strong attack usage enabled in the settings will use their Strong ATK during auto-battle.

* A feature will be added to automatically proceed with matchmaking in the Arena.
 - An "Auto-Matching" button will be displayed in the Arena, allowing you to automatically start matchmaking in your desired mode by selecting the button.
 - "Auto-Matching" will continue until the matchmaking is canceled, or until the daily Arena play limit of 100 matches is reached. Additionally, if a match is ended due to inactivity, "Auto-Matching" will end.

* The chat system will be improved to allow Masters of the Book to communicate more actively.
 - A new chat box will now be displayed in the lower-left corner of the game screen.
 - The chat box will allow you to view Guild (green), Party (blue), and Private (purple) conversations.
 - To ensure better communication for Masters of the Book of the same language, a feature will be added that allows the selection of a world channel by language.


* The Support Knight of Veda System will be improved.
 - The Gold received per Support Knight of Veda will be increased from 2,000 gold to 5,000 gold.
 - The number of daily reward claims available through Support Knight of Veda will be increased from 5 times to 10 times, allowing you to accumulate up to 20 rewards and earn a maximum of 100,000 Gold.
 - The level difference restriction for using other Masters’ Support Knight of Veda will be removed.

* A feature will be added that allows you to adjust the size of the damaged font displayed in battle.
 - A new menu will be added in the Settings to adjust the size of the damage numbers displayed during combat, allowing you to customize the font size.

* A "Claim All" button will be added to content with multiple rewards, enabling you to claim all rewards at once.
 - The "Claim All" button will be applied to the Guidance of the Book event rewards, progress rewards, and trophy reward pages.

* A "Claim All" button will also be added to the Item mailbox, allowing you to receive all purchased items at once.

* An icon will be added to the Adventure Guide that allows you to see more information about the topic on Noah’s Great Library at the Official Website.

* Information about the "Ancient Golden City" will be added to the Adventure Guide.

* Wishing you a joyful harvest moon festival with ASTRA: Knights of Veda! 🌕
 - Wishing you a joyful harvest moon festival, we're bringing in a series of exciting events packed with generous rewards. We hope that you have a prosperous and joyful moment with ASTRA: Knights of Veda!

 - Golden Sunset Festival Event
　· In celebration of this year's harvest, we're launching the Golden Sunset Festival event!
　· During the event,  you can collect Tri-color Half-moon Rice Cakes by clearing Adventure Dungeons
　· You can collect up to 10 Tri-color Half-moon Rice Cakes daily
　· These Tri-color Half-moon Rice Cakes can be used to enhance the stats of the Knights of Veda, and the rewards will be based on the number of rice cakes collected during the Golden Sunset Festival.
　· The event will end on 10/2, after the regular maintenance.

- Gift Filled to the Brim Event
　· The Gift Filled to the Brim Event brings the fun of the Harvest Moon Festival straight to you!
　· Log in daily for 7 days during the event period to receive Crystals of Destiny, Starstones, summoning currencies, and enhancement materials.
　· This event will end on 10/2, after the regular maintenance.

 - Fall Night Bathed in Moonlight Event
　· Join us in an adventurous mission event, Fall Night Bathed in Moonlight.
　· This event will end on 10/2, after the regular maintenance.

* Shattered Dimensional Rift Event
  - Team up with your guild in the Shattered Dimensional Rift event!
  - Enter the Rift through the Twisted Portal in your Guild Territory.
  - Earn Guild Kill rewards and Individual Kill rewards based on the number of Rogue Ones defeated with. Guild Kill rewards will include an Insignia reward.
  - The Individual Kill rewards for this event have been improved.
  - The difficulty of the Shattered Dimensional Rift has been adjusted, making it more accessible compared to previous events.
  - The event ends on 10/2, after the regular maintenance

* Harold's Lost Knowledge Event comes to you once again
 - Help Harold gather his research materials and earn a variety of rewards!
 - Collect materials Harold requires to write his research log from the Adventure Dungeons and submit them to him in Todburg to receive Starstones and Upgrade/Ascension materials.
 - The event will unlock new content daily, and you can check your progress in the Research Log.
 - This event will end on October 2, after the regular maintenance.

* The "Special Supply Delivery Operation" event will be held once again.
 - Each stage consists of 3 rounds, and you can acquire buffs upon entry and after completing the 1st and 2nd rounds of combat.
 - If you successfully complete the supply transport, you will receive rewards.
 - The "Special Supply Delivery Operation" event will end after the maintenance on 10/2.

* The "Black Mutation: Adventure Zone" will be introduced in the adventure zones.
 - During the "Black Mutation: Adventure Zone" event, you can encounter anomalies in specific adventure zones every 3 days.
 - The "Black Mutation: Adventure Zone" event will end after the maintenance on 10/31.

* The "Blessing in Nightmare" event will be held, allowing you to earn double rewards from Veda's Nightmare.
 - During the "Blessing in Nightmare" event, you can receive double rewards from Veda's Nightmare up to the daily limit.
 - The "Blessing in Nightmare" event will end after 9/25 11:00 PM PDT / 9/26 6:00 AM UTC.

* The "Journey in Memory (Rebecca Trial)" event will be held.
 - During this Trial event, you can try out Knights of Veda: 5★ Rebecca, 5★ Veleno, 4★ Shikh, and 4★ Elias.
 - The "Journey in Memory (Rebecca Trial)" event will end after the maintenance on 10/2.

* A new Tower of Trials season begins
 - The completion rates for the "Tower of Trials," which consists of floors 9 through 12, will be reset, and new "Quest Blessings" and "Goddess's Arrangement" will be applied.
 - The new Tower of Trials season will end after the maintenance on 10/2.

* A new season of Arena will begin.
 - During Arena Season 4, you can earn rewards such as Tunics, Emotes, and Insignia based on your progress..
 - Arena Season 4 will end after the maintenance on 10/31.

* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.
 - The attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
 - The new Portrait of Thierry season will end after the maintenance on 10/2.

* A new Reward Decree season will start.
 - The new Reward Decree season will begin right after the update on 9/12, and will continue until 10/22 06:00 AM (UTC) / 10:21 11:00 PM (PDT).

[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]
* To prevent PvP matches from ending too quickly as players' attack power increases, the HP of Knights of Veda in PvP has been adjusted.

* The number of Rubies and Starstone required for shoe charges has been adjusted:
 - (Before) 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 / 175 / 200 / 200 / 200
 - (After) 20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160 / 180 / 200

* Improved the ability to check the applied effects of food when using cooking items.

* After completing a dungeon, selecting "Retry" will now immediately restart the dungeon instead of bringing up the dungeon information screen.

* In Ancient Golden City, when using the “following” command, Knights of Veda will now perform their evasion move before following.

* The Knights of Veda and the general combat balance will see significant improvements. The details of these enhancements in this update are as follows:

 - General
　· The unique abilities of the Knights of Veda 'Eliyar,' 'Arin,' 'Edward,' and 'Atterisee' increase with each Fate activation based on the Fate Lv. When all 6 Level of Fate are reached, their abilities increase by approximately double compared to before.
　· The unique abilities of the Vedic Knights 'Sarka,' 'Death Crown,' 'Abert,' 'Nec,' and 'Sansar' increase with each Fate activation, depending on the Fate Level. At Level 6 of Fate, their abilities increase by approximately 2 times.
　· Depending on the Refinement Level of Eliyar's exclusive weapon "Anuray's Antler", a CRIT Chance increased by 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40% option is added to the exclusive skill effect of "Anuray's Antler." (Updated 09/11 02:28 AM PDT / 09:28 AM UTC)
　· The damage per second (DoT) of the "Burn" effect will increase from 26.4% to 129.4% of ATK. (Updated 09/11 02:28 AM PDT / 09:28 AM UTC)
　· The damage per second (DoT) of the "Shock" effect will increase from 15.6% to 76.4% of ATK. (Updated 09/11 02:28 AM PDT / 09:28 AM UTC)
　· The way Incoming DMG is applied will be adjusted (Updated 09/11 10:50 PM PDT / 9/12 05:50 AM UTC)
　　: (Current) When hit, the “DMG Bonus” effect is applied first, then the “Reducing Incoming DMG” effect of the attacker will be applied.
　　: (Adjustment) When hit, the “Reducing Incoming DMG” effect is applied first, then the “DMG Bonus” effect of the attacker will be applied.

 - Death Crown
　· The effect of the Power of Death activated by using the signature skill will now increase the resistance of Death Crown and allies by 30% and 50% respectively for 15 seconds. 
　· At Fate 6, the resistance increase effects granted by the Power of Death will be 40% for Death Crown and 60% for allies.

 - Arin
　· An increase in the amount of stats adjusted per skill and signature level up will be made.
　· At Fate 1, the damage increase effect from the Hint of Death granted by using a regular skill will rise from 15% to 30%. 
　· At Fate 2, the skill multiplier applied to Dark Visions has been increased.
　· At Fate 2, the number of additional damage instances applied by the Dark Visions effect granted by using a regular skill will be adjusted from 3 to 2.

 - Edward
　· The damage multiplier for all attacks increases while the signature skill is active.
　· The attack power increase from the Harbinger of Flames effect granted by using the signature skill will increase from 40% to 50%.
　· At Fate 4, the DMG dealt by the “Fire Floor” effect will be increased.
　· At Fate 6, an additional 40% increase in damage dealt will be applied during the Time for Punishment buff effect.

 - Nec
　· The skill coefficient for normal attacks, regular skills, and signature skills increases.
　· The damage increase from using regular skills will rise from 10% to 20%. 
　· The duration of Roderick's Oath will increase from 2 seconds to 3 seconds while the cooldown will decrease from 30 seconds to 15 seconds. 
　· A new effect will be added where Roderick will share 40% of the damage Nec receives while Roderick is summoned. 
　· The Roderick’s Will effect from Roderick’s basic attacks will change from reducing enemy attack power to reducing the damage the enemy deals. 
　· A new effect will be added to the signature extended skill where enemies hit will have their movement and attack speeds reduced by 10% for 5 seconds. 
　· At Fate 4, the Spirit's Touch effect will change from reducing the attack power of enemies hit by Roderick to reducing the damage dealt by the enemies.

 - Atterisee
　· The skill coefficient for normal attacks, regular skills, and signature skills increases.
　· The increase in attack power proportional to HP when using a normal skill has been raised from 3.2% to 4.4%.
　· At Fate 4, the effect of applying 3 Master of Poison debuffs simultaneously from the signature skill will now apply at Fate 4, previously only at Fate 6.

 - Sansar
　· The skill coefficient for normal attacks, regular skills, and signature skills increases.
　· The attack power increase based on health ratio granted by using regular skills will increase from 3.2% to 4.4%. 
　· At Fate 4, a new effect will be added where enemies hit by the signature extended skill will have their defense reduced by 20%.

 - Sarka
　· The skill coefficient of the 'Thunderstorm Bolts' effect triggered by using normal skills increases.

[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
* An issue where using the relics ‘Blessed Curse,’ ‘Assassin of Tranquility,’ and ‘Honorable Fighter’ as enhancement materials would grant experience points of a relic one grade lower will be fixed.
 - Players who used these relics as enhancement materials before the scheduled maintenance on 9/12 will be compensated with additional enhancement materials based on relevant data. We apologize for any inconvenience caused while using the content.
* The “Forlorn Poison Researcher” accessory set effect will be changed from a debuff applied to enemies when they are hit to a buff applied to the Knights of Veda in use.
* An issue where the game would forcibly close during the 'Shattered Dimensional Rift' on certain iPhone devices will be fixed.
* An issue where the guild joins confirmation popup did not appear when joining a guild will be fixed.
* An issue where the failure popup did not appear when a guild join attempt failed will be fixed.
* An issue where the quantity unit of items was not displayed when dismantling items from the inventory will be fixed.
* An issue where the background music did not play during repeated challenges in Adventure Area 7-6 will be fixed.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in Astra: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Team’s Responses to Your 8/22 Update Comments and Questions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book. I am Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

On August 22nd, we released our new raid content, "Ancient Golden City." 
We would like to extend our sincere appreciation to all of Masters of the Book for your continued interest and feedback.

We at the Development Team are constantly monitoring all your feedback and suggestions and based on the feedback you've provided regarding this update, we would like to share our responses and outline our future plans.


[h3][b]1. Since compatible characters are required to clear the Ancient Golden City, the accessibility and difficulty seem to be too high.[/b][/h3]

We are considering various measures to improve the Ancient Golden City's difficulty and accessibility and make it more enjoyable.

Among these measures is enabling the Support Knight system in Ancient Golden City, where you can receive help from other Masters of the Book’s Knights a fixed number of times. We will also be looking into improving the performance of both 5★ and 4★ Knights so that an even more varied amount of Knights can be utilized properly.


[h3][b]2. It is unfortunate that the Ancient Golden City content was released as solo content rather than as Co-Op party content. When will Co-Op raids with other users be released?[/b][/h3]


When looking at data from the “Shattered Dimensional Rift” event, we were able to see that the frequency of players doing the event solo was much higher than those doing it with their friends. This is despite the event being made relatively difficult for solo players and with Co-Op play in mind.

Because of this, we thought that if raid content was introduced to the game as a Co-Op mode, it would be much more difficult for the majority of Masters of the Book to enjoy the content and experience the difficulty as it was intended. We would like to ask for your understanding that due to the reasons mentioned above we released the content as a solo experience where you can obtain rewards individually.

In addition, we are also planning to introduce a version of the Shattered Dimensional Rift that you can play from the Adventure Zones in the near future, allowing you to enjoy it with Co-Op in mode.

With this version of Shattered Dimensional Rift, you will be able to party up not just with your fellow Guild members but also with other Masters of the Book and obtain rewards, and these rewards being items needed the most.

We will be sharing more details on this content once details are finalized.


[h3][b]3. It would be nice if there was a function to hide the appearance of the Weapon of Genesis.[/b][/h3]

It is currently possible to disable the appearance of the Weapon of Genesis on your weapon by selecting the Weapon of Genesis you wish to disable then at the bottom left of the Book screen, and select the desired visibility.

However, even though the option is set to “Hide”, the appearance was still exposed when entering battles.

This issue has been resolved during the 8/29 Maintenance, so please check the options and see if the proper setting has been applied.


[h3][b]4. The Weapon of Genesis was also released with a paying product, so the BM elements are continuously increasing, making it burdensome. I wish it could be obtained in-game.[/b][/h3]

We apologize for releasing the Weapon of Genesis as a paid product.
We plan to provide additional in-game events to obtain enough by playing the game.


[h3][b]5. It’s difficult for new users to find friends, and keeping up with the increasing content is challenging. It would be helpful if there were no level restrictions on Knight Support.[/b][/h3]

We fully understand your concerns. To help new Masters of the Book settle into Todburg, we plan to remove the level restriction for utilizing support characters in the next update and explore ways to expand the support system across more content, starting with those that have no particular issues.



[h3][b]6. It would be great to improve the Arena matching system based on character stats instead of account level.[/b][/h3]

The development team has heard your feedback regarding this issue and have done an in-depth review. During the review however, we have determined that it would be difficult to base the matchmaking criteria on abilities or stats.

In addition, even if improvements are made in this way, there is a risk that we may provide an even worse experience than the current one. Therefore, we will carefully review the direction of improvement internally before proceeding.

For the last, since the opening of the current Arena season, there have been no significant changes to the abilities or stats of the Knights. Regardless, the power of the Knights of Veda played by the Masters of the Book has become very strong, so we will take this into consideration and make improvements to ensure you can enjoy the Arena in a more engaging way.


[h3][b]7. The lack of materials when enhancing newly acquired accessories creates a significant burden. It would be great if accessories could also have a "Resetting Item" like Veda Knights or weapons.[/b][/h3]

It is indeed true that enhancing and resetting accessories with every update takes a lot of time. As per your suggestion, we will add an item that allows resetting the growth of accessories.

Additionally, we are preparing a preset save function to improve convenience. Although the scope of this feature is larger than expected, it is scheduled to be updated on October 2.
We will ensure there are no delays in the schedule and also improve the convenience of equipment replacement.


[h3][b]8. It seems that the rewards for the "Wealth of the Holy Grail" have become too lackluster. It would be great to enhance the rewards and add a chance to obtain special rewards to increase the excitement of logging in.[/b][/h3]

The rewards for the "Wealth of the Holy Grail" have not been updated since its release. We will quickly review the rewards and reset them with items that better fit the current situation for an upcoming update.


[h3][b]9. The rewards for the "Simon's Amazing Gift" event are too low, and it's disappointing that only one mascot can be obtained per Guild.[/b][/h3]

The "Simon's Amazing Gift" event is new content designed to encourage guild members to gather in the Guild Territory and earn rewards.

However, as mentioned, there were also opinions within the development team that the number of mascots obtainable as rewards is too low and that the incentives are too low to justify participating at a specific time. Therefore, with the update on Thursday, August 29th, we have increased the number of Mascot rewards to 5 and extended the event period by one day to four times a week. We hope for your active participation.


[h3][b]10. It seems that Death Crown has become essential in all content, but there is currently no place to obtain it.[/b][/h3]

We plan to improve this by allowing you to obtain it as a reward upon completing the boss battle that utilizes Death Crown, the final battle of Season 1, in line with the Season 2 update. 

We are also preparing to provide it to those who have already completed the final battle of Season 1, so we kindly ask for your patience. Thank you.


[h3][b]11. In the 2024 roadmap, it was mentioned that a new relic set would be added with the Ancient Golden City update, but it hasn't been added. I am wondering if the Relic Engraving system has replaced this.[/b][/h3]

Yes, the new Relic set has been replaced by the Relic Engraving system. We apologize for not providing a clearer notification in advance.

As mentioned in the roadmap, we were planning a new Relic set, but creating a new set of Relics takes a long time. We also considered that many players have already invested significant time in setting up their current Relics.

Additionally, we ask for your understanding that we decided it would be best not to diminish the value of the existing Relics at this time. However, new Relics will be available through the new Nightmare Dungeon to be added in Season 2.

The grade of the new Relics will be the same as the current ones, but we are preparing to provide certain Knights with more favorable options. For those who have nearly completed their Relic setup, we are designing the content to allow farming based on how you want your Knights to be built.


[h3][b]12. Call of the Stars - Fallen Veda Wings: We are curious if Event-limited Knights and Weapons will be added.[/b][/h3]

The development team is still discussing ways to allow new Masters of the Book to obtain event characters. We are carefully preparing to implement improvements related to this in Season 2.

This concludes the summary of the topics we believe you might be interested in regarding the recent update. Lastly, we'd like to inform our Masters of the Book about the update schedule leading up to Season 2.

On September 12 update, various quality-of-life improvements that were previously mentioned in the Director's letter will be implemented.

1. The Portrait of Thierry will have its floors expanded from 27 to 36. You will be able to receive rewards by clearing only the last section you completed.
 * You will also be able to receive the rewards from the previous floors and choose grace as well.
2. Sweep Function: This feature will be added to Calydon Hideout, Forgotten Mines, and Knight’s Mission.
3. Instant Stage Entry: When retrying Adventure Zones, Sealed Prisons, and Veda’s Nightmare, you will now enter the stage directly without going through a loading screen.
4. Arena Auto-Matching: An auto-matching function will be added to Arena content.
5. Equipment Dismantling: When dismantling equipment, you will now receive Enhancement Materials instead of Gold. Additionally, equipment obtained will automatically be dismantled based on its grade.
6. Bulk Reward Collection: The ability to collect rewards in bulk, previously only available in certain content like achievements, will be significantly expanded to other content.

Additionally, a Hell Mode Boss Battle, named ‘Beast Battlefront’, will be introduced in the October 2nd update. We hope you look forward to it.

Lastly, we regret to inform you that the schedule for Season 2 has been pushed back from the originally planned October 3rd to October 31st. While adding new content is important, we have prioritized the quality-of-life improvements mentioned above.

As a result of the extended timeline, we will enhance the quality of Season 2 content, including new content that wasn’t on the update roadmap, such as a new challenge with 1,000 floors. We are also preparing various events and rewards to ensure your satisfaction, so please stay tuned.

We sincerely apologize for the delay and the wait that Masters of the Book anticipating Season 2 will now have to endure.

The development team is committed to not missing out on feedback from our Masters of the Book and will continue to strive to provide the best possible service.

Thank you.

notes.title: 8/22 Patch Details (Updated 9/11 00:09 AM PDT / 07:09 AM UTC)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9120f46e53b03b71dc0440b3f0c05cee4e8fd20f.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book! 

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on August 22, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game. 

[h3][b]■ Update[/b][/h3]
*  A new 5★ Knight of Veda “Gabi” will now be available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/df706c456f0f6544d7d72193776e003686a13360.png[/img]
[i]“Hi, there! You look so, SO strong and invincible! Let’s fight!”

A girl with a relentless quest for strength. During her transformation into an Enchanted Warrior, she lost her memory and forgot why she wanted to be strong. But one thing is for sure: fighting the strongest is the most fun in the world! Today, Gabi still bounces around, excited to see someone strong enough to challenge her, someone who is "super strong and invincible"[/i]


 - Gabi is a Blood-type Melee Dealer who wields a large axe to inflict Bleed on enemies. She is extremely powerful against bleeding targets.
  · Her Normal Skill “Fight me!” sends enemies flying with her large axe and inflicts Wound Aggravation to increase Bleed DMG. 
  · Gabi’s Signature Skill “How About This?” causes the large axe to spin around her body, inflicting Bleed on enemies it hits and dealing powerful additional Blood DMG to enemies who are already bleeding to claim victory.
 
[b]* New content: Ancient Golden City[/b]
 - Travel to the ancient kingdom of Neejarem with the completed King's Medallion and stop the desires of the corrupt Boden Caryen and the Five Guardians of the Crown who guard him to obtain the “Weapons of Genesis” and materials for Relic Engraving. This content is a Unit Battle-based content with high difficulty.
 - “Unit Battles” are battles in which your Knights of Veda are organized similarly as in the “Black Mutation” areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/19e11c1add34aadb4187421b6dfd60207c79921f.jpg[/img]

 - The “Ancient Golden City” can be accessed in Chapter 7 of the Adventure Zone after completing the World Quest “Intact King's Medallion” which will be available after completing the quest “The Identity of the Fragment”, clearing the Sealed Prisons and completing the fifth floor of the Tower of Trials.
 - In “Ancient Golden City,” a total of five Knights of Veda start battle at the same time, one of which you can select and control.
 - The founder of Neejarem, Boden Caryen, and the Five Guardians of the Crown who guard him await you in the six stages of adventure in the kingdom. After completing the scenario that takes place upon your initial entry into the Ancient Golden City, you will now be able to participate in a free progression mode where there are weekly progress rewards and the difficulty can be freely changed. 
 - In “Ancient Golden City,”  attribute resistance does not activate and the Overflowing Power of the Stars mechanic is disabled. 
 - When you defeat the boss of the “Ancient Golden City”, you will be able to receive “Galactic Bliss”, which allows you to acquire the new piece of equipment, “Weapon of Genesis” and also materials for Relic Engraving.
 - “Weapon of Genesis” and “Galactic Bliss” can also be obtained as weekly progress rewards, with higher difficulties allowing you to earn more of them.
 
[b] * New Equipment: “Weapon of Genesis”[/b]
 - "Weapon of Genesis" is a remnant of a weapon created at the beginning of time–a special piece of equipment that can be combined with your weapon. Equipping a “Weapon of Genesis” that matches your weapon’s type will greatly improve the performance of your Knights of Veda.
 - “Weapon of Genesis” can be obtained by using “Galactic Bliss” in the new “Ancient Golden City” gamemode and on Guidance of the Goddess under “Furnace of Genesis”.
 - “Galactic Bliss” can be obtained in the new “Ancient Golden City” gamemode.
 - “Weapon of Genesis” can be equipped by going to the Book menu and checking under the “Equipment” tab.
 
[b]* New System: Relic Engraving[/b]
 - One Random option among those on a high level relic can be strengthened through Relic Engraving.
  · [Highest Level Relic condition by grade] 
	- 5★ Relic : Level 20
	- 4★ Relic : Level 16
	- 3★ Relic : Level 12
 - When re-engraving an upgraded Relic, the strengthened stats are reset and one random stat among those on the Relic will then be strengthened.
 - Relic Engraving can be done without restrictions.
 - The option values that are possible to be enhanced through Relic Engraving are the same as the option values that are on the Enhanced Relic.
 - The cost of the engraving increases by up to 100,000 Gold depending on the number of engraving attempts.
 
[b]* Event: Simon's Amazing Gifts![/b]
 - “Simon's Amazing Gifts!” is a new event where you and your fellow Guild members work together to defeat fearsome Treasure Chests that will appear in your Guild Territory during the event period, do so and receive rewards.
 - You can participate in the event after completing the World Mission "Social Party?"
 - You can participate in the event at your Guild Territory at 11:00 AM UTC / 04:00 AM PDT base on server time on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays during the event period.
 - At the designated time, a “Fearsome Treasure Chest” will appear in the Guild Territory, When the “Fearsome Treasure Chest” is defeated, 30 Treasure Chests will be dropped and one of these can be opened per Guild Member.
  · The Treasure Chest that appears after defeating the “Fearsome Treasure Chest” will be available for 2 hours after the Fearsome Treasure Chest has been defeated. Chests that have already been opened by your other Guild members cannot be re-opened.
 - Various rewards can be obtained from the Treasure Chests that appear after the defeat of the “Fearsome Treasure Chest”, these include the newly added “Mascot” feature.
 - Acquired Mascots can be checked in the Belle menu, and the equipped Mascot will follow the Master of the Book. Equipped Mascots does not affect the performance of any Knights of Veda.
 - The “Simon's Amazing Gifts!” event will conclude after the regular maintenance on 9/12.
 
[b]* Event: The 'Black Mutation'[/b]
- The “Black Mutation” event in the Nightmare Dungeon will feature anomalies occurring in specific Nightmare areas every 3 days during the event period.
- Similar to the adventure area Black Mutation, entering an area affected by Black Mutation will trigger a battle with 4 of your Knights of Veda. During this battle, you can control only one Knight, while the other 3 Knights will fight automatically.
- The “Nightmare Black Mutation” event will end after the regular maintenance on 9/12.

* New Feature: Cooking for Tower of Trials and Portrait of Thierry
 - Experience a boost in power, as well as the joy of victory with your carefully prepared dishes, as they will now be accessible on both Tower of Trials and in Portrait of Thierry.

[b]* Update: Full Auto Mode Improvements[/b]
* Improvements will be made so that some actions requiring manual input when in Full Auto will now also be automated.
 - Interacting with the Veda’s Return statue to obtain rewards and end the stage in Adventure Dungeons and Black Mutation will now be automated.
 - Actions for starting dungeon progress in the Sealed Prisons and similar dungeons will now be automated.
 
[b]* Event: Adventure Dungeon’s Double rewards[/b]
 - During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Dungeons up to the daily limit.
 - The double rewards event for Adventure Dungeons will end after 9/4 08:00 PM (PDT) / 9/5 03:00 AM (UTC)
 
[b]* Ancient Golden City Mission Event: "He Who Will Leave No Name”[/b]
 - Participate in the "He Who Will Leave No Name" event in the new content, ‘Ancient Golden City,’ and earn various rewards, including the material ‘Galactic Bliss’ needed to obtain the 'Weapon of Genesis,' along with enhancement materials.
 - The "He Who Left No Name" event will end after the regular maintenance on 10/2.

* Event: Weapon of Genesis called "True Creation, Weapon of Genesis"
 -  The "True Creation, Weapon of Genesis" event will end after the regular maintenance on 10/2.
 
[b]* Event: Journey in Memory (Gabi)[/b]
 - In this trial event, the available Knights of Veda for trial are ★5 Gabi / ★5 Ellen Farell / ★4 Ardor / ★4 Marthel.
 - The "Journey in Memory (Gabi)" event will end after the regular maintenance on 9/12.
 
[b]* Event: New "Portrait of Thierry" Season[/b]
 - After regular maintenance, monsters differing in attributes from those in the previous seasons will appear in the stages of “Portrait of Thierry.”
 - The new season of "Portrait of Thierry" will end after the regular maintenance on 9/12.
 
[b]* Event: New “Tower of Trials” Season[/b]
 - The new “Tower of Trials” season will start after the update, with Floors 9 to 12 of the Tower of Trials being reset and the blessings "Quest Blessing" and "Goddess's Arrangement" to be applied.
 - The new season of the Tower of Trials will end after the regular maintenance on 9/12.

[b]* Update: Iris and Land of Pride Summons[/b]
* The Knight of Veda, Iris and her weapon, “Land of Pride” will be available for summoning in “Call of the Stars: Fallen Wing of Veda.”
 - Iris will not be added to the “Start the Call of the Stars” and “Knight’s First Leap” banners.


[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]
* If a target attacked by a dual-attribute Knight of Veda has a “Resistant” shield active, the system will now check for the opposing attribute and adjust the attribute of the attack accordingly.
* During Unit Battles, the ability to use the Overflowing Power of the Stars will be improved. When used, it will be applied to all Knights of Veda with the corresponding attribute.
* To prevent battles from ending too quickly in Arena Showdown 1v1, Health points will be adjusted accordingly.
* To prepare for the new content of this update, including the "Ancient Golden City," we will be making adjustments to the balance of Knights of Veda and combat in general. The changes being made in this update are as follows:


[b] - General[/b]
  * The DoT inflicted to a Knight that is “Poisoned” will be increased from 5.1% of ATK to 15.84%.
  * The DoT inflicted to a Knight that is “Bleed” will be increased from 19.2% of ATK to 95%
    : The “Shock”, and “Burn” effects will be adjusted in the update on September 12.
  * Critical hits will now be applied to DoT when “Poisoned,” “Bleed,” “Shock,” and “Burn” are applied.
  * Debuff removal skills will now be unable to remove the  “Poisoned,” “Bleeding,” “Shock,” and “Burn” effects. They also now do not disappear when an affected Knight enters the Active Resistance state.
  * For Knights of Veda Veleno, Xanthia, Vesti, and Ellen Farell, the coefficients that increase upon leveling up are now approximately 2 times higher than before.  (Updated 8/23 09:41 AM UTC / 02:41 AM PDT)
  * For Knights of Veda: Veleno, Xanthia, Vesti, and Ellen Farell, the unique stats that increase with each activation of Fate are now higher than before, with a 2-time increase at Level 6 Fate compared to the previous value.

[b] - Veleno[/b]
 - Veleno will now inflict Poison with all Normal Attacks.
 - When Veleno uses the signature skill “Metastases of Poisoning” the effect of “Loaded Poison Arrows” will be increased from giving 1 stack of Poison to 2 stacks.
 - The following Fate effects for Veleno will be adjusted:
  : At Fate Level 0, the duration of the “Poison” status applied will be increased from 6 seconds to 20 seconds.
  : At Fate Level 2, an increase to the maximum number of Poison stacks from 20 to 30 will be made.
  : At Fate Level 4, an increase to the number of Poison stacks applied by normal attacks by 1 (an additional increase of 1 on critical hits) will be newly added.
  : At Fate Level 6, the maximum number of Poison stacks will be increased from 30 to 40.
 - The cooldown of “Poisonous Fangs” of Veleno’s exclusive weapon “Bow of Sacrifice” is reduced from 5 seconds to 4.5 seconds.
 - Veleno will no longer move backward when using her Signature Skill. (Updated 9/11 00:09 AM PDT / 07:09 AM UTC)

[b] - Xanthia[/b]
 - The Fate effects of Xanthia will be adjusted:
 : At Fate Level 6, the damage intervals for her signature skill “Event Horizon” will be reduced from 1 second to 0.5 seconds.
 
[b] - Vesti[/b]
 - The Fate effects for Vesti will be adjusted:
  : At Fate Level 0, the maximum number of jars that can be created will be increased from 6 to 10.
  : At Fate Level 1, the maximum number of jars that can be created will be increased from 10 to 20.
  : At Fate Level 2, the number of jars created with a 50% chance will be increased from 2 to 3, and a new effect that generates jars with a 50% chance on the first and second attacks of normal attacks will be newly added.
  : At Fate Level 4, the number of jars summoned by the third and fourth attacks of normal attacks will be increased from 1 to 2, and the maximum number of jars that can be created is increased from 20 to 30.

[b] - Ellen Farell[/b]
 - The following Fate effects for Ellen Farrel will be adjusted:
  : At Fate Level 0, the water attribute damage per stack of the “Wave” effect will be increased from 0.5% to 1%, and a new effect where one additional stack is applied on the fourth attack of normal attacks will be newly added.
  : At Fate Level 4, the maximum number of stacks for the “Wave” effect will be increased from 10 to 20.
  : At Fate Level 6, the maximum number of stacks for the “Wave” effect will be increased from 20 to 30.
 - The maximum number of stacks for the ‘Torrents’ effect of Ellen Farell’s signature weapon “Wave of Life” will be increased from 5 to 8.


[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
* An issue where monster entities appeared differently in Calydon Hideout will be fixed.
 - The number of monster entities appearing in the Calydon Hideout will now be fixed to a maximum of 109. Once the maximum number of monsters have all been defeated, the battle will now end immediately even if there is still time remaining. (Updated 8/23 08:00 AM UTC / 01:00 AM PDT)
 - The amount of gold obtained when defeating a Calydon will be increased. This is to ensure that the amount of gold obtained on Calydon Hideout will remain the same as before. (Updated 8/23 08:00 AM UTC / 01:00 AM PDT)

We hope this update will bring you more exciting adventures in Planis.

Thank you!

notes.title: Development Team’s Responses to Your August Update Comments and Questions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book. I am Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.


In the beginning of August, we added Guild Territories to the game to serve as the foundation for expanding our Guild-related content, and the newly-introduced “Shattered Dimensional Rift” is the first step to this wave of new content.

We at the Development Team are constantly monitoring all your feedback and suggestions, including those about the “Shattered Dimensional Rift”, and would like to assure our Masters of the Book that we are reviewing them for implementation into the game.


Among the content introduced in this update, there was some feedback which we can immediately address and some that may take some time before implementation. We would like to address each one-by-one.


[h3]1. Decrease the amount of time spent progressing on existing content as newer ones are introduced.[/h3]

The development team plans to introduce a 'Clearance' function to allow players to quickly complete content that may sometimes feel like 'homework' or is very tedious. This function will also be applied to some challenging content depending on the situation.

These improvements aim to let players enjoy the game more comfortably, allowing you to focus on the more challenging content. Here are the specific directions:

* Portrait of Thierry: We will shorten some sections when the boss on the 18th and 27th floors are cleared and allow immediate rewards for the shortened sections.
 - For example, if you have cleared up to the 19th floor, you can start from the 10th floor in the next round, and if you have cleared up to the 27th Floor, you can now proceed from the 19th Floor.

* Arena: An automatic rematching function will be added to make it easier to obtain the Crown of Victory Progress reward.

* Knights Mission: Previously completed missions will be marked as completed immediately to allow easier collection of rewards.

* Calydon Hideout: We plan to improve it so that you can receive gold rewards based on your highest Kill Count.
           
* Forgotten Mine: We plan to improve it so that you can receive rewards based on the quantity of the most acquired enhancement materials such as Calydon Hideout.

In addition, while we had planned to add higher difficulty levels for the above content in future updates, we will instead focus on providing a more challenging experience to minimize the fatigue that the Masters of the Book might feel.

We believe that these changes make the game a more enjoyable experience for everyone, please look forward to these changes being implemented into the game on the September, 12 Update maintenance.

In addition to the 'Clearance' feature, we also plan to add a function to automate the acceptance of the statues of the Goddess the “Veda’s Return” when Full Auto Battle is enabled in Adventure Area, Sealed Prison, Veda’s Nightmare and Tower of Trials content. This new feature will be quickly applied during the August 22 update. 


[h3]2. The new Shattered Dimensional Rift event is too hard, and Guild Territory lacks content. Additionally, the Guild alarm and Chat alarm features are not working properly causing inconvenience.[/h3]

Introduced during the 8/1 update, Guild Territories will be updated to include new main content such as Guild Conquest, Guild Treasure Chests. and Guild World Bosses. Current event content like Shattered Dimensional Rifts will continue to be accessible in this area.

Although there are still many areas needing improvement, we strive to make important Guild Notices more accessible and quickly fix the chat notification feature. We also plan to add and expand uses for the Guild Progress function.

As for the difficulty of the Shattered Dimensional Rift event, we initially developed the event with it being the most challenging content for players in a guild. We will be taking extended notes and will be analyzing the performance of our Masters of the Book in order to make more informed decisions for game balance for the next event. Additionally, we will improve the display of attribute information for each boss to make progress easier.

We will coordinate the application schedule internally with the development team and aim to implement these changes as quickly as possible.


[h3]3. Requests for new Knights of Veda of other attributes and positions, as well as a Practice Mode[/h3]

We are planning to add DPS Knights with Blood, Earth, and Poison attributes. We are also planning to introduce on the October 2nd Update, the addition of a practice space that will allow you to test each Knight's performance.

As mentioned in the previous Director’s Note, we plan to improve the Knights of Veda currently lagging behind other Knights in power. For lingering damage attributes like Poison, we plan to improve the overall attribute structure to make them more attractive to use.


[h3]4. It would be nice if the maximum amount of Radiance and Mystical Chromatics could be increased.[/h3]

With the 8/8 update, the maximum number of these two currencies was increased from 9,999 to 999,999. We are also continuing to consider adding more ways to acquire these currencies.


[h3]5. Addressing problems like long loading screens, pressure to spend on Halos and El Cids, and adding new support characters for Special Supply Delivery Operation.[/h3]

We will add new Knights of Veda to the Knight support system, which can be used in various events, as quickly as possible.
The frequency of loading screens is also a very important factor for enjoying a smooth gaming experience, so we will make every effort to reduce or eliminate them as much as technically possible.
We will also strive to design premium items more reasonably and consider diversifying the sources of materials.

The 8/22 update will include the DPS Blood attribute Knight of Veda, Gabi, who wields a Large Axe. The update will also bring the Ancient Golden City, the Fearsome Treasure Chest, the Weapon of Genesis, and Relic Engraving.


We promise to keep delivering engaging content and look forward to sharing more in the next Director's Note.

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Team's Responses to Your July Update Comments and Questions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book. I am Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

We have been carefully reviewing the various opinions shared by the community and on the official Discord following the major content update.

We sincerely appreciate the diverse feedback provided by the community. Moving forward, we aim to gather your comments and questions after each major content update and provide comprehensive responses.

While there are still areas for improvement, we are committed to incorporating your feedback to enhance the content and deliver a more polished experience.

In this developer's note, we have compiled your questions about the first dual-attribute knight, Death Crown, and the challenging PVE content, Portrait of Thierry.


[h3]1. Portrait of Thierry feels significantly more difficult compared to other content, and being limited to one attempt per week makes it feel even more challenging.[/h3]

Portrait of Thierry is designed as high-difficulty PVE content in ASTRA: Knights of Veda. Our aim is to provide the enjoyment of overcoming tough challenges using your improved Knights of Veda.
Currently, it consists of 27 levels, but we plan to add more and continue improving it.
We've also heard your concerns about the game cycle.
Considering that weekly resets may contribute to content fatigue, we will carefully deliberate internally to find ways to improve this aspect. We will strive to enhance the Portrait of Thierry based on your feedback and the data to make it more enjoyable and meaningful.

In the future, we will introduce other high-difficulty PVE content like Guild Portal, Ancient Golden City, and All-Out Boss Battles.
We will also review the options for accessory items, the main drops from Portrait of Thierry, to ensure you can enjoy building your teams for future content.
Additionally, in Season 2, we are preparing end-game PVE content like World Boss Battles and Guild World Boss Battles that everyone can participate in. We hope that everyone will look forward to the new upcoming content.


[h3]2. Set Accessories from the Portrait of Thierry are so much better than existing Accessories that the latter are becoming neglected. [/h3]

Set Accessories from the Portrait of Thierry are currently the top-tier items in ASTRA: Knights of Veda. 
However, like the existing accessories, their options appear randomly, so it may take a long time to get the desired setup.
Additionally, utilizing the normal Accessories is key to progressing through the early stages of the Portrait of Thierry, so assembling the Set Accessories requires a slow build-up. 
For the time being, we expect the Portrait of Thierry to be the definitive spot for obtaining accessories, and we aim to provide sufficiently attractive growth potential through this content. 


[h3]3. Since Death Crown is a dual-attribute Knight of Veda, I’m wondering if the damage from both attributes are doubled. I also wonder if his damage type can be changed to deal another attribute when the enemy activates Active Resistance. [/h3]

A dual-attribute Knight of Veda has the advantage of being able to counter two enemy attributes, but also has the weakness of being vulnerable to both opposite attributes. 
Death Crown, the first dual-attribute Knight of Veda, is strong against Light and Poison Knights of Veda, but is weak against Blood and Water. It also cannot deal much damage against Darkness. 
As you asked, attacking an enemy with Active Resistance against one of Death Crown’s attributes will not allow you to deal more damage, since he will maintain his original attribute of attack. 
If it were possible to switch to another attribute to deal damage to bypass Active Resistance, it would deviate too much from the current rules of the game, so we intend to maintain this current interaction. 
However we plan to improve it so that if another Knight of Veda triggers the active resistance, a dual-type Knight of Veda will be able to gain an advantage (if possible). 
Dual-attribute Knights of Veda are designed as the ultimate 5-star characters. 
Therefore they possess the strength to overcome their weaknesses. 

In Season 2, we will continue to introduce dual-attribute Knights. Dual-attributes will be granted to Knights of Veda comparable to the Transcended Angels, Boden and 
Dual-attributes will be granted to Knights of Veda equivalent to the top 5 units from the Dragon Blaze universe, such as the Transcended Angels, Quintuple Ascendants and Boden. 


[h3]4. El Cid types are too detailed, and we'd like to see more sources where we can get enhancement and ascension materials[/h3]

Currently, El Cids are divided into general El Cids and exclusive El Cids. We aimed to make general El Cids relatively easier to obtain compared to exclusive El Cids.
Exclusive El Cids provide special effects tailored to a character's traits, allowing for stronger growth. We are constantly looking for ways to reduce the difficulty in acquiring El Cids.
To address the lack of enhancement and ascension materials for El Cids, we have added items to the Guild Shop that can be exchanged starting from the August 1 update.
We are also discussing and planning more ways to provide sufficient content for acquiring enhancement materials for El Cids and Halos to meet your expectations.
 

[h3]5. We are concerned about the underperformance of some Knights of Veda and the skill cooldown reduction options.[/h3]

We are aware that some Knights of Veda are not performing well.
We will continuously update and improve these knights.
We are especially focused on reviewing the performance of pickup knights.
All Knights of Veda will have roles in various content.
We understand that you play with great affection for each Knight of Veda, and we are working to ensure all knights can shine in different content.

We also recognize your concerns about the skill cooldown reduction options.
Currently, the maximum efficiency of this stat is 81.28%, and for Yanko, it can reach up to 88.48% at Fate 6.
We believe this issue is more noticeable in PVP than in PVE and will continue to monitor it closely.
As mentioned before, we promise to find solutions other than nerfs to provide updates that will hopefully satisfy the community.


[h3]6. We would like to have a feature that allows us to check battle stats for each content.
[/h3]
We understand that checking detailed battle statistics is essential for enjoying the game.
We will schedule updates to add this feature, starting with the content where battle statistics matter the most.


[h3]7. We would like a preset feature to easily swap relics and accessories, and a Knight of Veda with a skill that occasionally returns enchantment scrolls.[/h3]

The development of a preset feature for equipment is currently in progress.
We will also incorporate the suggestion for a Knight of Veda with a skill that returns enchantment scrolls into development as soon as possible.
We are committed to continuously updating the game with various quality-of-life features that the community has been asking for.

 
[h3]8. Lack of stories for new characters[/h3]

Detailed stories for the new knights will be revealed in the Season 2 storyline.
Season 2 will introduce knights with unique and captivating backgrounds.
We are working hard to build anticipation for the upcoming story and to highlight the unique qualities of many heroes in Season 2.
 

[h3]9. Having to play Calydon Hideout and Forgotten Mine three times daily feels exhausting.[/h3]

We understand that Calydon Hideout and Forgotten Mine can feel like daily chores for material farming without much fun. To address this, we will improve the system and add a sweep function to claim rewards based on your best record.


We have reviewed the various feedback shared after the Portrait of Thierry update.
We will incorporate your feedback and improvements to hopefully provide everyone with a better experience.
We are preparing more PVE and PVP content for everyone to enjoy.
In Season 2, there will be end-game content tailored to each position.
We promise to keep delivering engaging content and look forward to sharing more in the next Director's Note.

Thank you!

notes.title: 8/1 Patch Details
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9120f46e53b03b71dc0440b3f0c05cee4e8fd20f.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book! 

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on August 1, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game. 

[h3]■ Update[/h3]
*  A new 5★ Knight of Veda “Violet” will now be available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0410de061115990037454aba8fa020201189f6fb.png[/img]
[i]"Is your life… fresh enough?"

Violet, an Enchanted Warrior who has earned the title: "The kindest and cruelest of them all.” She normally exudes dignity and politeness, yet in battle, she transforms into a fearsome warrior. Her opponent’s strong will to live only stimulates her hunting instincts. Even she, who smiles a maniacal grin while taking a new, fresh life, has moments of genuine laughter.[/i]

 - “Violet'' is an Electric-attribute Ranged Healer who wields a staff capable of restoring allies’ HP based on the amount of DMG dealt to enemies. Her Normal Skill, "Lightning Flash," drops a powerful bolt of lightning on an enemy location, dealing Shock and DMG. Her Signature Skill, "Blossom of Lightning," unleashes a lightning flower to bloom on an enemy location, dealing heavy DMG and knocking back enemies that approach, creating a field of electricity that continuously deals Shock and Electric DMG over time.

* A new 4★ Knight of Veda “Bjorn” will also be available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0d8fd0cc6cb0ebd19a1ba5b77cb71a31f80ab081.png[/img]
[i]"My fury is as fierce as the frozen ocean!"

If one were to describe him in a single word, it would undoubtedly be "tenacity." In order to protect his tribe from the beasts, he was unwavering in his pursuit of immense strength and held a deep disdain for weakness. A mere glance at his scarred and calloused body betrays the hardships he endured and the relentless battles he fought to survive.[/i]

 - "Bjorn" is a Fire-type Melee Tank with an Axe & Shield, able to withstand enemy attacks with high DEF and fast ATK SPD while unleashing quick attacks in combat. His Normal Skill, “The One Who Calls Destruction,” allows him to leap high and slam the ground, dealing a wide area of DMG and leaving a burning zone on the ground that deals DMG and weakens enemies over time. His Signature Skill, “Wild Frenzy,” taunts nearby enemies to protect his allies before striking back to neutralize them.

* New Guild Feature: Guild Territory
 - “Guild Territory,” a new place to socialize with your fellow Guild members, will be opened. Come and enjoy all the new guild content!
 - From your Guild Territory, you can access the “Guild Bulletin Board” to communicate with fellow guild members and the “Twisted Portal” to participate in the “Shattered Dimensional Rift” event. You can also check the Guild Shop, Guild Information, and other existing functions here.
 - If you aren’t part of a guild, you should join one first before you can enter the Guild Territory through the "Guild" button in the Belle menu.

* New Content: Shattered Dimensional Rift
 - This new content is designed for top guilds, allowing up to three guild members to fight the wrath of Rogue One. Access it through the Twisted Portal in the Guild Territory.
 - In the Shattered Dimensional Rift, powerful Rogue Ones will continuously appear. Defeating them or waiting for their timed appearance will summon new Rogue Ones.
 - Kills are tracked both individually and by team and will determine the rewards received which are separated into “Individual Kill Rewards” and “Guild Kill Rewards.” “Insignia” can be received as a Guild Kill Reward.
 - The “Shattered Dimensional Rift” event will end after the scheduled maintenance on 8/22.

* Event: Harold’s Lost Knowledge
 - Assist Harold in gathering research materials and earn various rewards.
 - Participate in the “Harold’s Lost Knowledge” event through Harold, who you will be able to see hanging out in Todburg after you clear stage 2-12 of the Adventure Zone.
 - Obtain the materials needed for Harold’s Research Journal in Adventure Zones and submit them to him in order to obtain various rewards, which include Starstones and enhancement and ascension materials.
 - The event will open in parts, one each day, until all seven parts have been unlocked. You can check the event progress through the “Research Journal.”
 -  The event will end after the regular maintenance on 8/22.

* Event: The “Special Supply Delivery Operation” returns!
 - This event has been revamped since its first run in April.
  : Rewards are now based on how quickly the wagon reaches the destination, instead of the remaining health of the wagon.
  : The method of escorting the carriage will remain the same, but now obstacles will appear along the wagon’s route, and its speed decreases based on its remaining health.
 - Each stage consists of three rounds. Buffs can be earned upon entering and completing the first and second rounds.
 - Rewards will be given once you have successfully escorted the carriage to the end. 
 - The event will end after the scheduled maintenance on 8/22.

* Update: Portrait of Thierry
Monsters on every floor of Portrait of Thierry will now have different attributes than before the regular maintenance.

* Event: Blessing in Nightmare
 - Earn double rewards a limited number of times per day from Veda’s Nightmare during the event period.
 - The “Blessing in the Nightmare” event will end on 8/15 at 06:00 AM UTC / 8/14 at 11:00 PM PDT.

* Event: Rebels of Chaos
 - Participate in the new “Shattered Dimensional Rift” content and earn various rewards. “Rebels of Chaos” 
-  The “Rebels of Chaos” will end after the scheduled maintenance on 8/22.

* Event: Fateful Encounter
A new “Fateful Encounter” daily attendance event will start. 
 -  Log in for 7 days to receive various rewards.
 - The “Fateful Encounter” event will end after the scheduled maintenance on 8/22.

* Update: New “Tower of Trials” Season 
 - The new “Tower of Trials” season will start after the update, with Floors 9 to 12 of the Tower of Trials being reset and the blessings "Blessing of Tasks" and "Grace of the Goddess" to be applied.
 - The difficulty of the “Tower of Trials” will be adjusted to match the growth of the Master of the Book, making it more challenging than before, alongside this adjustment, the rewards will also be improved compared to the previous season.
-  The new “Tower of Trials” season will end after the scheduled maintenance on 8/22.

* Update: New Reward Decree Season
 - We have made some changes to the Reward Decree rewards.
  : Upon reaching level 50 in the Reward Decree and after unlocking the Neejarem Reward Decree, you will now be able to obtain a Legendary Weapon Draw Ticket.
 - The new Reward Decree season starts immediately after the update on 8/1, and will run until 9/10 06:00 AM UTC / 9/9 at 11:00 PM PDT.

* Event:  Journey in Memory (Violet)
- During this “Journey in Memory” event, you can try out the 5★ Character Violet, 4★ Bjorn and 4★ Liam.
- This event will end after the scheduled maintenance on 8/22.

* Update: Emile and Pure Love Summons
- Knight of Veda “Emile” and her signature weapon “Pure Love”' can now be summoned from “Call of the Stars: Fallen Wing of Veda.”
 - She will not be included in the “Beginner: Call of the Stars” and “Knight's First Leap” Call of the Stars.


[h3]■ Improvements[/h3]
* The list of Halos and El Cids has been added in the Collections.
* The drop rate of Accessory ascension materials obtainable in the Sealed Prisons will be adjusted:
 - It is now possible for more than two of “Accessory Frame of Bajilae” to drop on Sealed Prisons when at Adventure Level 8.
 - Drop rates for “Accessory Frame of Ness” will be increased when at Adventure Level 7 and below.
* When the boss at Sealed Prisons uses a powerful skill, it can now be canceled quicker by conducting an attack from an opposing attribute.
  - For example, when the Earth attribute Rogue Ones in Chapter 3 - Sealed Prison uses Quartz Roll, you can quickly cancel it if you use an attack of the Poison attribute.
* The El Cid reward icon will now also display each class to easily identify which role it can be equipped to.
* Improved food system to conveniently check and use recently used dishes before entering a dungeon.
* The maximum number of materials used when enhancing equipment will be increased from 20 to 50.
* When the stats of Veda's Knights exceed the maximum, both the maximum stats and the current stats will now be displayed in the detailed information screen.
* The login process for the Steam platform has been improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/b3cdd18cbabe78bafce7d89190b6e0d3c798e8c1.png[/img]
 - You will now be able to log out and access another account while using the Steam platform.
 - Once the Steam Login Process improvement is complete, a re-login will be required to access the game.
  : If you have not linked an external account on your existing Steam account, you can play with the previous data by attempting to log in with the existing Steam account.
  : If you have no history of using a Steam account, you can log in with your desired external account to play the game.
※ The “Start with your Steam account” button will only be visible when you run the game on the Steam platform.


[h3]■ Bug Fixes[/h3]
* The issue where control keys disappear and control becomes impossible when entering the boss room in Portrait of Thierry under certain conditions has been fixed.
* The issue where Knights show that they can use their signature skills but are unable to do so has been fixed.


[h3]■ Changes[/h3]
* The sale of the following items will end after the update maintenance on 8/1:
 - 100-Day Celebration Pack 1-4
 - Death Crown Summon Step-Up 1-5

We hope this update will bring you more exciting adventures in Planis.

Thank you!

Masters of the Book! 

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on July 25, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game. 

[h3]■ Update[/h3]
* Co-Op in Arena
- The "Co-Op" feature is now available in Arena.
- Invite friends and guild members to participate in the Arena together.
- Invitation restrictions are based on the mode (Survival or Showdown) rules.

* Dismantle Items in Bulk
  - A new feature will be added to dismantle items of the same grade in bulk.
  - By clicking the “Dismantle” button in the bag, you can dismantle items in bulk using the "Batch Processing" button.
  - The maximum number of items that can be dismantled at once will be increased from 50 to 500.

* View Opponent’s Information in Battlefield of the War Gods
 - You can now view detailed information about your opponent, including Knights of Veda used, their level, equipment, Fate level, and Relics before entering the battlefield.
 - Check this information via the ‘View Info’ button before entering the battlefield.

* New Arena Season Starts
 - Participate in various missions during Arena Season 3 to earn rewards such as Tunics, Name Cards, Emoticons, and the newly introduced “Insignia”.
 - Arena Season 3 ends after the regular maintenance on 9/12.

* A new ‘Insignia’ system, symbolizing the honor of the Masters of the Book
 - Insignias symbolize the honor of the Masters of the Book and can be used to decorate your name. Earn Insignias by advancing in the Arena and participating in upcoming content.
 - Insignias are visible in Todburg and any Battlefield, but provide no additional gameplay benefits.
 - Change your Insignia in the Belle menu once acquired.

[h3]■ Improvements[/h3]
* The "Damage Over Time (%)" option will no longer be applied to certain set accessories obtainable from the Portrait of Thierry that are not supposed to have this attribute. The affected items are:
 - Territory Guardian Ring
 - Deepwater Ring
 - Martyr's Gold Ring
 - Dark Moon Ring
 - If you have these accessories with the "Damage Over Time (%)" option, they will be replaced during the maintenance on 7/25. The replacement accessories will be sent through your in-game mailbox. The new accessories will have random attributes, but they will not include the "Damage Over Time (%)" option.
* Interactions necessary for game progression, such as Veda’s Return, Sealed Prisons, and dungeon missions, will be improved to respond better to input.
* The hitboxes for the Calydons in Calydon Hideout and dragon-type monsters in Portrait of Thierry will be increased to make them easier to hit.

[h3]■ Bug Fixes[/h3]
* An issue where the damage from the Death Crown’s first basic attack is not dealt to enemies when his attack speed is near 100% will be fixed.
* An issue where some stats are incorrectly displayed when ‘Death Crown’ wears a Fire-attribute Ring will be fixed.
* An issue where lowering the game volume to 0 in the settings did not apply to connected Bluetooth speakers will be fixed.
* The issue where the resistance of enemies in the Portrait of Thierry increased after the regular maintenance on 7/18 will be fixed.
For more details, please check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2484250/view/4370264265350194189?l=english]related announcement[/url].

[h3]■ Changes[/h3]
* The reset time for the purchase limit of the following items will be changed to 8/1 03:00 AM UTC/ 7/31 08:00 PM PDT. They will be discontinued after the maintenance update on 8/1.
 - Legendary Knight Step-up 1~5
 - Legendary Weapon Step-up 1~5
  : The Legendary Knight & Legendary Weapon Step-up packages will be re-released with updated content on 8/1.

We always listen to your feedback to improve and provide an enjoyable adventure.

Thank you.
