Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game. 

[h3]■ A new 5★ Knight, the King of the Living and the Dead has arrived![/h3]
*  A new 5★ Knight of Veda ‘Death Crown’ will now be available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2e0a914e061c28f47c4e0fc0ce5d4e3fc55f3c9d.png[/img]

[i]“Sorry to keep you waiting”

Fated to reign, the King of the Living and the Dead was named to symbolize grand missions and numerous destinies. But none of that matters to him. From the moment he was born, he was destined to take on the great task. And he only moves forward in silence, following his own will.[/i]

 - Death Crown is a close-range tank with a dual attribute of Darkness and Fire, wielding a longsword that converts some of its damage into defense and uses debuffs to weaken enemies. The normal skill “Darkness Tear” allows him to approach enemies instantly and deal DMG, while also increasing Death Crown's tenacity. His signature skill “Judgment of Death” leaps into the air and lands on enemies, dealing AoE damage, removing buffs from enemies and preventing them from getting new buffs for a short time. It also creates a field around Death Crown that increases resistance for allies and decreases resistance for enemies.

[h3]■ New Content: Portrait of Thierry[/h3]
 - Portrait of Thierry is a new type of seasonal content available to all Masters of the Book. Follow the footsteps of Rivers, a man who disappeared 10 years ago in this new roguelike game mode. Portrait of Thierry is intended more for late-game players who have already maxed out all of their equipment, as the rewards come in the form of better accessory sets and the new equipment type “El Cid”.
 - You can unlock Portrait of Thierry by completing the quest “Thierry’s Conversation” that will be available after clearing Adventure Stage 7-12.1
 - Portrait of Thierry resets every Thursday at 11:00 PM PDT / 06:00 AM UTC

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/6878dc7f530bad85d75bdc07cdadf3c5ac5952bf.jpg[/img]

 - In Portrait of Thierry, you move around a map composed of tiles that represent a zone, defeat the monsters and bosses in each zone and obtain rewards such as accessories or the new equipment type, “El Cid”. Knights of Veda can move to adjacent tiles based on the zone they are currently in, but they can only move to the right.
 - Portrait of Thierry consists of a total of 27 Floors. with the next floor being available after defeating the current floor’s boss. 
 - Monsters with two specified attributes appear on each floor and you can specify which Knights of Veda you want per floor.
 - Damage taken by your Knights will carry over to the next battle.
- A maximum of 4 Knights of Veda can be deployed on each floor, and if all 4 deployed Knights of Veda die, you can redeploy other Knights of Veda you have.
· If all the Knights of Veda you have die, the reconstruction of the portrait will end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/cdd579a519256a34d225320636206987b1627c72.jpg[/img]

 - A “Grace Effect” can be selected after clearing each zone, these effects can then stack up, allowing you to deal with more powerful enemies more efficiently.
 - After defeating the boss of the floor, you can obtain accessories with set effects and Mystical Chromatics which you can use to obtain El Cid.
 - Reaching a certain floor every week will reward you with additional Mystical Chromatics you can use to obtain more “El Cid” or “Gold Coins” which you can use in the Portrait of Thierry Shop. Additionally, you can obtain an accessory with a set effect upon clearing the 27th floor.

[h3]■ New Equipment Type: El Cid[/h3]
 - El Cid is a new piece of equipment made from mysterious light fragments scattered throughout Noah. Each Knight of Veda can equip one El Cid based on their position, making them even more powerful.
 - El Cid can be obtained by using Mystical Chromatics obtained from “Portrait of Thierry” or the Goddess’ Guidance “Fragments of the Painting”.
 - Obtained El Cids can be equipped on the menu that will be visible after clicking the arrow-shaped button at the bottom right corner of the Book screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/591bf252a4fa9d8cf9f55ccba16798f37562fbe2.jpg[/img]

[h3]■ Changes to Black Mutation[/h3]
 - The “Black Mutation” event will now be available past the event period, and will be changed so that all Masters of the Book can now participate.
 - When participating in the Mutated Area, you will consume the same amount of shoes as the normal Adventure Areas but as the amount of monsters increases, so too will the amount of rewards when using Hero's Shoes.
 - The "Black Mutation" change cycle will be changed from 4 days to 3 days.

[h3]■ Event: 100 Days Commemoration Events[/h3]
 - To express our gratitude to all Masters of the Book who have been with us over the last 100 days, we have prepared a handful of special events:
  : The ‘100-Day Anniversary Event Festival’
  : The 100-Day Miracle Event Brought Together by Destiny‘, where you will be able to obtain one 'Star's Glory,' and one ‘Song of the Weapons.
  : 100-Day Anniversary Login Reward Event
- All of these events will end after the regular maintenance on 08/01.

[h3]■ Event for returning users: The Star Rises Again[/h3]
 - “The Star Rises Again” event will be available to returning Masters of the Book for two weeks after their returning log-in. 
 - “Returning Players” are Masters of the Books who have not accessed the game for 14 consecutive days after clearing Adventure Stage 1-12.
 - This event comes in the form of various Attendance and Mission rewards to help returning Masters of the Book on their journey.

[h3]■ Portrait of Thierry Participation Event: Into the Portrait[/h3]
 - Conduct tasks in the new gamemode “Portrait of Thierry” and receive various rewards.
 - This event will end after the regular maintenance on 9/12.

[h3]■ El Cid Mission Event: El Cid, the Dazzling Breath[/h3]
 - Conduct tasks related to the new equipment type “El Cid” and receive various rewards.
 - This event will end after the regular maintenance on 8/22.

[h3]■ New Event: Fragments of the Painting[/h3]
 - “Fragments of the Painting” is an event where you will be able to obtain new El Cid and the materials needed for upgrading and ascending it.
 - You will be able to obtain El Cid and the upgrade/ascension materials by using the Mystical Chromatics given as a reward on the “Portrait of Thierry” gamemode. Halos exclusive to the new Knight of Veda “Death Crown” and “Aurora” can also be obtained through this event.
 - “Fragments of the Painting” event will be renewed after the regular maintenance on 08/01.

[h3]■ Season Reset: Tower of Trials[/h3]
 - The new Tower of Trials season will end after the regular maintenance on 07/25.
 - Progress on the “Tower of Tasks” achievements that are attached to the 9th and 12th Floors of the Tower of Trials, will be reset. 
 - New achievements “Task Blessings” and “Goddess’ Arrangement” will be introduced.

[h3]■ New Event: Journey in Memory (Death Crown)[/h3]
- During this “Journey in Memory” event, you can try out the 5★ Death Crown, 5★ Aurora, 4★ Nayan and 4★ Ardor.
- This event will end after the maintenance on 08/01.

[h3]■ General Knights of Veda Changes[/h3]
- The growth rate of increasing basic stat options with each 5★ Knight of Veda's Fate upgrades will be increased from 8% to 12%.

The following Knights will receive an additional Increased DEF (%) stat per Fate level:
  - Sansar
  - Nec
  - Sorin

The following Knights will receive an Increased Stamina (%) stat per Fate level:
  - Albert

The following Knights will receive an Increased HP (%) stat per Fate level:
  - Ellen
  - Saeya
  - Sarka
  - Vesti
  - Xanthia

The following Knights will receive an Increased Veda Energy (%) stat per Fate level:
  - Atterisse

The following Knights will receive a Movement SPD Bonus (%) stat per Fate level:
  - Aurora

The following Knights will receive a Reduce All Incoming Damage (%) stat per Fate level:
  - Arin
  - Elias
  - Edward

The following Knights will receive an Increase DoT DMG (%) stat per Fate level:
  - Veleno

[h3]■ Stat changes[/h3]
 - The duration of any movement debuff effects applied will now be reduced more with higher Tenacity values.
  : This applies to stagger/stun/airborne/downed etc.
 - The duration of skills that pull/group Knights of Veda will now be reduced with higher Tenacity values.
  : This includes Xanthia’s Signature Skill “Event Horizon”.
- The probability of staggering effects from attribute attacks corresponding to resistance will be reduced by 50% in the resistance state.
- The critical hit rate of attribute attacks corresponding to resistance is reduced by 50% in the resistance state.

[h3]■ Atterisee[/h3]
 - An issue where Veda Energy is not restored after using Roll! Roll! Roll! will be fixed.

[h3]■ Nec[/h3]
 - Fate 1 effect: Darkness RES will be increased from 5% to 8%.
 - Fate 4 effect: ATK and DEF reduction applied by Roderick will be increased from 15% to 20%.

[h3]■ Saeya[/h3]
 - The heal applied by the “Tidal Oscillations” effect of her skill “Wave of Life” will now apply to all Knights of Veda in her party.

[h3]■ Veleno[/h3]
 - Fate 2 effect: Skill DMG for “Great Doctor's Poison Fog” will now be increased.
 - Fate 6 effect will be changed: Poison Transfer Interval for her skill “Metastases of Poisoning” will be reduced from 1.5s to 1s.

[h3]■ Vesti[/h3]
 - Fate 2 effect: Number of additional jars summoned will be increased from 1 to 2.
 - Fate 6 effect: The damage taken from the cracks created by her skill “Ground Slam” will now be increased 20% from the previous value.
 - The Skill DMG increases given by upgrading her skill “Take this!” will now be increased 25% from the previous value.
 - The Skill DMG increases given by upgrading her skill “Ground Slam!” will now be increased 25% from the previous value.
 - The jars created by Vesti will now expire earlier.

[h3]■ Other Improvements[/h3]
* The maximum number of Hero's Shoes you can have will be increased from 5 to 8.
* Information on ‘Calydon’s Hideout’ and ‘Forgotten Mine’ will be added to the Adventure Guide.

[h3]■ Store Updates[/h3]
* After the update maintenance on July 11th, the following package items will no longer be available for purchase:
 - Legendary Halo Selection Pack
 - Sage’s Scroll Pack
 - Celestial Scroll Pack
 - Sorin Step-up Package I to V
※ The Scroll Package product is scheduled to be released on 07/11 with renewed components.

We hope this update will bring you more exciting adventures in Planis.

Thank you!

Masters of the Book,

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on June 27, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game. 

[h3]■ Update[/h3] [list]
[*] A new ★5 Knight of Veda ‘Sorin’ will arrive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/6015d8e0a1332b180ada236828e6362d822191ef.png[/img]

[Code][b] “Nice to meet you all! I'm Sorin Urora. Call me the Saint of the Sun”[/b]
She is a remarkable knight and a star among the Salvation Knights 
People admire her, and she returns their love
Sorin always wears a bright smile,
but deep down there may be a darker side that remains hidden, perhaps more than anyone can fathom [/code] 

[*] Sorin is a Light-type Melee Healer with a Sword & Shield who heals allies and assists in combat. Her Normal Skill "Answer of the Goddess" deals Light DMG to enemies and heals allies’ HP. Signature Skill "Sunlit Flower" deals Light DMG to a wide area and heals allies over time.

[*] Summons (this includes Nec/Rodrick, Sansar/Narni, Iris/Dekania) are not removed by Sorin’s Signature Skill [Sunlit Flower].
[*] Due to reasons of in-game balance, structures summoned by some bosses will not be removed by [Sunlit Flower]. Affected bosses include:
  * Adventure Dungeon Chapter 6 Boss / Giant Golden Bell
  * Sealed Prison Chapter 3 Boss  / Rolling Quartz Boulders
  * Sealed Prison Chapter 4 Boss / Electric Spheres
  * Sealed Prison Chapter 5 Boss / Glacier Crash, Blizzard


[*]  A new ★4 Knight of Veda ‘Iris’ will also be available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/70d384bca763d0936d2595ba7858b6c34ceed301.png[/img]
[code] [b]“I will achieve great things from now on! Remember this day!”[/b]
She is admired by all, but she also has a passionate admiration for someone. Iris has become a member of the Salvation Knights-in-Training, fueled by her deep admiration for the Great Mage of Earth, Lynn Savage. With a sense of pride in her own abilities, she may encounter setbacks along the way, but she will persevere through these challenges to achieve her dreams[/code]

[*] “Iris” is an Earth-type Ranged Support wielding Wand & Orb. She summons Dekania and drops rocks in combat. Her Normal Skill “Summon Dekania” summons Dekania to taunt enemies, increasing the damage received by the targeted enemy. Her Signature Skill "Grasp of Desire" causes a giant stone hand to rise up, binding enemies and exploding as it disappears, dealing additional DMG [/list]

[h3]■ ‘Black Mutation’  Follow Function[/h3] [list] 
[*] A button will be added so that other knights can follow the currently controlled Knight of Veda. [/list]

[*] A new Tower of Trials season will start after the update and will end after the maintenance on July 11th.
[*] Floors 9 to 12 of the Tower of Trials will be reset.
[*] New blessings "Blessing of Tasks" and "Grace of the Goddess" are applied. [/list]
[h3]■ New Season: Reward Decree[/h3][list]
[*] The new season starts immediately after the maintenance on June 27th and continues until July 31, 06:00 AM (UTC) / July 30, 23:00 (PDT). [/list]
[h3] ■ New Event: "Journey in Memory (Sorin)"[/h3][list]
[*] During this “Journey in Memory” event, you can try out the 5★ Character Sorin, 4★ Iris and 4★ Andrei.
[*] This event will end after the maintenance on July 25th. [/list] 
[h3]■ Arin[/h3][list]
[*] An issue where she did not perform strong attacks under certain conditions in auto-attack mode will be fixed.[/list]
[h3]■ Sansar[/h3][list]
[*] Some changes to her Fate description/effects will be applied:
- Fate level 2 effect: Previously, "Narni Attack Power +19%, Health +12.5%" was applied but missing in the fate description. This will be fixed.
- Fate level 6 effect: "Narni Attack Power +50%" was correctly applied, but displayed as the Fate level 2 effect ("Narni Attack Power +19%, Health +12.5%"). This will be corrected.

* Health: Previously increased by 3% per skill upgrade from a base of 80% (0 Fate), and will be changed to increase by 4.8% per upgrade. [/list] 
[h3] ■ Yanko[/h3][list]
[strike][*] An issue where Fate level 6 description: "Attack Power +40%, Health +33%" was applied but missing in the description will be changed. [/strike]
[*] An issue where Fate level 2 description: “Attack Power +40%, Health +33%" was applied but missing in the description has been changed.” (Updated 07/01 01:55 AM UTC/ 06/30 06:55 PM PDT)
[*] The description for his Normal Skill “Automatic Interceptor” has been modified to display the enhancements given by the Fate level. (Updated 07/01 01:55 AM UTC/ 06/30 06:55 PM PDT)
[/list]


[h3]■ Bug Fixes[/h3][list]
[*] The issue in Battlefield of the War Gods where the Fate level for Knights of Veda not being displayed in the defense/attack setup list will be fixed.

[*] An issue will be fixed where when you’re in the Battlefield of the War Gods' defense and attack setup screens, moving the list of Knights of Veda to the bottom will obscure some areas.

notes.title: 6/13 Update Details (Last updated 06/13 04:58 UTC)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/036f35657ff085a1e2b835901aa669652937280e.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book,

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on June 13, 2024! Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game. 

[h2]■ Update[/h2]
[b]New 5★ Knight of Veda, ‘Vesti’ will be available.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/10e75b5b1e95bf2b334d775b9303882bcb450cb5.png[/img]

[code][b]"Ha! I guess it's finally my turn!"[/b]
If you want to find her, just look down. You'll always spot Vesti lying on the floor, lazily passing the time. However, something motivates Vesti, transforming her. Why do it today when there’s always “tomorrow?” she always thinks. But for once, she decides to do it “today.”[/code]

[list][*] Vesti is an Earth-type Ranged DPS wielding a Staff, but she mostly gives a good kicking ATK to enemies with flying jars.
[*] Normal Skill “Take This!” throws a massive jar and triggers explosions.
[*] Signature Skill “Ground Slam” sends a massive jar crashing to the ground in mid-air, dealing heavy DMG. When using both Normal and Signature Skills, additional DMG can be dealt if the installed jars are still on the ground [/list]

[b] New Content 'Battlefield of the War Gods'[/b][list][*] 'Battlefield of the War Gods' is a new PVP mode where you battle on a recreated battlefield of Veda's descent with her guards.
[*] In this mode, you can form a team of up to 5 Knights of Veda to engage in 5 vs. 5 automatic battles against another player's defense team.
[*] Once the battle begins, your Knights will fight automatically, and you cannot control them manually during the fight.
[*] You can earn initial rank achievement rewards and daily rank rewards, and with the rewards obtained, you can acquire the new equipment 'Halo.'
[*] To access 'Battlefield of the War Gods,' you need to complete the World Mission 'Battlefield of the War Gods,' which is available after clearing Adventure Dungeon 3-12. You can then enter through the new NPC 'Baldur' in Todburg Village.
- 'Battlefield of the War Gods Challenge Tickets' are recharged daily at 11:00 PM PDT / 06:00 AM UTC. You can only have a maximum of 5 tickets.
- The daily recharge count for 'Battlefield of the War Gods Challenge Tickets' resets at 11:00 PM PDT / 06:00 AM UTC every day.
- Daily ranking rewards for the Battlefield of the War Gods can be claimed once based on the current rank from 11:00 PM PDT / 06:00 AM each day until 10:59 PM PDT / 05:59 AM UTC the following day. [/list]

[b]New Equipment 'Halo'[/b][list][*] 'Halo' is a new item that symbolizes the glory given by the goddess to Veda's guards, enhancing the abilities of the Knights of Veda.
[*] Knights of Veda can equip 'Halo,' which boosts their abilities when worn.
[*] You can obtain 'Halo' through Radiance, which is earned from the Guidance of the Goddess 'Mark of the Sworn Loyalty.'
[*] Radiance can be earned as a reward from the new content 'Battlefield of the War Gods' and can also be exchanged in the Support Shop and the Exchange Starstones section in the shop.
[*] The 'Halo' you possess can be equipped by clicking the arrow-shaped button at the bottom right of the Book screen, where the 'Halo' section will be displayed.
[*] In the Halo equipment screen, you can hide the appearance of the equipped Halo through the settings at the bottom left. [/list]

[b]New Event: 'Black Mutation'[/b][list] [*] The new event 'Black Mutation' is a PVE event that takes place in the 'Black Mutation' area where mysterious black energy rises from the ground in the adventure dungeon.
[*] During the 'Black Mutation' event, you can observe anomalies in specific adventure zones every four days.
[*] When entering an area affected by the Black Mutation, a team of four Knights of Veda will begin the battle simultaneously.
[*] During the battle, only one Knight of Veda can be controlled, while the other three will fight automatically.
[*] In the 'Black Mutation' area, the amount of Adventurer's Boots consumed when receiving rewards is halved, and exclusive Black Mutation trophies are additionally awarded.
[*] The 'Black Mutation' event will end after the regular maintenance on Thursday, July 11 [/list]

[b]New Event: 'Mark of the Sworn Loyalty' event where you can obtain the new equipment 'Halo' and 'Halo enhancement materials.'[/b][list] [*] In the 'Mark of the Sworn Loyalty' event, you can use the Radiance obtained from the new content 'Battlefield of the War Gods' to acquire 'Halo.'
[*] During the event, you can get attribute-specific 'Halo' and 'Halo enhancement materials.' You can also obtain a special signature Halo for the new Knight of Veda, 'Vesti,' but only for a limited time.
[*] The 'Mark of the Sworn Loyalty' event will be updated after the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, June 27 [/list]

[b]New Event: ‘War of the Gods’ event for participating in the ‘Battlefield of the War Gods’[/b] [list] [*] Participate in the event while the new content 'Battlefield of the War Gods' is ongoing and earn various rewards.
[*] The 'War of the Gods' event will end after the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, July 11 [/list]

[b]New Event: ‘Heavenly Light, Halo’ Mission Event[/b] [list]- The 'Heavenly Light, Halo' event will end after the scheduled maintenance on Thursday, July 25 [/list]

[b]‘Journey in Memory (Vesti)’ Event[/b] [list] [*] During this “Journey in Memory” event, you can try out the 5★ Character Vesti, 4★ Capecchi and 4★ Marthel.  
[*] This event will be active until the regular maintenance on Thursday, June 27. [/list]

[b]Other Updates[/b][list]
[*] Calydon Dungeon and the Forgotten Mine will no longer appear through lost items and will be accessible at all times.
- Calydon Dungeon will be permanently located in Adventure Zone 2 (Chapter 2 - Plagued Dark Forest) , and the Forgotten Mine will be permanently located in Adventure Zone 3 (Chapter 3 - Abyssal Cavern of Cultists).
- You can enter each dungeon up to 3 times per day, with rewards increased by 1.5 times compared to before.
- The daily entry limit resets at 11 PM (PDT) / 6 AM (UTC) every day.
[*]  With the addition of the new equipment 'Halo,' new achievements will be added. Achieve these milestones by obtaining and enhancing the Halo to earn Starstones.
[*]  A 'Quick Emoticon' feature will be added to facilitate easy communication with other Masters of the Book during co-op play.
[*]  A feature will be added to allow the use of strong attacks during auto-battle. [/list]

[h2]■ Improvements[/h2]
[list][*] The animation time for automatic enchantments and socket creation has been improved to be twice as fast as before.[/list]

[h3]General Balance[/h3][list]
[*] The "active resistance" for Knights of Veda who use melee weapons will be increased by 40% compared to before.
 - Reverse active resistance remains the same.
[*] The time during which Knights of Veda who use melee weapons are staggered when hit while sprinting will be reduced by 75% compared to before.
[*] The delay before the next action after dodging for melee attack Knights of Veda will be reduced.
[*] When resistance is triggered by an enemy's attack, movement control skills (e.g., Xanthia's signature skill [Event Horizon]) will be improved to provide a certain amount of protection against skills of the same element that hinder movement.
[*] Emergency evasion will now be allowed after a certain period of time when exposed to Xanthia’s Signature Skill [Event Horizon]. [/list]
[h3]Arin[/h3][list]
[*] The delay of the third and fourth attacks in the normal attack [Shadow Slash] will be reduced by 28.5% compared to before.
[*] The hit range of the normal attack [Shadow Slash] will be increased by approximately 14% vertically.
[*] The activation condition for [Death's Grip] with the normal skill at Fate 2 will be eased from requiring 4 hits to just 3 hits for additional damage. Additionally, the damage will be increased from 42% to 63%, enhancing the overall damage effect of the normal skill.
[*] The damage for [Death’s Grip] at Fate 2 will be increased from 42% to 63%. [/list]
[h3]Edward[/h3][list]
[*] Using the signature skill [Time for Punishment] will now apply a 10% Damage Reduction buff, allowing for more aggressive play. 
[*] After using the signature extend skill [Wounds of Flames], you will be able to attack again more quickly. [/list]
[h3]Atterisee[/h3][list]
[*] The normal skill [Roll Roll Roll!] will now include a 30% DEF reduction effect.
[*] The normal skill [Roll Roll Roll!] will be improved to work more accurately.[/list]
[h3]Veleno[/h3][list]
[*] The signature skill [Metastases of Poisoning] will be adjusted to move slightly backward when used. [/list]
[h3]Rani[/h3][list]
[*] The damage of the Strong Attack, [Midday Beam] will increase by around 25%. [/list]
[h3]Andrei[/h3][list]
[*] The skill range of [Blazing Pillar] will increase by around 25%. (For Fate 4 Andrei, it will increase by around 20% more than previously). 
[*] The signature extend skill [Burn] will now inflict a ‘Burn’ DoT for 3 sec. [/list]
[h3]Yanko[/h3][list]
[*] The skill [Complete the Bond] will now pierce enemies (up to 2 times) when Yanko reaches Fate Level 4.[/list]
[h3]Eliyar[/h3][list]
[*] The signature skill [Reindeer Strong Bow] has been adjusted to allow for a quicker follow-up attack.
 - Normal Skill [Consecutive Strike]: (Before) 1.93 sec. -> (After) 1.35 sec.
 - Strong Attack [Fine Sight]: (Before) 0.5 sec. -> (After) 0.4 sec.
 - Normal Skill [Throwing Trap]: (Before) 1.3sec.  -> (After) 0.9 sec. [/list]
[h3]Nayan[/h3][list]
[*] The health-based recovery value of Nayan will be changed to include the effects of cooking and Tower of Trials buffs. 
[*] The health based damage and health based heals of Nayan will be changed to be based on her current maximum HP, which can change based on buffs and debuffs, instead of the base maximum HP. [/list]
[h3]Nec[/h3][list]
[*] The Abyssal Eye effect of Nec’s Signature Weapon [Misplaced Love] will be changed to also apply to HP-based damage. 
[*] The summon, Roderick, will be modified so that the [Abyssal Eye] effect from the [Misplaced Love] weapon will apply to it.[/list]

[h3]Option Balancing[/h3][list]
[*] The existing “Guard Rate(%)” option will be replaced with “Absolute Defense(%)’.
 - The existing “Guard Rate” effect will be retained, reducing stamina consumption and increasing the amount of Veda’s Energy restored when guarding. (This effect has a cap of 80%).
 - While guarding, the amount of stamina consumed will be reduced by the “Absolute Defense” value, and the amount of Veda’s Energy restored will increase. 
 - [Minimum Defense] guarantees that your minimum defense is equal to a percentage of your [Absolute Defense], and will apply from any damaging threat, even when you are not guarding. 
 - It remains effective above the maximum [Guard Rate] value of 80%, but its efficiency gradually decreases near this threshold.

[b][*] Improvements will be made to allow the “Damage over Time (%)” option to be obtained when enchanting Accessories with 3★ Galaxy Scrolls and 4★ Celestial Scrolls.
[*] “Damage over Time (%)” option to be obtained when enchanting Weapons with 3★ Mage's Scroll and 4★ Sage's Scroll.
[*] ‘DoT(%)’ option has been improved to increase the damage amount according to a character’s level. 
[*] New options have been added.
 - Bleed DMG Bonus : Can be obtained by crafting Blood attribute gems.
 - Burn DMG Bonus : Can be obtained by crafting Fire attribute gems.
 - Shock DMG Bonus : Can be obtained by crafting lightning attribute gems. 
 - Poison Effect DMG Bonus : Can be obtained by crafting poison attribute gems
  : These options will have higher base values than the “Damage over Time (%)” option. [/b] Updated: 06/13 04:58 UTC

[*] ‘Reduce Incoming Wound Rate(%)’ option will be improved so it can be increased to 36%
[*] ‘ATK Bonus(%)’ option will be improved to apply to both “Attack Power” and “Attribute Attack Power”.[/list]

[h2]■ Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the ‘Ruthless Intruder’ set 4-piece bonus where it applied 13% Veda Energy instead of 13.  
[*] An issue will be fixed where skill levels were correctly applied only up until level 11, and skill levels beyond this would have lower values than displayed. 
[*] An issue where guild chat would not send correctly if the message was too long will be fixed. 
[*] The issue where the preview stats of a tunic ascension would display as the current tunic level has been fixed. 
[*] An issue where the Hero’s Shoes shortcut key “Q” would close the Veda’s Return popup will be rectified. 
[*] An issue where attempting to match with other players without first completing the first adventure stage would show incorrect numbers has been fixed. 
[*] The Call of the Stars animation that incorrectly played when collecting crafted weapons will be fixed. 
[*] When previewing ascensions for Knights, equipment and Tunics at level 90 will now display the correct materials.
[*] An issue where the item “Weights of Ambition” would show as an available item for Adventure Level 3 ‘Luminous Hall of Nightmares’ will be fixed.
[*] The issue where the “Steps of the Journey” item had a “Use” button in the inventory will be fixed.
[*] In the achievements window, the ‘Jack of All Trades Vol. 2” achievement icon was showing incorrectly. This will be fixed. [/list]

We hope this update will bring you more exciting adventures in Planis.

Thank you

[code][b]"Don't come any closer. Then, I'll help you"[/b]
She was known as the Flower of Neejarem, adorned with breathtaking beauty and a captivating voice.
But do not be fooled by her charming appearance.
A knight, reborn as a departed soul, protects her with unwavering loyalty.
She will never forgive those who seek to hinder her love.[/code]

[list]
[*] “Nec” is a Darkness-type Ranged Support wielding Wand & Orb, ensuring stability in battles through swift elemental ATKs.
[*] Normal Skill “Bansch's Dance” generates a black orb that reacts to ATKs, dealing additional DMG to enemies while aiding allies in battles.
[*] Signature Skill “The Dark Sign of Love” summons “Roderick,” the Knight of Darkness, to provoke and attack enemies while supporting allies in battles

[*] New 4★ Knight of Veda, ‘Emile von Kroos’ will be available.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d12bfe1a4182536eba1cbe94473dfdf857e6a59b.png[/img]

[code][b]"S-sneeze! Oh, sorry…! I've come to send lo-love!"[/b]
A frail priest in training at the Lloyd Papal Court who dreams of spreading love to people all over the world. The girl firmly believes that by giving her all and sharing the power of love, she will earn love in return. This innocence has the extraordinary ability to make the world a more beautiful place, but… it also sometimes invites misfortune.[/code] 

[list]
[*] “Emile” is a Water-type Ranged Support wielding a Staff, using a skill that slows down and freezes enemies' every movement.
[*] Normal Skill “Crystal of Blessing” maintains generated ice crystals while granting the “Frost Crystal” effect to enemies that attack you.
[*] Signature Skill “Crystal of Love” deals wide-area DMG to multiple enemies, slowing down their movement and ATKs to provide support to allies in battles

[*] Tower of Trials Season Improvements
 - From the 9th to the 12th floors of the Tower of Trials, the completion rates for the Tower of Quests' will be reset, and new ‘Quest Blessings' and 'Goddess's Arrangements' will be applied.
 - New Tower of Trials Season ends before the 6/27 maintenance.

 - During Arena Season 2, participate in various missions to earn special rewards such as tunics, namecards, emoticons, and more.
 - Last Season's Crowns of Victory progress will be reset.
 - Arena Season 2 ends before the 7/25 maintenance.
[*] Features will be added to enhance your experience in the Arena.
 - A rematch button will be added to the Arena results screen, allowing quick rematching after a match ends.
 - The progress icon will be moved to the bottom left area of the waiting room for easier tracking of Arena progress.
 - Arena Survival mode, previously available from Thursday to Sunday, will now be accessible daily.
[*] A new function will be added so Masters of the Book can check their Call of the Stars record
 - Will be adding a button for everyone to be able to check their Call of the Stars record.
[*] A new feature will be added to automate enchantments and socket crafting. 
 - Using the Auto feature, you can automatically proceed with Enchanting and Socket crafting until you get the desired options. 
[*] A new feature will be added to enable you to batch synthesize Gems. 
 - You will be able to synthesize up to 50 gems of the same grade at once. 
[*] Item Synthesis is being updated to allow for easier synthesis of materials from the same series by grade. Item synthesis will now be more convenient.  
[*] The Knight of Veda, ‘Ardor’ and his weapon, 'Death Cry' will be added to the possible results of the Fallen Wing of Veda Call of the Stars and the Event Call of the Stars. 
 - Ardor and his weapon will not be available in the “Start the Call of the Stars” or the “Knight’s First Leap”.

 - (Before) Increases Stamina Cost by 10% but also increases DMG dealt by a Strong ATK by 35%
 - (After) Increases DoT by 30% and Strong ATK DMG by 35%
[*] The number of times you can encounter the Giant Spider in the Forgotten Mines has been increased from 5 to 7. More attacks will now yield more enhancement stones than before.
[/list]

[h3] ■ Events [/h3][list]
[*] The “Blessing in Nightmare” event will be active, allowing you to earn double the rewards from Veda’s Nightmare.
 - During the ‘Blessing in Nightmare’ event, you can earn double the rewards from Veda’s Nightmare, up to a certain limit.
 - The “Blessing in Nightmare” event will run until the regular maintenance on Thursday, June 13. 

[*] The “Blessing of Calydon” event will be active, allowing you to earn double rewards from the Calydon Dungeon. 
 - During the “Blessing of Calydon” event, you can earn double rewards from the Calydon Dungeon, up to a certain limit. 
 - The “Blessing of Calydon” event will run until the regular maintenance on Thursday, June 13. 

[*] Starting May 31, 2024 11:00 PM PDT/June 1, 2024 6:00 AM UTC, we're launching The Fruits of Adventure event, where you can earn rewards by attending every day for a month.
 - The Fruits of Adventure event is an ongoing attendance event that resets and recurs on a monthly basis.
 - The attendance chart will reset on the first of each month, and even if you don't earn all the rewards, you'll start over at the reset point.
[*] The “Journey in Memory (Nec)” event will be available.

[h3] ■ Bug Fixes [/h3] [list]

[*] A bug where the item count does not update after purchases in the Wandering Merchant's shop will be resolved.
[*] The issue where the shoe area does not display correctly when using Veda's Return during 'Elita's Request' world/knight missions will be fixed.

[*] Fixes an issue where gamepad key settings could be set incorrectly.

[h3] ■ Changes [/h3] [list]

Masters of the Book,

Currently there is an issue with the 'Trial of the Goddess' mission in Finar's Reward Decree, which began with the May 16th update.

To complete the 'Trial of the Goddess' mission, you need to achieve 12 challenge goals in the Tower of Trials. If you have fewer than 12 trophies left due to your previous progress, you won't be able to complete this mission until the new Tower of Trials season starts in two weeks.

We understand this inconvenience and will address it in the next maintenance.
- Affected users: Masters of the Book with fewer than 12 trophies left as of May 16th.
- Action: We'll add counts to the 'Trial of the Goddess' mission.
- Schedule: During maintenance on May 23rd

This issue arose because the Tower of Trials and Reward Decree seasons don't align, affecting those who have cleared the Tower of Trials with more than 96 total trophies.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/3202938e6fe17e009f732dfcc4c0b6cf2e476b73.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book, 

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on May 16, 2024! Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game. 

[h2]■ Update[/h2] [list]
[*] New 5★ Knight of Veda, ‘Ellen Farrell’ will be available.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/5eabe80ddf5610eefd53e5416ffaeaffd772dcba.png[/img] 

[code][h3]"I am responsible for lives"[/h3]

A boy who had learned the weight of life at a young age hated his weakness. Not wanting to lose innocent lives in vain, all he could do was try. As always, he will continue to put his all into betterment, however slight. After all, even the weak can become strong and protect those weaker than themselves…
[/code] 

[list][*] "Ellen Farrell" is a Water-type melee DPS with a greatsword. He uses his long reach and attacks to gain the "Wave" buff and consumes stacks of "Wave" for powerful attacks. His Normal Skill, "Training Sword of Life", allows him to leap at enemies and bring down his greatsword, then unleash a fan-shaped blast of water energy to keep both melee and ranged enemies at bay. His Signature Skill, "Sword of Waves", unleashes accumulated "Wave" stacks at once for a devastating DMG

[*] A new Hero’s Mission, ‘Tangled Secrets’ has been added. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/aa511e733b2634c79b61180475ea1dc6635706fe.jpg[/img]
[i]An unexplained kidnapping case has occurred in Todburg. Suspecting the beast "Aurora" as the culprit, self-proclaimed detective Belle sets out with the Master of the Book to investigate.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/c43d846fcba3cf00ef9cff931eb208e4360ce4af.jpg[/img]
[i]In a desolate mine, haunted by a strange howling. The crime scene is filled with a strange energy. Just then, a completely unexpected truth unfolds before the Master of the Book...[/i]

[*] The new Hero Mission, ‘Tangled Secrets’, will allow Masters of the Book to progress through the story of the Knight of Veda, ‘Aurora’.
    - ‘Tangled Secrets’ can be obtained through Lionel after clearing Adventure Stage 5-6, and completing the Forgotten Mine World Mission. 

[*] New features will be added for co-op mode. 
   - A ‘Quick Invite’ feature will be added, which will allow players to quickly invite their previous team mates to another co-op adventure. 
   - A matchmaking feature will be added, allowing players to quickly join other Masters of the Book for battle. 

[*] The ability to break down higher-level Skill and Ascension materials into lower-grade materials will be added. 
   - You can choose to disassemble items in the inventory, making it easier to secure the desired materials. 

[*] A double item drop event will be added to the game. 
   - Stages that fall under the ‘Adventure’ tab in the Adventure Guide will have double rewards (up to a certain limit). 
   - This event will run until May 30th, 2024 before the regular maintenance. 

[*] For a limited time, the ‘Drink Cool Lime with Belle Snow’ event will run, which includes new recipes to create. 
   - Everyone can participate in the  ‘Drink Cool Lime with Belle Snow’ event as there are no Master of the Book level requirements.
   - During the event, you can create ‘Cool Lime Smoothie’ and ‘Cool Lime Ade’ by using ‘Herbs’, ‘Water,’ and ‘Sugar’ obtained through stages, and ‘Lime’ which is available from the cooking shop in limited quantities.
   - The ‘Drink Cool Lime with Belle Snow’ event will run until June 13, 2024 regular maintenance. 

[*] A new Reward Decree begins.
   -  The new reward decree will begin immediately after the May 16 Update, and will conclude until 06:00 UTC on June 25. 

[*] ‘Journey in Memory(Ellen Farell Experience)’ event will be available.
   - In this event, you can experience the newest Knight of Veda, 5★ Ellen Farell, along with 4★ Yanko and 4★ Rani.   

[*] The ‘Warm May’ attendance reward event will begin. 
   - Login over 7 days and you will receive various rewards. 
   - The ‘Warm May’ attendance event will run until May 30th, 2024 maintenance. 

[*] The special mission event, ‘Adventure with Luck’ will begin.
   - Over 7 days, you’ll be given special missions to earn various rewards
   - The ‘Adventure with Luck’ event will run until the May 30th, 2024 regular maintenance. 
[/list] 

[h2] ■ Improvements [/h2] [list]
[*] 'Elemental RES' will now affect 'Reflected Damage'
   - When your opponent's Resistance is activated, Reflected Damage rate will be decreased so you will take less reflected damage.
   - The 'Reflected Damage' you take will be affected by your 'Elemental RES'
   - Reflected Damage' will now be counted as Elemental Damage, and together will affect 'Resistance' activation.
   - When 'Resistance' is active, it will no longer reflect 'Reflected Damage' back to the opponent.
   - After 'Resistance' has been activated, 'Damage Reflection' effect will not activate for 1 sec.
   - The in-game balance will be adjusted as follows:

- When the Signature Skill of the Knight of Veda Albert, 'The Roar of the Golden Lion' has been activated, the 'Lion’s Blessing' Damage reflection rate of the summoned Lion Statue will increase from 50% to 100%. (100% to 200% at 6 fate level)

- Damage Reflection rate of the Relic set Sculptor of Despair(4-set effect), will increase from 120% to 250%.

[*] The ‘Goddess’ Arrangement’ and ‘Challenge Prayers’ on floors 7 and 8 of the Tower of Trials will have their cooldown times changed. 

   - On the 7th Floor of the Tower of Trials, the Goddess’s Arrangement will change from “Hitting an enemy increases ATK by +10% and Decreases DEF by 10%” with a 10 second cooldown, to “Hitting an enemy increases ATK by +10% and Decreases DEF by 10%” with a 20 second cooldown.

   - On the 8th Floor of the Tower of Trials, the Goddess’s Arrangement will change from “Additionally increases CRIT Chance +15% for 15 sec upon using a Signature Skill. (This effect can be triggered once every 15 sec)” to “Additionally increases CRIT Chance +15% for 15 sec upon using a Signature Skill. (This effect can be triggered once every 30 sec). 

   - The “Challenge Prayer” buff will change from “Increasing damage on Dodge for 15 seconds with a cooldown of 20 seconds, to a cooldown of 35 seconds. 

[*] For effects with a duration, such as Relic 4-set effects and Weapon effects, the duration will now be included in the ‘cooldown time’. 
[*] The cooldown time of certain Relic 4-set effects will be removed or adjusted. 

[b]Cooldown Time Removed[/b]
- Eternal Graveyard Set
- Swift Messenger Set
- Legendary Oceanographer Set
- Last Royal of Stormhold Set
- Silent Slave Set

[b]Cooldown Time Adjusted[/b]
- Wanderer of Repentance Set
The cooldown time of the 4 second duration buff effect will be adjusted from 8 seconds to 9 seconds (due to improvements in the cooldown mechanics, the actual duration will decrease from 12 seconds to 9 seconds.) 

[*] The reset times for certain in-game content will be changed. Please refer to the separate notice for more details.  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2484250/view/4167595772890741261?l=english](link)[/url]
[*] To enhance the readability of attribute images, each attribute icon will be resized. 
[*] The most recent login platform will now be more easily recognizable when you login. 
[/list]

[h2]■ Bug Fixes[/h2] [list]
[*] An issue will be fixed where the Knight of Veda ‘Eliyar’ had her signature skill, “Reindeer Strong Bow’s” damage and bleed damage scale on her basic attack level and not her Signature Skill Level.  
[*] The issue where the Wanderer of Repentance Relic 4-set effect “100% reduction in Veda’s Energy Consumption” was activating without the prerequisite “After using the Signature Skill” will be fixed. 
[*] The issue where the Skill Cut-ins would still display in stages even after they were turned off in the Settings > Other > Activate Display of Signature Skill cut-in(s) will be fixed.  
[*] The issue where when switching channels, the screen moving forward to Himmith will be fixed. 
[*] The intermittent issue where Relic set images were not displayed in the Relic filter will be fixed.  
[*] An issue will be fixed where the Story dungeon for Chapter 5 stages 1 and 2 were outputting as normal dungeons to party members. 
[*] An issue will be fixed where certain item information popups were truncated on certain mobile devices.
[*] An issue will be fixed where the UI would disappear when entering and exiting the store via item navigation. 
[*] An issue will be fixed where when registering and unregistering a leveled up Relic would continue to show the EXP gained by consuming the Relic. 
[*] The issue where achievement completion notifications would be displayed even after completing all achievements in a category will be fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue with Nayan's Signature Skill, "Calling Spirits!" where Fate Level 3 was not applying correctly to the third hit of the skill. 
[*] Fixed an issue with Veleno's "Metastases of Poisoning" where Fate Level 3 was not applying correctly to the third hit of the skill.  [/list] 

Thank you for continuing to show your support for ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

notes.title: May 9th Update Details
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/036f35657ff085a1e2b835901aa669652937280e.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book, 

The May 9 update is here, and this update will see changes to Nightmare mode for Adventure Levels 7 and 8, as well as changes to Apostles. Find out what’s in store for the May 9th Update below!  


[h2]■ Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]For Adventure levels 7 and 8, Veda’s Nightmare will now guarantee a minimum number of 5★ Relics.  
   · For Adventure Level 7, a minimum of 1 general 5★ Relic will be guaranteed to drop. 
   · For Adventure Level 8, Veda’s Nightmare will guarantee 1 general 5★ Relic, and 1 elemental 5★ Relic, totaling  2 guaranteed 5★ Relics.
   · The maximum number of 5★ Relics obtainable remains unchanged, ensuring a minimum drop count to avoid cases where no Relics would drop. 

[*]For Adventure levels 7 and 8, Sealed Prisons will now guarantee a minimum number of 5★ Necklaces or Rings. 
  · In Adventure Level 7, one 5★ Necklace or Ring that matches the attribute of the appearing boss will be guaranteed to drop.
   · In Adventure Level 8, one 5★ Necklace or Ring that matches the attribute of the appearing boss will be guaranteed to drop, along with the Adventure Level 7 guaranteed drop, resulting in two obtainable 5★ Necklaces or Rings.
   · The maximum number of 5★ Necklaces or Rings obtainable remains unchanged, ensuring a minimum drop count to avoid cases where no Relics would drop. 

[*]On stages where the ‘Apostle’ type monster can appear, an improvement is being made so that if it does not appear in three consecutive runs, it will be guaranteed to appear in the next stage. 
   · The existing probability of an ‘Apostle’ appearing remains unchanged.
   · The appearance of an ‘Apostle’ is counted after clearing a stage and consuming shoes.
Due to this rule, when using Hero’s Shoes, the guaranteed appearance will occur at least twice. 
   · Regardless of this feature, When the ‘Apostle’ appears, the guaranteed appearance opportunity is consumed. 
   ·This feature does not count when playing together. However, the number of non-appearances of the ‘Apostle’ is counted, and when the ‘Apostle’ appears, the guaranteed appearance opportunity is applied. 

   · Example: If the ‘Apostle’ does not appear in co-op more than 6 times, the opportunity for 2 appearances will be maintained, which will apply to a single player run. 

   · Even if there is one guaranteed appearance opportunity due to this rule, if the ‘Apostle’ appears when playing together, the guaranteed opportunity will be consumed. 

[*]The Unique Stat that increases incrementally with each Fate level of a 5★ Knight of Veda will be changed. 
   · Unique Stat Example: Veleno: Poison DMG Bonus / Aurora: Light DMG Bonus. 
   · The stat at 0 Fate will be increased to 300% of its original Value, and Fate Level 6 will increase to 111% of its original value. 
- The unique stats that increase incrementally with each refinement of  5★ weapons will be changed. 
   · Example of Unique Stats: Bow of Sacrifice: ATK SPD, DoT / Light-speed Bow: CRIT chance, ATK SPD
   · At 0 Refinement, the unique stats will be increased to 150% of its original value, and Refinement level 6 will increase to 105% of its original value. 
[/list]

[h2]■ Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The issue where in the arena, the amount of Crowns of Victory obtained did not display correctly, will be fixed. 
[*]The issue where the end date for the current Tower of Trials event displayed incorrectly from the scheduled end date will be fixed. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the background music would not play in certain places.
[/list]
Thank You

notes.title: 5/2 Update Details (Updated 5/2 06:09 UTC)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/036f35657ff085a1e2b835901aa669652937280e.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book, 

The veiled woman traversing moonlight ‘Lightning-fast Arrow’ Aurora has arrived.
The "One Week’s Journey" event is now live, offering a range of enhancement materials for logging in daily over a week. Together with the rebooted "Fateful Encounter," this event supports the progression of all Masters of the Book who join us in ASTRA: Knights of Veda. From Thursday to Sunday, experience the thrill of survival in the "Arena Survival – For the Thrill of Survival" and face new challenges in the "Tower of Trials." Prepare to discover your enhanced abilities!

Keep reading for more details about what’s coming!

[h1] ■ Update [/h1]
[list] 
[*]The new 5★ character, Aurora, is here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/7ad43e747a2bebf5157e781e3edcbdb0b2d4a844.png[/img]


[code] [b]"I followed the thread of destiny"[/b]
Every time the moonlight appears, Aurora vanishes suddenly, her true intentions known to none. She roams the world in search of the Book, concealing her innermost thoughts, leaving her true motives wrapped in mystery. [/code]

"Aurora" is a Light-type ranged dealer, wielding a large bow. When she deals CRIT DMG with her Normal ATKs, she gains the "Retribution" effect to amplify DMG dealt. Her Normal Skill, "Arrow Festival", allows her to dodge backwards while firing arrows to keep incoming enemies at bay. Her Signature Skill, "Light-Speed Kicks", deals DMG to nearby enemies, and after dealing CRIT DMG for a period of time, she gains the "Extermination" effect, allowing her to finish off enemies with even more power.

[*]  A new 4★ Knight of Veda, Elias, has been released. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/6bbfce7688e8292a78ba0e7272b4f5af3c01a74e.png[/img]

[code] [b]"Rules are Rules!"[/b]
He is renowned for being an unwavering believer in his principles, refusing to make any compromises. His steadfast dedication to his principles has earned him the nickname, "That's what Elias would do," a phrase often used to describe someone inflexible. However, his unwavering principles have made him stronger, and his selfless devotion to the House of Segric compels him to embark on a new adventure.
[/code] 

“Elias” is a Electric-type Melee DPS wielding a Large Axe, electrocuting enemies and dealing CRIT for an explosive match. Normal Skill “Lesson of Principles” wields an axe to electrocute targets and their nearby enemies. Signature Skill “Lightning Leap” leaps up lightning-fast and lands an axe to deal wide-area electric DMG.

[*] - New content, ‘Survival Arena,’ is being added.
   · Survival Arena is open 4 days a week, Thursday through till Sunday, where up to 10 Masters of the Book can engage in battles to be the last Master of the Book standing. 
   · The longer the match, the smaller the arena shrinks, and the map is filled with various buffs and hiding spots to launch a surprise attack. 
   · Crowns of Victory will be distributed according to placement, and progression rewards will also be obtained.
   · You can access ‘Survival Arena’ from the Arena menu. 
[*]  A new ‘Survival Arena’ season begins. 
   · During the new ‘Survival Arena’ season, you can participate in events, complete missions, and earn great rewards. 
   ·  The ‘Survival Arena’ will conclude after the 5/30 maintenance. 
[*] A new Tower of Trials season begins
   · Floors 9 to 12 of the Tower of Trials have been reset, and new blessings, and the Goddess’ Arrangement will be applied. 
   · The new Tower of Trials season will conclude during the 5/30 maintenance. 
[*] The ‘Weekly Journey’ attendance event begins.
   · Log into the game for 7 days and receive various rewards. 
   · The ‘Weekly Journey’ event ends during the 5/16 maintenance. 
[*] Added new Birthday Features for Masters of the Book, Belle, and the Knights of Veda
   · On each birthday, you’ll receive a special letter and rewards. 
[/list] 

[h1] ■ Improvements [/h1]

[h3]Xanthia[/h3]
[*] Xanthia’s teleport (evasion), will have the cooldown reduced by 30%, from 2 seconds to 1.4 seconds. 
[*] The damage from the normal skill "Law of Gravity" and Signature Skill "Event Horizon," was previously distributed evenly, will now be segmented into early, mid, and late stages. 

[b]‘Law of Gravity’[/b]
(Before) 9.44% 10 Hits (total 94.4% damage)
(After) 18.8% 2 hits, 12.56% 3 hits, 7.52% 5 hits (total 112.88% damage) 

[b]‘Event Horizon’[/b]
(Before) 27.12% 10 Hits (total 271.2% damage)
(After) 54.24% 2 hits, 36.16% 3 hits, 21.68% 5 hits (total 325.26% damage)

[b]‘Event Horizon’ (With Fate 2 or higher)[/b]

(After) 54.24% 3 hits, 36.16% 5hits, 21.68% 7hits (total 508.8% damage)


[h3] Albert [/h3]
[*] Albert’s base damage threshold will be increased by 30% (applies to all Knights of Veda with Defense-based damage)

[b]‘Sacred Hammer’[/b]
(Before) Projectile Damage = DEF-Based 11.06%, AoE DMG = DEF-based 55.34%
(After) Projectile Damage = DEF-Based 14.46%, AoE DMG = DEF-based 72.37%

[b]‘Roar of the Golden Lion’[/b]
(Before) Statue Fall DMG = DEF-Based 43.67%, 'Leap of the Golden Lion' DMG = DEF-based 14.7%
(After) Statue Fall DMG = DEF-Based 57.11%, 'Leap of the Golden Lion' DMG = DEF-based 19.22%

[b]‘Roar of the Golden Lion’ (Fate 2 or higher)[/b]
(Before) Statue Fall DMG = DEF-Based 53.94%,  'Leap of the Golden Lion' DMG = DEF-based 17.65%
(After) Statue Fall DMG = DEF-Based 70.52%,  'Leap of the Golden Lion' DMG = DEF-based  23.08%

[*]The third strike of “Power of Earth” (normal attack) will be changed to defense-based damage. 
Damage will change from ATK 72% to DEF-based 55.38%

notes.title: Director's First Update on Future Plans Pt. 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d9584f71da4a41f954c70a084ef74d6d341d7a88.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book, this is Youngmo Kim, Director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.
We sincerely appreciate your love and enjoyment of ASTRA: Knights of Veda, despite its various shortcomings. We apologize for the delay in our communications through developer's notes, as our priority has been to address urgent issues. Today, I'd like to provide further details that were not fully covered in my initial letter.


[h2]Frequent Feedback on the Balance of Knights of Veda[/h2]
After the adjustment of the [Ignore DEF(%)] stat on April 18, we are preparing for further stat adjustments on May 2. We ask for your understanding in advance and aim to provide an early explanation of these adjustments.
Many of you have commented on the change to the [Ignore DEF(%)] value on April 18. High-level players, who primarily farm mobs with high defense (higher levels and grades), have found that [Ignore DEF(%)] provides up to three times greater efficiency than [Attack Power(%)], reducing the value of other options. This imbalance necessitated a prompt revision.

It was a necessary step to refine the balance of current and future Knights of Veda and their equipment. However, the significant adjustments disappointed many players, and we sincerely apologize for not explaining these changes adequately beforehand.
As previously mentioned, when a specific stat or capability becomes overly dominant, it undermines the relevance of other options, making rebalancing necessary. Ideally, these issues should have been identified and addressed during testing. We apologize for this oversight and assure you that we are committed to preventing similar issues in the future.

[h2]Upcoming Adjustments on May 2:[/h2]
The issue where the stat increase of the [Elemental ATK] on rings was inadvertently set to half of the intended amount will be corrected. 
Additionally, a problem where the [Movement SPD] and [ATK SPD] stats were not being properly combined will also be fixed.
For rings increasing in [Elemental ATK], the base value for [ATK] was initially set to double that of [Attack Power], but the stat increase was mistakenly set to match that of [ATK]. This will be corrected to reflect the intended design of doubling the stat increase of [ATK].

Unlike [ATK], [Elemental ATK] does not benefit from the [ATK(%)] option, hence it has a higher base value. If [ATK(%)] is kept below a certain threshold, [Elemental ATK] proves to be more efficient, and if it is above that, [ATK] becomes more efficient.

[h3]Cap Limitations:[/h3]
Furthermore, we will implement caps on the stats for [Guard Rate] and [Reduce Veda Energy Consumption]. The cap for [Guard Rate] will be set at 80%, and for [Reduce Veda Energy Consumption], it will be 30%.

[Guard Rate] is an option available only to Knights of Veda who have 'guard' type heavy attacks. These knights inherently possess a certain level of [Guard Rate], making it one of the easier stats to enhance. While achieving 100% is relatively simple, at this level, guarding consumes no stamina, which could lead to unexpected behaviors and problems in various content, hence the need for adjustment.

Considering the limited number of knights that can use the [Guard Rate] stat and to maintain competitiveness with other option stats, we have decided not to significantly reduce its effectiveness. Instead, we are setting a cap at 80%, allowing Masters of the Book to select this stat up to the cap or choose other options as needed.

As for the [Reduce Veda Energy Consumption] stat, setting it to 100% could prevent any Veda Energy usage, which might lead to unintended gameplay issues. Exceeding specific thresholds could also undermine the effectiveness of other game mechanics like 'Sync Rate,' 'Skill Effects,' and 'Relic Set Options.' To avoid these issues, we've decided to cap this stat at 30%. We understand that reaching this cap may be difficult for some players, but maintaining a balanced and diverse strategic environment is crucial for enhancing the gameplay experience.

Furthermore, we will proceed with balance adjustments for specific Knights of Veda in the upcoming May 2 update. Details of these adjustments will be provided in the patch notes. Our aim is to minimize the frequency of balance changes and to focus more on buffs rather than nerfs to ensure a fair and enjoyable game environment for all players.

[h3]Xanthia[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Cooldown for teleportation (dodge) will be reduced. 
[*] The damage from the normal skill "Law of Gravity" and Signature Skill "Event Horizon," was previously distributed evenly, will now be segmented into early, mid, and late stages. The initial damage will be more potent, decreasing as it progresses to the later stages.
[/olist]

[h3]Albert[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The base damage threshold on Defense-based Knights will be adjusted to increase the damage ratio (applies to all Knights of Veda with Defense-based damage)
[*] The third strike of “Power of Earth” (normal attack) will be changed to defense-based damage. 
[*] The Veda Energy cost of the Signature Skill “The Roar of the Golden Lion” will be reduced. 
[/olist]

[h3]Atterisee[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Cooldown for teleportation (dodge) will be reduced. 
[*] Roll, Roll, Roll! (Normal Skill) - When the animated bear charges, the interval between hits will be reduced, allowing it to push targets more effectively. Damage during the charge will be adjusted accordingly.
[*] The Strong Attack charge time will be reduced, and a movement speed reduction effect will be added. 
[*] Research Pays Off (Signature Skill) will have the “Reduce Incoming Heal” replaced with “Decreased Defense”. 
Before: (1) Reduces ATK, (2) Reduce Incoming Heal, (3) Reduce All RES
After: (1) Reduces ATK, (2) Reduce DEF, (3) Reduce All RES
[*] The duration of debuffs granted by “Research Pays Off” will be increased. 
[/olist]

[h3]Lucian[/h3]
[olist]
[*] “Holy Sword of Blessing” (Normal Skill) will have its cooldown reduced and its duration increased.
[/olist] 

Andrei
[olist]
[*] The range of “Red Meteorite” (Normal Skill) and “Narcissistic Flame” (Strong Attack) will be increased.  
[*] The damage of “Red Meteorite” (Normal Skill) and “Narcissistic Flame” (Strong Attack) will be increased.
[/olist]  

[h3]Yanko[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Scaling for “Mechanic Arrow” (Basic Attack) will be increased. 
[*] Scaling for “Weakness Calculation” (Strong Attack) will be increased. 
[/olist]

Orlik
[olist]
[*] The base damage threshold on Defense-based Knights will be adjusted to increase the damage ratio (applies to all Knights of Veda with Defense-based damage. 
[*] The third strike of Orlik’s Strong Determination (Normal Attack) will be changed to Defense-based damage. 
[/olist]

[h3]Leon[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The base damage threshold on Defense-based Knights will be adjusted to increase the damage ratio (applies to all Knights of Veda with Defense-based damage. 
[*] The third strike of Leon’s “Justice!” (Normal Attack) will be changed to defense-based damage. 
[/olist]

Additionally, since launch, many Masters of the Book have enjoyed participating in Arena, and we have been closely monitoring the sentiment that Melee Knights of Veda are at a disadvantage compared to ranged Knights of Veda. The matches between melee and ranged are finely balanced, with the low stagger and tenacity of ranged Knights vs the high stagger and tenacity of melee ones playing a key role in balancing between the two. However we are aware of the disadvantages that melee Knights of Veda can run into, especially when facing highly specialized and effective ranged knights in the active 3v3 arena.

Currently, we are balancing the tenacity values of melee Veda Knights, and we are considering reducing the duration of stagger when it occurs repeatedly upon being hit. We are striving to obtain balanced test results, and update as quickly as possible. 
Once again, we feel a heavy responsibility for not predicting these situations earlier, and apologize for any inconvenience caused. 

[h2]The 50/50 Issue[/h2]
We’ve received a lot of feedback regarding the topic of the 50/50 not being shared across pickup character banners. The development team heavily underestimated the impact that having this focused on one character instead of both would have. We have listened to your feedback, and the 50/50 will be shared across multiple banners starting from the May 2 update. 

[h2]Inconvenience associated with forming parties[/h2]
We plan to introduce an automatic matching feature to streamline party formation without needing friend requests, allowing for quick re-invitations of previous party members. We aim to launch this update by May 16 and will provide a detailed schedule in due course.
We sincerely apologize for any shortcomings and assure you of our commitment to continually enhancing the game. We are dedicated to promptly addressing your feedback and understand the frustration and disappointment caused by ongoing issues and balance adjustments. 

To address this, we have prepared a small login event as follows:
From April 24 to May 2, participants will receive 200 Starstones daily, amounting to a total of 1,600 Starstones over the eight days.
Thank you for your understanding and support.
Best regards,
Youngmo Kim

notes.title: Director's First Update on Future Plans
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0d66f6b0ad34d439dbfab04e8707cf0df1b4b73b.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book. I'm Youngmo Kim.

Entering the third week following the launch of ASTRA: Knights of Veda on April 2nd, I want to emphasize that delivering excellent content and service remains our utmost priority. Despite our efforts, both the development team and our publishers HYBE IM acknowledge there have been shortcomings, particularly in addressing user inconveniences and our communication.

We are committed to attentively listening to every piece of feedback provided by our players on Discord and other community platforms. While we wish to respond to everyone's feedback individually, some responses and decisions require more time, and we apologize for any delays in communication.

We apologize for the recent update that decreased the efficiency of the ignore-defense option and reduced the capabilities of Capecchi. We understand this has caused significant frustration for users who invested time and resources into developing their characters. In a game where collecting characters is key, it is our responsibility to ensure thorough testing, and we regret that we fell short.

We will issue further details on the adjustments to character balance, options, and stats through an additional developer's note this week. Unlike previous practices, we will provide these details well in advance of the next update, ensuring there's ample time for community feedback. 

An upcoming developer note will also address the heavily discussed topic of the Character rate-up events, and the potential improvements we can make to them. 

Additionally, the upcoming developer's note will address the frequently discussed topics of the 50/50 system on the Event Call of the Stars and potential improvements we can make to it.

Actions speak louder than words. We are committed to addressing the areas of discomfort you've experienced and will continue to make visible improvements, even if progress seems slow at times. We promise to do our utmost with all the resources at our disposal.

This coming update on April 25th will focus on implementing changes based on the continuous feedback we've received. We are always doing our best to improve your experience with each update we roll out.

The maximum number of shoes will be increased from 160 to 240, and the recharge time for one shoe will be reduced from 8 minutes to 6 minutes. The support Knights will also be modified, bringing the level range from -5 to +2 up to -5 to +5. 
 
We also intend to make some changes to Veleno, the Knight of Veda added last week. 

[list]
[*] Regular attacks and signature skills will be modified so she doesn’t track backwards. 
[*] The projectile range of Veleno’s strong attack will increase by 33%. 
[*] Veleno’s Strong attack will penetrate one target when charged to the second stage. 
[*] During Auto-battle, the Knight of Veda 'Veleno' will maintain a certain distance from the target and use normal skills.
[/list] 

Changes to Option Stats:
[list]
[*]The baseline value for DoT damage will increase by a factor of 2.33 compared to its previous value (Example: 9%>21%). 
[/list] 
 
Additionally, there are a lot of things that we can improve on, such as the shortcomings of the party system, lack of content, insufficient on-time rewards and the lack of events. We want to make corrections and improvements as quickly as possible, but we will prioritize the most important issues and then work through everything sequentially. 
 
We’re working hard to prepare announcements of major content updates that we have planned for the future, and once we’re ready, we will make sure to announce it without hesitation. 

Once again, I apologize for the shortcomings of ASTRA: Knights of Veda so far, and we want to ensure that we can live up to your enthusiasm for the game. 
 
Thank you

notes.title: 4/18 Update Details (Last Updated 4/18 05:06 UTC)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/87b0a44139e8ce1ba75f608a64b3ec4c7ebf2ded.png[/img]

Masters of the Book! 

The “Gifted Doctor” Veleno is here! After the Day of Tragedy, Veleno has been sacrificing everything in order to find a cure for the Undead, and bring life back to the lands. But what has she been doing? What has been going on between her and the Spoiled Princess Atterisee? Explore the caves where danger lurks, and explore their ties. 

In addition to the Special Material Transport Mission, where you transport materials to predetermined goals to earn rewards, we’ve prepared other improvements to assist you on your Adventures! 

Let’s take a look at what is coming in the 4/18 update! 

[h1]■ Update [/h1]
- A new 5★ Knight of Veda, ‘Veleno’ appears. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/38b40a744a2b982fc04be4ed3d9f50c2c8fcd2a3.png[/img]

[code][b]"If you can understand the cause, then you can change the outcome"[/b]

Born with the qualities of a great doctor, she is willing to make personal sacrifices to aid others. Even in the face of the events of the Day of the Tragedy, Veleno holds a belief that she falls short because she has not yet found a cure for the undead. She will tirelessly delve into the study of poisons, subjecting herself to constant anguish, until she discovers a means to heal the wandering souls in Darkness...[/code]

[list]
[*] “Veleno” is a ranged Poison DPS who wields a small bow, and releases multiple arrows with concentrated poison at her enemies.
With her Normal Skill "Great Doctor's Poison Fog," Veleno swiftly evades backwards while releasing an area attack that deals poison damage to enemies. Veleno's Signature Skill, "Metastases of Poisoning" inflicts "Lethal Poison" to enemies pierced by her arrows, metastasizing poison to all foes nearby. All her attacks for a certain period will inflict poisoning, maximizing damage. 
Join the new missions and content introduced along with the “Gifted Doctor” Veleno to test her skills. 
[/list]

[list]
[*] New hero missions, “The Green Doctor and the Spoiled Princess” will be added. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/c0aae0e007f19e6122b3f34677cb26b585bf89be.png[/img]
[i]The Master of the Book encounters a stubborn child in a cave where danger lurks. Behind their confident demeanor, an intriguing mystery dwells. [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/e9f4cf0be0dd724b1ce1af2bcf20cbbc4ecc46a6.png[/img]
[i]As they unravel the mystery, perilous situations occur. At the end of it all, deeply buried secrets begin to reveal…[/i]

[*] Through the mission “The Green Doctor and the Stubborn Princess,” you can progress through the story of the newest Knight of Veda, “Veleno.”
[*] ‘Green Doctor and the Spoiled Princess’ can be picked up after clearing Adventure Stage 3-10, and can be collected from Demona. 
[*] Special Supply Delivery Operation has been added. 
- The new event, “Special Supply Delivery Operation” involves escorting materials from various regions. - Select your knights based on their elements to get the most out of the mission. 
- Each stage consists of 3 rounds, and you gain buffs by completing rounds 1 and 2. 
- Escort the wagon to its destination to obtain rewards. 
- The “Special Supply Delivery Operation” will end after the May 16 Maintenance. 
 
[*] Journey in Memory, Veleno Experience, will be added. 
- In this event, you can experience the newest Knight of Veda, Veleno(5★), along with Liam (4★), Marthel (4★), and Rani (4★).
- ‘Journey in Memory (Veleno Experience)’ will end after the May 16 Maintenance.
[/list]

[h1]■ Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new Auto-mode will be added that will utilize all Knights of Veda in a team. 
- Auto-Battle will be divided into Full and Semi automatic modes. 
- FULL Mode will automatically trigger the Overflowing Power of the Stars, and will switch your Knights of Veda to make full use of skills (Priority is given in Team Order). 
- For players who prefer to manually switch knights based on their own judgment, the SEMI mode allows them to engage in automatic combat as before.
- You can toggle through the available auto-modes by pressing the Auto-battle multiple times. (OFF → FULL → SEMI → OFF)
[*] The attribute icons will be changed to make it easier to identify an enemy's attribute. 
[*] The filter for Relics will be improved so that it will filter for all Relics, and not just the current Relic slot. 
[*] Viewing cutscenes in the log collection will be improved. Whereas previously it was divided into multiple small sections, the cutscenes will now play continuously, allowing you to immerse yourself in the story. 
[*] In the Adventure Guide, the number of current Hero’s Shoes will be displayed, and an icon to check which blessings are currently active in Tower of Trials will also be added. 
[*]The number of daily shoe charges will increase from 8 times to 10 times, and the cost to charge shoes after 8 times does not increase. (Added 4/18 05:03 UTC)
[/list]

[h1]■ Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The intermittent targeting issue with the Knight of Veda 'Albert's' normal skill will be fixed.
[*] The damage of Knight of Veda 'Xanthia's' normal skill will increase from 7.4% to 9.44%.
[*] The activation time for Knight of Veda 'Atterisee's' normal skill will decrease from 0.27 seconds to 0.15 seconds.
[*] The throwing angle of Knight of Veda 'Atterisee's' normal attack will be lowered, reducing the time it takes to reach the target and increasing the likelihood of getting closer targets.
[*] The damage of Knight of Veda 'Capecchi' normal skill will be reduced. (From 24.72% to 12.32%, and for Fate Level 2 from 30.88% to 15.44%)
- Adjustments have been made after confirming that the existing hit count criteria was incorrectly set, resulting in higher than expected damage.
[*] An error where activating the fourth Fate level of the Knight of Veda 'Capecchi' incorrectly increased the duration of his Signature Skill has been identified and will be fixed.
[*] The Ignore DEF Rate (%) value applied to all items will be halved
- The Ignore DEF Rate option has abnormally high expected damage output compared to other options. 
- This change will apply to all item stats including equipment, relics, gems, and enchantments (skill-applied stats will not be changed).
[*] Restrictions based on the Master of the Book's level will now be applied to the list of Knights of Veda available through the Support Knight system.
- Previously: No level restrictions for friend and guild support.
- Changed: For friend and guild support, the supported Knights are limited to those whose Masters of the Book's levels are within a range of -5 to +2 of the player’s level.
[*] The issue where the dialogue gets cut off if you move ahead of Lionel during 'Lionel's Guide' will be fixed.
[*] In Chapter 4, Stage 12, and Chapter 5, Stage 12, the problem with the NPCs' bodies disappearing immediately upon death during combat will be fixed.
[*] The issue where the 'Awakened Knight' quest in Chapter 5, Stage 2 cannot be completed normally when progressing in auto co-op mode will be fixed.
[*] The problem in Chapter 7, Stage 6, where players get stuck in trap sections during auto-battle and cannot progress, will be fixed.
[*] The issue where the mid-boss in Chapter 5 of Veda's Nightmare does not attack when approached will be fixed.
[*] The issue where navigation does not appear for items only listed in the substitution list in the inventory will be fixed.
[*] An issue where in certain circumstances an error message would appear when enhancing relics will be fixed. 
[*] An issue where the guild chat window displayed the earliest entered chat message when checking the chat again will be fixed. 
[*] An issue where clicking a World Mission, with other sub-missions active would cause missions to reorganize themselves will be fixed. 
[*] When exchanging for gold in the “Exchange Memories of the Stars”, the issue where the exchange did not correctly update 
[*] The issue where clicking on a locked adventure level in the Adventure Guide displays incorrect text will be fixed.
[*] An issue where changing the language in Nightmares caused all owned missions to be displayed as “View Profile” will be fixed. 
[*] The issue where pressing the ESC key repeatedly before entering the Call of the Stars tutorial prevents progression will be fixed.
[*] In the Forgotten Mine, a problem where supporting with the same Knight of Veda that is already in the current team does not remove the duplicated Knight will be fixed.
[*] The issue where the game UI displays abnormally when network disconnection occurs on mobile devices during an Adventure Stage will be fixed.
[*] The problem where progression is not possible due to network disconnection on mobile devices during the loading screen after 3:3 Arena matching will be fixed.
[*] The issue where the crown indicating the player appears dimmed during 2:2 and 3:3 Arena matches will be fixed.
[*] The issue where Crown of Victory points were not displayed on the Arena ranking page will be fixed.
[*] The issue with the meaningless notification (exclamation mark) on the top left of the World Map will be fixed.
[b][*]The 4-set effect of the Relic [Sculptor of Despair](★3, ★4, ★5) will have some restrictions on its functionality. (Added April 17, 2024 5:44 PM)
(Previously) When blocking an attack, the stamina consumed was reduced by 40%, and 120% of the damage received was reflected.
(Now) When blocking an attack, the stamina consumed is reduced by 40%. Additionally, within 1 second after guarding, 120% of the damage received is reflected. [Added 4/17 08:58 UTC][/b]
[*] An issue where Arena’s Crown of Victory reset time was not updating properly has been identified and will be fixed. [Added 4/17 10:34 UTC]
[*]An error will be fixed where if an 'Apostle' monster appeared in a stage, it would always appear in additional attempts triggered by using Hero's Shoes, or if it did not appear, it would never appear in additional attempts. Now, the appearance probability will be properly reflected in additional attempts. (Added April 17, 2024 7:01 AM PDT, 02:01 PM UTC)

[/list]

[h1]■ Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] 「Adventurer's Ascent」 Knights of Veda Enhancement Package name and purchase conditions changes
- Adventurer's Ascent」 Knights of Veda Enhancement Package will be changed to 'Adventurer's Package.'
- 「Adventurer's Ascent」 The purchase conditions will be revised to allow purchases once every two weeks.
[/list]

Thank you
